scripts.text:
[Vigilante Ajegna]
Huh? I doubt you're from Far-Star.
I get it! You're from the New Continent, aren't you?
scripts.translation:
[义警 阿杰尼亚]
咦？您看起来不像是法尔斯塔尔人。
我明白了！您是从新大陆来的吧？

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Ajegna]
If you're planning to cross that ridge, I wouldn't recommend it.
Why don't you just return to your village from here?
scripts.translation:
[义警 阿杰尼亚]
如果您打算翻过那道山脊，我劝您还是别去。
不如从这里直接回村子吧？

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Ajegna]
Oh, there you go!
You can talk to others in the same way you just spoke to me.
scripts.translation:
[义警 阿杰尼亚]
对，就是这样！
您刚才是怎么和我交谈的，也可以照样和其他人交谈。

scripts.text:
!- Notice -!
^4d4dffBasically, you talk by left-clicking the mouse button while hovering the cursor over an NPC.
Left-click the mouse button to talk with an NPC, move about and attack a target.^000000
scripts.translation:
!- 告示 -!
^4d4dff通常，将鼠标光标移到 NPC 身上并点击鼠标左键，就能与其交谈。
点击鼠标左键还可以与 NPC 交谈、移动或攻击目标。^000000

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Ajegna]
Good work crossing over the mountain, newbie.
Just like yourself, there are a bunch of people who are crossing this mountain range these days to reach the ^4d4dffNew Continent^000000.
scripts.translation:
[义警 阿杰尼亚]
不错嘛，新人，成功翻过山了。
和您一样，最近有很多人也翻越这片山脉，前往^4d4dff新大陆^000000。

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Ajegna]
Honestly, I was surprised, too.
I never imagined even in my wildest dreams that there would be any other continent other than ^4d4dffMidgard^000000 or ^4d4dffFar-Star,^000000 which we live in.
scripts.translation:
[义警 阿杰尼亚]
说实话，我也很惊讶。
我做梦都没想到，除了我们居住的^4d4dff米德加尔特^000000和^4d4dff法尔斯塔尔^000000之外，竟然还有其他大陆。

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Ajegna]
That explains the slew of Dorams, who simply wander about, in ^4d4dffLasagna^000000, which was nothing but a fishing village in the border area.
scripts.translation:
[义警 阿杰尼亚]
这就解释了为什么^4d4dff罗札纳^000000会有那么多四处游荡的多兰——它原本不过是边境地区的一个渔村。

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Ajegna]
What's worse is that the Dorams who come from outside of Lasagna would often cause problems. This is really causing a headache for the Vigilante Corp.
A Vigilante's job is to assist the Dorams who are in the New Continent expedition, in addition to maintaining public order, so please help.
scripts.translation:
[义警 阿杰尼亚]
更麻烦的是，从罗札纳以外来的多兰经常惹出乱子，义警团为此头疼不已。
义警既要维持治安，也要协助参加新大陆探险的多兰，请您多多配合。

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Ajegna]
Do you see the Doram over there? He's ^4d4dffAglio^000000. He'll let you in on some useful stuff. Go meet the guy.
scripts.translation:
[义警 阿杰尼亚]
看到那边的多兰了吗？他叫^4d4dff阿利奥^000000，会告诉您一些有用的信息。去找他聊聊吧。

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Ajegna]
I should welcome the new Dorams coming in here.
^4d4dffAglio^000000 will let you in on more details. He's right over there.
scripts.translation:
[义警 阿杰尼亚]
我得欢迎新来的多兰才行。
^4d4dff阿利奥^000000会告诉您更多详情，他就在那边。

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Ajegna]
Aglio is one of the very, I mean, very good Doram in the Farfalle Vigilante Corp, so watch and learn!
scripts.translation:
[义警 阿杰尼亚]
阿利奥可是法尔法莱义警团里数一数二优秀的多兰，好好向他学习吧！

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Ajegna]
If you have any questions, don't hesitate to ask him.
Don't be a stranger even when you're out on the New Continent!
scripts.translation:
[义警 阿杰尼亚]
有问题尽管问他。
即使到了新大陆，也别见外！

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Ajegna]
The Lasagna Port is over that way!
Don't tell me you're here because you didn't know that.
scripts.translation:
[义警 阿杰尼亚]
罗札纳港在那边！
您该不会是因为不知道港口在哪儿，才跑到这里来的吧？

scripts.text:
[Paul]
~Shrieks~ You startled me!
A human? Wow, what an odd-looking one!
scripts.translation:
[保罗]
（尖叫）吓我一跳！
人类？哇，长得真奇怪！

scripts.text:
[Paul]
So, you're that adventurer Doram, eh?
Hey, what do you think?
You agree with me about damage, right? STR comes first!
scripts.translation:
[保罗]
所以，您就是那位冒险者多兰啊？
喂，您怎么看？
说到伤害，您也同意我的看法吧？力量（STR）最重要！

scripts.text:
[Paul]
You need to be on the offense to win the battle.
^4d4dffThe quickest way to boost ATK is to boost STR^000000!
scripts.translation:
[保罗]
想赢得战斗，就得主动进攻。
^4d4dff提升攻击力（ATK）最快的方法就是提高力量（STR）！^000000

scripts.text:
[MacCarnie]
...Reckless attacks are of no use!
No attack will work if you miss the target!
scripts.translation:
[麦卡尼]
...鲁莽进攻没有用！
打不中目标，再强的攻击也白费！

scripts.text:
[MacCarnie]
So, ^4d4dffyou need to boost DEX first to increase Accuracy^000000.
It doesn't matter how strong you are. You need to hit the target first!
scripts.translation:
[麦卡尼]
所以，^4d4dff得先提升灵巧（DEX），提高命中率^000000。
不管力量多强，首先得击中目标！

scripts.text:
[MacCarnie]
I refuse to use martial arts willy-nilly as you do!
^4d4dffI'm using the summoning skill by boosting INT for magical attacks!^000000
scripts.translation:
[麦卡尼]
我才不像您那样随便乱用武术！
^4d4dff我会提升智力（INT），用召唤技能发动魔法攻击！^000000

scripts.text:
[Paul]
Pfff! What's wrong with using the summoning skills to complement the physical skills?
Are you implying that I haven't got a clue?
scripts.translation:
[保罗]
噗！用召唤技能辅助物理攻击有什么不对？
您是在说我一窍不通吗？

scripts.text:
[MacCarnie]
...That's not what I meant! This cat's brains must be full of fat!
scripts.translation:
[麦卡尼]
...我不是那个意思！这只猫的脑子里装的都是肥肉吗！

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Gnocchi]
...Stop fighting, you two!
Hey, there. Newcomer.
You can ask me if there is something you'd like to know.
scripts.translation:
[义警 尼奥奇]
...你们两个别吵了！
喂，新来的。
有什么想知道的，尽管问我。

scripts.text:
[Paul]
He might tell you What's good about being a Vigilante, so go ahead and ask him.
He'll prove that I was right, after all.
scripts.translation:
[保罗]
去问问他当义警有什么好处吧。
到时候他就会证明我才是对的。

scripts.text:
[Paul]
So, is this all about boosting your abilities based on your competencies?
scripts.translation:
[保罗]
所以，只要根据自己的能力提升相应属性就行了吗？

scripts.text:
[Paul]
Come to think of it, there is a ^4d4dffhypnotist^000000 in the village.
^4d4dffYou can reset skills and statuses through a hypnotist^000000. Just so you know that you can.
scripts.translation:
[保罗]
说起来，村里有位^4d4dff催眠师^000000。
^4d4dff催眠师可以帮您重置技能和属性^000000，告诉您一声。

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Gnocchi]
Ahem! This is like a gateway to the Far-Star Continent.
No more humans are allowed!
scripts.translation:
[义警 尼奥奇]
咳！这里就像通往法尔斯塔尔大陆的关口。
不再允许人类通过！

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Gnocchi]
So they were having an animated discussion over status.
scripts.translation:
[义警 尼奥奇]
原来他们刚才是在激烈地争论属性啊。

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Gnocchi]
Do you need more explanation on the status?
scripts.translation:
[义警 尼奥奇]
还需要我进一步说明属性吗？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 需要

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不需要

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Gnocchi]
Up to level 49, the village hypnotist will reset your stats and skills.
This will let you practice and experiment which will help find the path that works for you.
scripts.translation:
[义警 尼奥奇]
49 级以前，村里的催眠师可以帮您重置属性和技能。
您可以借此练习、尝试不同的路线，找到适合自己的发展方向。

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Gnocchi]
Press the ^4d4dffAlt+Q^000000 keys to view your physical stats.
Calibration is also available depending on your equipment.
scripts.translation:
[义警 尼奥奇]
按 ^4d4dffAlt+Q^000000 查看角色属性。
装备不同，可调整的属性也会有所不同。

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Gnocchi]
Let me explain the statuses in detail.
^4d4dffSTR means strength^000000. It ^4d4dffboosts physical attacks^000000.
scripts.translation:
[义警 尼奥奇]
我来详细说明各项属性。
^4d4dffSTR 代表力量^000000，能^4d4dff提高物理攻击力^000000。

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Gnocchi]
^4d4dffVIT is vitality which indicates health^000000. This is what ^4d4dffboosts your overall HP^000000.
^4d4dffAGI means agility^000000. It affects ^4d4dffevasion and attack speed^000000.
scripts.translation:
[义警 尼奥奇]
^4d4dffVIT 代表体质，关系到生命力^000000，能^4d4dff提高 HP 上限^000000。
^4d4dffAGI 代表敏捷^000000，会影响^4d4dff闪避率和攻击速度^000000。

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Gnocchi]
^4d4dffINT refers to intelligence and MATK means magical attack^000000. If your skills are centered on magic, you must boost INT first and foremost.
scripts.translation:
[义警 尼奥奇]
^4d4dffINT 代表智力，MATK 代表魔法攻击力^000000。如果您的技能以魔法为主，最优先提升的就是 INT。

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Gnocchi]
^4d4dffDEX is related with dexterity and accuracy^000000.
You can both quicken casting speed and boost the accuracy of your attacks.
scripts.translation:
[义警 尼奥奇]
^4d4dffDEX 与灵巧和命中率有关^000000。
提升 DEX 可以加快咏唱速度，也能提高攻击命中率。

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Gnocchi]
^4d4dffLUK means luck; the more luck you have, the higher your critical hit rate (CRI) becomes^000000.
It also means you can dodge an enemy's attack more easily.
scripts.translation:
[义警 尼奥奇]
^4d4dffLUK 代表幸运；幸运越高，暴击率（CRI）也越高^000000。
幸运还能提高完全回避率，让您更容易避开敌人的攻击。

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Gnocchi]
If you want to boost your physical attacks, focus on STR. If what you want is magical attacks, go for INT. Got it?
scripts.translation:
[义警 尼奥奇]
想提高物理攻击就专注提升 STR，想强化魔法攻击就提升 INT。明白了吗？

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Gnocchi]
DEX is highly crucial in the early stages because it is what boosts Accuracy.
This can be a difficult concept to get, so you should try boosting this and that to find your own way.
scripts.translation:
[义警 尼奥奇]
初期 DEX 尤其重要，因为它能提高命中率。
这个概念可能不太好理解，您可以多试着调整不同属性，找到适合自己的方式。

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Gnocchi]
I wish you godspeed!
scripts.translation:
[义警 尼奥奇]
祝您一路顺风！

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Aglio]
Oh! You must be the famous strangers from the New Continent, eh?
Out-of-towner Dorams abound in this place, I definitely don't want any more of them.
scripts.translation:
[义警 阿利奥]
哦！您一定就是那些来自新大陆、鼎鼎有名的外来者吧？
这里外地来的多兰已经够多了，我可不想再来更多。

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Aglio]
Wouldn't they be surprised to see you guys?
Moreover, it's dangerous to cross the mountain ridge.
This is for your own good. Just go back to where you come from.
scripts.translation:
[义警 阿利奥]
他们看到你们，肯定会大吃一惊吧？
而且翻越山脊很危险。
我是为你们好，还是回原来的地方去吧。

scripts.text:
- Hold on a second here!! -
- You have too many items. -
- That means you can no longer receive any items. -
- Free up some space -
- and try again. -
scripts.translation:
- 请稍等！ -
- 您的物品太多了。 -
- 已无法再领取物品。 -
- 请腾出一些空间 -
- 然后重试。 -

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Aglio]
Oh, hello?
I'm Aglio. I'm going to be your attendant from this point on.
Consider it a privilege.
Because I'm one of the ace members of the Farfalle Vigilante Corp.
scripts.translation:
[义警 阿利奥]
哦，您好！
我是阿利奥，从现在起由我负责接待您。
能由我接待，您应该感到荣幸。
毕竟，我可是法尔法莱义警团的王牌成员之一。

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Aglio]
I'm sure I can be of help for just about anything.
First off, let's see what you've got.
scripts.translation:
[义警 阿利奥]
无论什么事，我都能帮上忙。
首先，让我看看您带了些什么。

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Aglio]
Hang on. Let me check if you are properly equipped first.
You don't want to fight with bare hands, now do you?
^4d4dffYou should equip your weapons.^000000
scripts.translation:
[义警 阿利奥]
稍等，我先检查一下您的装备。
您总不想空手去战斗吧？
^4d4dff记得装备武器。^000000

scripts.text:
!- Notice -!
^4d4dffYou can use or equip an item by double-clicking it.
Open or close the item window with the shortcut key [Alt+E].
scripts.translation:
!- 告示 -!
^4d4dff双击物品即可使用或装备。
按快捷键 [Alt+E] 可以打开或关闭物品窗口。

scripts.text:
!- Notice -!
^4d4dffCheck out your equipped items easily by pressing the shortcut key [Alt+Q].
Simply drag the appropriate items to the area you'd like to equip.^000000
scripts.translation:
!- 告示 -!
^4d4dff按快捷键 [Alt+Q]，即可查看已装备的物品。
将对应物品拖到想装备的位置即可。^000000

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Aglio]
Now that we've checked your weapons, why don't we take a look at a target to hunt?
Do you see those ^4d4dffEggring^000000 wandering around over there?
scripts.translation:
[义警 阿利奥]
武器检查完了，接下来找个目标练练手吧。
看到那边游荡的^4d4dff蛋黄波利^000000了吗？

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Aglio]
They may look dumb but they can be a real pain in the butt. They will pick up and eat anything they come across.
They are a dime a dozen around here, so they're a great target for the novice Dorams to test their worth on.
scripts.translation:
[义警 阿利奥]
它们看起来傻乎乎的，其实很烦人，遇到什么都会捡起来吃掉。
这里到处都是，正好让初心者多兰拿它们练练手。

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Aglio]
Go ahead and get rid of some ^4d4dffEggring^000000, will you? ^4d4dffThree^000000 should do for now.
scripts.translation:
[义警 阿利奥]
去消灭几只^4d4dff蛋黄波利^000000吧！暂时打^4d4dff三只^000000就够了。

scripts.text:
^4d4dff!- Notice -!^000000
You have accepted a quest from an NPC.
^4d4dffCheck out the quest details by pressing the shortcut key [Alt+U],^000000 or through the Quest icon found in the menu tray.^000000
scripts.translation:
^4d4dff!- 告示 -!^000000
您已接受 NPC 发布的任务。
^4d4dff按快捷键 [Alt+U] 查看任务详情，^000000也可以点击菜单栏中的任务图标。^000000

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Aglio]
Alright, to warm up, go and eliminate ^4d4dffthree Eggrings^000000.
scripts.translation:
[义警 阿利奥]
先热热身，去消灭^4d4dff三只蛋黄波利^000000吧。

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Aglio]
What do they look like? You'll see just by glancing at them right away. You can't miss them!
They abound around here. Go get them, tiger!
scripts.translation:
[义警 阿利奥]
它们长什么样？一眼就能认出来，绝对不会认错！
这里到处都是，去吧，小老虎！

scripts.text:
^4d4dff!- Notice -!^000000
^4d4dffCheck out the quest details by pressing the shortcut key [Alt+U],^000000 or through the Quest icon found in the menu tray.^000000
scripts.translation:
^4d4dff!- 告示 -!^000000
^4d4dff按快捷键 [Alt+U] 查看任务详情，^000000也可以点击菜单栏中的任务图标。^000000

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Aglio]
Whoa, you're good!
I should've seen that in you because crossing the mountains is never easy.
scripts.translation:
[义警 阿利奥]
哇，您真厉害！
我早该看出来您有这本事，毕竟翻过这片山脉可不容易。

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Aglio]
I believe you can do very well, even in a new location.
Here, take this.
scripts.translation:
[义警 阿利奥]
我相信您到了新地方也能应付自如。
来，这个给您。

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Aglio]
I brought some snacks for you.
It's cool apple juice!
scripts.translation:
[义警 阿利奥]
我给您带了些点心。
这是冰镇苹果汁！

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Aglio]
Click the 'Item' icon in the basic information window found in the upper left-hand side to open the item window.
scripts.translation:
[义警 阿利奥]
点击左上角基本信息窗口中的“物品”图标，即可打开物品窗口。

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Aglio]
The item window comes with four tabs.
Items are automatically placed into the Item, Gear and Etc tabs, depending on their type.
scripts.translation:
[义警 阿利奥]
物品窗口有四个标签页。
物品会根据类型自动归入“物品”、“装备”和“其他”标签页。

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Aglio]
To use or equip an item, ^4d4dffdouble-click that item^000000, or
^4d4dffdrag it to the Equipment window^000000 to use.
scripts.translation:
[义警 阿利奥]
要使用或装备物品，^4d4dff双击该物品^000000，或者^4d4dff将物品拖到装备窗口^000000。

scripts.text:
!- Notice -!
^4d4dffYou can use or equip an item by double-clicking it.
Open or close the item window with the shortcut key [Alt+E].
scripts.translation:
!- 告示 -!
^4d4dff双击物品即可使用或装备。
按快捷键 [Alt+E] 可以打开或关闭物品窗口。

scripts.text:
!- Notice -!
^4d4dffCheck out your equipped items easily by pressing the shortcut key [Alt+Q].
Or, simply drag the appropriate items to the area you'd like to equip.^000000
scripts.translation:
!- 告示 -!
^4d4dff按快捷键 [Alt+Q]，即可查看已装备的物品。
也可以将对应物品拖到想装备的位置。^000000

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Aglio]
If you want to ^4d4dffsee a detailed description for each item, right-click that item.^000000
This shows the detailed description of the selected item.
scripts.translation:
[义警 阿利奥]
想^4d4dff查看物品的详细说明，请右键点击该物品。^000000
这样就能显示所选物品的详细说明。

scripts.text:
!- Notice -!
^4d4dffRight-click an item to view its detailed description.^000000
scripts.translation:
!- 告示 -!
^4d4dff右键点击物品，即可查看详细说明。^000000

scripts.text:
!- Notice -!
^4d4dffIf a player wishes, they can use the social options such as Booking, Party, or Guild. Here, they join a party or request transactions.^000000
scripts.translation:
!- 告示 -!
^4d4dff玩家可以使用预约、队伍或公会等社交功能，也可以加入队伍或发起交易。^000000

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Aglio]
Well, then. ^4d4dffGo ahead and drink the apple juice that I gave you.^000000
scripts.translation:
[义警 阿利奥]
那么，^4d4dff把我给您的苹果汁喝了吧。^000000

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Aglio]
How do you like it? It's cool, sweet, and just good, right?
I would've given you more if I had any, but...no.
scripts.translation:
[义警 阿利奥]
味道怎么样？冰冰凉凉、甜甜的，很好喝吧？
我本来还想多给您一些，可惜没有了...

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Aglio]
Oh, right! I'll give you this, too.
It'll restore your stamina if you take it when you're tired.
scripts.translation:
[义警 阿利奥]
对了，这个也给您。
累了的时候喝下它，可以恢复体力。

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Aglio]
Also, I'll give you a new staff.
It should be better than that sprout you brought with you.
Now you know how to equip an item because I already explained it to you, don't you?
scripts.translation:
[义警 阿利奥]
我再给您一把新法杖。
应该比您带来的那根嫩芽法杖好用。
我已经教过您如何装备物品，应该会用了吧？

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Aglio]
I'll direct you to the village, now.
scripts.translation:
[义警 阿利奥]
我现在带您去村子。

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Aglio]
What's up?
Oh, you're the youngest kitten of the tool merchant!
it's dangerous around here. What brought you all this way?
scripts.translation:
[义警 阿利奥]
怎么了？
哦，您是道具商人家最小的猫崽！
这里很危险，您跑这么远来做什么？

scripts.text:
[The Youngest Kitten of the Tool Merchant]
Oh, actually...I lost it!
There was a box!
I was supposed to give it to Haru.
I was just trying to hang out for a while, but I fell down!
scripts.translation:
[道具商人家的小猫崽]
其实...我把东西弄丢了！
有个箱子！
我本来要把它交给哈鲁。
我只是在这里玩了一会儿，结果摔了一跤！

scripts.text:
[The Youngest Kitten of the Tool Merchant]
Please find it, Aglio!
Or, I'm going to be in trouble!
scripts.translation:
[道具商人家的小猫崽]
阿利奥，求你帮我找找！
不然我就惨了！

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Aglio]
So, you were running an errand to deliver a box to Healer Haru.
But you fell down while hanging out for a while and lost the box. Is that it?
scripts.translation:
[义警 阿利奥]
所以，您是要替人把箱子送给治疗师哈鲁。
结果玩耍时摔了一跤，把箱子弄丢了。是这样吧？

scripts.text:
[The Youngest Child of the Tool Merchant]
Yes, sir!
You're so good at summing it up!
scripts.translation:
[道具商人家的小猫崽]
是的，先生！
您总结得真好！

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Aglio]
Alright. You just return to your village.
I'll see what I can do. You return home and wait.
scripts.translation:
[义警 阿利奥]
好吧，您先回村子。
我来想办法，您回家等消息。

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Aglio]
One more thing. Just drop that habit of acting like you're naive in front of the strangers!
scripts.translation:
[义警 阿利奥]
还有一件事，别再在陌生人面前装天真了！

scripts.text:
[The Youngest Kitten of the Tool Merchant]
Come on...I'm the cutest, youngest kitten from Lasagna!
Anyway, I hope you help me by finding that box. Please.
scripts.translation:
[道具商人家的小猫崽]
拜托啦...我可是罗札纳最可爱、最小的猫崽！
总之，求你帮我把箱子找回来。拜托了。

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Aglio]
.....
........~Sighs deeply~...

[Vigilante Aglio]
Well, there's no choice, then.
{0}
I think you can step up and handle it this time.
scripts.translation:
[义警 阿利奥]
看来只能这样了。
{0}
这次就交给您处理吧。

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Aglio]
it's a relief to have a competent Doram with me.
My guess is that an ^4d4dffEggring must've eaten that box.^000000
scripts.translation:
[义警 阿利奥]
有位能干的多兰和我同行，真让人放心。
我猜那个箱子一定是被^4d4dff蛋黄波利^000000吃掉了。

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Aglio]
Keep hunting Eggrings until you find that box...
Let's go!
scripts.translation:
[义警 阿利奥]
继续猎杀蛋黄波利，直到找到箱子为止...
出发吧！

scripts.text:
!- Notice -!
^4d4dffYou accepted a new quest from Vigilante Aglio.
Check out the details of the quest in the Quest Information Window.
scripts.translation:
!- 告示 -!
^4d4dff您接受了义警阿利奥发布的新任务。
请在任务信息窗口中查看任务详情。

scripts.text:
!- Notice -!
Press the ^4d4dffAlt + U^000000 shortcut key to open the Quest Information Window.
scripts.translation:
!- 告示 -!
按 ^4d4dffAlt + U^000000 快捷键，打开任务信息窗口。

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Aglio]
You must remember Eggrings, you've hunted them before, haven't you?
They are easily spotted around here.
scripts.translation:
[义警 阿利奥]
您还记得蛋黄波利吧？之前不是猎杀过吗？
这附近很容易就能找到它们。

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Aglio]
I have no idea which Eggring swallowed the box, but, you'll find it once you start hunting them.
scripts.translation:
[义警 阿利奥]
我不知道是哪只蛋黄波利吞了箱子，不过您开始狩猎后一定能找到它。

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Aglio]
Well, then. I'm counting on you.
scripts.translation:
[义警 阿利奥]
那就拜托您了。

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Aglio]
Ohh...! This is the box!
You can bring this when you visit the village!
scripts.translation:
[义警 阿利奥]
哦...！就是这个箱子！
您进村时把它带上吧！

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Aglio]
^4d4dffWhen you arrive in the village, find the tool shop first and deliver this box.^000000
scripts.translation:
[义警 阿利奥]
^4d4dff到村子后，请先找到道具商店，把这个箱子交过去。^000000

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Aglio]
I'll let you know how to reach the village.
Follow the arrows that just appeared on the ground.
scripts.translation:
[义警 阿利奥]
我告诉您怎么去村子。
沿着刚出现在地面上的箭头走就行。

scripts.text:
!- Notice -!
^4d4dffSometimes NPCs will help you find your destination through the Navigation tool.
Links can be created if there is a need for it. If you see the [Target], click it for pathfinding.^000000
scripts.translation:
!- 告示 -!
^4d4dff有时 NPC 会通过导航工具帮您寻找目的地。
如有需要，也可以创建导航链接。看到[目标]时，点击它即可开始寻路。^000000

scripts.text:
!- Notice -!
^4d4dffCall up the Navigation panel by clicking the appropriate menu icon.
Search for the target, set the goal, and click Pathfinding.
Arrows will be generated pointing toward the location of the target.^000000
scripts.translation:
!- 告示 -!
^4d4dff点击对应的菜单图标，打开导航面板。
搜索目标并设为目的地，然后点击“寻路”。
地面上会出现指向目的地的箭头。^000000

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Aglio]
What's in front of you is Lasagna, the harbor village.
You should bring that box to the tool shop first, right?
scripts.translation:
[义警 阿利奥]
您前面就是港口村罗札纳。
应该先把箱子送到道具商店吧？

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Aglio]
I'll let you know how to reach the village.
Follow the arrows that just appeared on the ground.
scripts.translation:
[义警 阿利奥]
我告诉您怎么去村子。
沿着刚出现在地面上的箭头走就行。

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Aglio]
I'll be right behind you!
Don't worry about me. Just keep going.
scripts.translation:
[义警 阿利奥]
我会跟在您后面！
不用担心我，继续走吧。

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Aglio]
Haven't you left for Midgard yet?
Well, problems do occur at the harbor from time to time, but I thought it wouldn't be an issue for you.
scripts.translation:
[义警 阿利奥]
您还没出发去米德加尔特吗？
港口偶尔确实会出点问题，不过我还以为难不倒您。

scripts.text:
- Hold on a second here!! -
- You have too many items. -
- That means you can no longer receive any items. -
- Free up some space -
- and try again. -
scripts.translation:
- 请稍等！ -
- 您的物品太多了。 -
- 已无法再领取物品。 -
- 请腾出一些空间 -
- 然后重试。 -

scripts.text:
[Sloth]
Hmm...You look energetic.
You see, I have an upset stomach.
scripts.translation:
[斯洛斯]
嗯...您看起来精神不错。
我肚子不太舒服。

scripts.text:
[Sloth]
The weather is sunny and warm, but...
I think I'm having a very bad day...
scripts.translation:
[斯洛斯]
天气晴朗又暖和，可是...
我今天好像特别倒霉...

scripts.text:
[Sloth]
I should pluck all the Red Grass in this herb field...
scripts.translation:
[斯洛斯]
我得把这片药草田里的红草都采下来...

scripts.text:
[Sloth]
But I'm pleasantly full in this fine sunny weather...
And there's a good breeze blowing...
scripts.translation:
[斯洛斯]
不过天气这么好，吃饱后真舒服...
还有微风吹来...

scripts.text:
[Sloth]
I don't think I can ever drag myself up.
But I'm supposed to pluck the Red Grass...
If you do it I'll give you anchovies, okay?
scripts.translation:
[斯洛斯]
我大概再也爬不起来了。
可我还得去采红草...
你帮我采的话，我就给你鳀鱼，好吗？

scripts.text: I'll pluck the Red Grass for you.
scripts.translation: 我来帮你采红草

scripts.text: Move your butt, you lazy sloth!
scripts.translation: 快起来干活，你这只懒树懒！

scripts.text:
[Sloth]
^4d4dffPluck 3 Red Grass and then collect 2 Red Herbs^000000 around here!
scripts.translation:
[斯洛斯]
^4d4dff在这附近采 3 株红草，再收集 2 份红色药草^000000！

scripts.text:
[Sloth]
This may be of great help to you!
Well, then. I'm counting on you.
scripts.translation:
[斯洛斯]
这对你会很有帮助！
那就拜托你了。

scripts.text:
[Sloth]
I'll rest here to make my upset stomach feel better.
scripts.translation:
[斯洛斯]
我要在这里休息一下，让肚子舒服些。

scripts.text:
[Sloth]
Meeow....
....Meeowww....

[Sloth]
What I want isn't too much.
Just ^4d4dffpluck the Red Grass and collect 2 Red Herbs^000000 around here. That's all.
scripts.translation:
[斯洛斯]
我的要求不高。
只要^4d4dff在这附近采些红草，再收集 2 份红色药草^000000就行了。

scripts.text:
[Sloth]
They grow too fast and keep growing no matter how many times I pluck them. I've had it...
scripts.translation:
[斯洛斯]
它们长得太快了，不管我采多少次，还是会一直长...我受够了...

scripts.text:
[Sloth]
What I want isn't too much.
Just ^4d4dffpluck the Red Grass and collect 2 Red Herbs^000000 around here. That's all.
scripts.translation:
[斯洛斯]
我的要求不高。
只要^4d4dff在这附近采些红草，再收集 2 份红色药草^000000就行了。

scripts.text:
[Sloth]
Oh...This aroma!
You plucked the Red Herbs just right.
scripts.translation:
[斯洛斯]
哦...这股香味！
红色药草采得正好。

scripts.text:
[Sloth]
I'll munch on them like twigs and digest them just like that. Meow!
scripts.translation:
[斯洛斯]
我会像嚼树枝一样把它们嚼碎，就这样消化掉。喵！

scripts.text:
[Sloth]
I'll give you the left-over herbs as a reward.
Chew them up and ^4d4dffyour HP will be restored.^000000
scripts.translation:
[斯洛斯]
剩下的药草就送给你当奖励。
嚼碎吃下去，^4d4dff就能恢复 HP。^000000

scripts.text:
[Sloth]
If you ask Haru, she'll tell you how to turn them into a potion with more effects.
scripts.translation:
[斯洛斯]
去问哈鲁的话，她会告诉你怎么把它们制成效果更好的药水。

scripts.text:
[Sloth]
Anyway, I'm the cat who knows how to return the favor.
This is for you.
Stay out of trouble, now.
scripts.translation:
[斯洛斯]
总之，我可是懂得知恩图报的猫。
这个给你。
以后别惹麻烦了。

scripts.text:
[Sloth]
I'm feeling... so tired...
scripts.translation:
[斯洛斯]
我好...累...

scripts.text:
[Well-known Troublemaker]
What brought you all the way up here, human?
Be gone! Be gone, meeow!
scripts.translation:
[著名的捣蛋鬼]
人类，你跑这么远来做什么？
快走！快走，喵！

scripts.text:
[Well-known Troublemaker]
This is like a gateway. It cannot and should not be tainted by humans!
scripts.translation:
[著名的捣蛋鬼]
这里就像一道关口，绝不能让人类玷污！

scripts.text:
[Well-known Kittie]
Hey, buddy!
Nyo-hoho! Nyo-hoho! You look so hectic. Where are you going?
To me, you look like a newbie adventurer who has just crossed the mountain ridge, meeow.
scripts.translation:
[有名的小猫]
嘿，伙计！
喵呵呵！喵呵呵！你看起来急匆匆的，要去哪儿？
依我看，你是刚翻过山脊的新手冒险者吧，喵。

scripts.text:
[Well-known Kittie]
Aren't you too weak to handle the Dorams in Lasagna?
scripts.translation:
[有名的小猫]
你这么弱，能对付罗札纳的多兰吗？

scripts.text:
[Well-known Kittie]
Do you even know how to use skills?
To me, you look like a greenhorn who's simply acting out.
scripts.translation:
[有名的小猫]
你会用技能吗？
依我看，你只是个装腔作势的菜鸟。

scripts.text: I'm a better fighter than you are!
scripts.translation: 我的战斗本领比你强！

scripts.text: Whoa, is that so?
scripts.translation: 哇，是吗？

scripts.text:
[Well-known Kittie]
Nyo-ho! Nyo-ho! How dare you disrespect me?
How about making a bet with me?
scripts.translation:
[有名的小猫]
喵呵！喵呵！你竟敢对我无礼？
要不要跟我打个赌？

scripts.text:
[Well-known Kittie]
I'll give you 10 full minutes while you hunt ^4d4dff3 Leaf Lunatics and 2 Grass Fabres^000000 around here!
scripts.translation:
[有名的小猫]
我给你整整 10 分钟，在这附近猎杀^4d4dff3 只群叶疯兔和 2 只草地绿棉虫^000000！

scripts.text:
[Well-known Kittie]
If you show me what you're made of, I'll get out of your way.
scripts.translation:
[有名的小猫]
只要你证明自己的本事，我就给你让路。

scripts.text: Accept.
scripts.translation: 接受

scripts.text: Decline.
scripts.translation: 拒绝

scripts.text:
[Well-known Kittie]
You've got 10 minutes. No more, no less!
^4d4dff3 Leaf Lunatics and 2 Grass Fabres!^000000
scripts.translation:
[有名的小猫]
你有 10 分钟，不多也不少！
^4d4dff3 只群叶疯兔和 2 只草地绿棉虫！^000000

scripts.text:
[Well-known Kittie]
Are you running away?!
No adventurer with a faint heart ever survived on the New Continent!
scripts.translation:
[有名的小猫]
你要逃跑吗？！
胆小的冒险者可没法在新大陆活下去！

scripts.text:
[Well-known Kittie]
Eliminate ^4d4dff3 Leaf Lunatics and 2 Grass Fabres^000000 swarming around here within ^4d4dff10 minutes^000000!
scripts.translation:
[有名的小猫]
^4d4dff在 10 分钟内^000000消灭这附近成群的^4d4dff3 只群叶疯兔和 2 只草地绿棉虫^000000！

scripts.text:
[Well-known Kittie]
Nyo-hoho!! Nyo-hoho!!
Was it too tough for you to handle?
What do you think? Want to give it another try?
scripts.translation:
[有名的小猫]
喵呵呵！喵呵呵！
这对你来说太难了吗？
怎么样，还想再试一次吗？

scripts.text:
[Well-known Kittie]
Was it too hard for you?
Are you using your ^4d4dffskills^000000 well while hunting?
scripts.translation:
[有名的小猫]
这对你来说太难了吗？
狩猎时有好好使用^4d4dff技能^000000吗？

scripts.text:
[Well-known Kittie]
You can ^4d4dffbring up the Skill Tree by pressing the [Alt+S] shortcut key or clicking the corresponding skill icon.^000000
scripts.translation:
[有名的小猫]
按快捷键 [Alt+S] 或点击对应的技能图标，就能^4d4dff打开技能树^000000。

scripts.text:
[Well-known Kittie]
Setup the skill you'd like to use so that you can use it while in battle.
scripts.translation:
[有名的小猫]
设置好想使用的技能，战斗时就能施放了。

scripts.text:
[Well-known Kittie]
^4d4dffSkills that are activated manually ^000000 can be ^4d4dffplaced on the quickbar^000000 for fast use.
scripts.translation:
[有名的小猫]
^4d4dff需要手动施放的技能^000000可以^4d4dff放到快捷栏^000000，方便快速使用。

scripts.text:
[Well-known Kittie]
...Now you know how to use skills.
So, what are you going to do?
scripts.translation:
[有名的小猫]
...现在你知道怎么使用技能了。
那么，接下来打算怎么办？

scripts.text: Try again.
scripts.translation: 再试一次

scripts.text: I'll quit right now!
scripts.translation: 我现在就放弃！

scripts.text:
[Well-known Kittie]
You have moxie and I like that!
Alright, then. Give it another go!
scripts.translation:
[有名的小猫]
你倒是挺有胆量，我喜欢！
好，那就再试一次！

scripts.text:
[Well-known Kittie]
How can you hope to survive the New Continent with that weak mindset?
Nyo-hoho! Nyo-hoho! I'm the strongest Doram in this domain!
scripts.translation:
[有名的小猫]
这么软弱，怎么能在新大陆活下去？
喵呵呵！喵呵呵！我是这片领地最强的多兰！

scripts.text:
[Well-known Kittie]
Hmm...You are good.
I feel challenged whenever I stumble upon a competent Doram such as you.
scripts.translation:
[有名的小猫]
嗯...你很厉害嘛。
每次遇到像你这样有本事的多兰，我都会觉得碰上了强劲的对手。

scripts.text:
[Well-known Kittie]
Time is already up! Nyo-hoho!!
So that again proves that I'm the best in this domain!
scripts.translation:
[有名的小猫]
时间到！喵呵呵！
这又证明了我才是这片领地最强的！

scripts.text:
[Well-known Kittie]
You finished the job on a high note so I'd like to help you in return.
scripts.translation:
[有名的小猫]
你漂亮地完成了任务，我也该回报你一下。

scripts.text:
[Well-known Kittie]
By the way, do you know what a ^4d4dffSkill Tree^000000 is?
Did I teach you about that?
Do you remember anything about it?
scripts.translation:
[有名的小猫]
对了，你知道什么是^4d4dff技能树^000000吗？
我教过你吗？
你还记得吗？

scripts.text:
[Well-known Kittie]
You can ^4d4dffbring up the Skill Tree by pressing the [Alt+S] shortcut key or clicking the corresponding skill icon.^000000
scripts.translation:
[有名的小猫]
按快捷键 [Alt+S] 或点击对应的技能图标，就能^4d4dff打开技能树^000000。

scripts.text:
[Well-known Kittie]
Setup the skill you'd like to use so that you can use it while in battle.
scripts.translation:
[有名的小猫]
设置好想使用的技能，战斗时就能施放了。

scripts.text:
[Well-known Kittie]
^4d4dffSkills that are activated manually ^000000 can be ^4d4dffplaced on the quickbar^000000 for fast use.
scripts.translation:
[有名的小猫]
^4d4dff需要手动施放的技能^000000可以^4d4dff放到快捷栏^000000，方便快速使用。

scripts.text:
[Well-known Kittie]
...Now you know how to use skills.
You should thank me. Nyo-hoho!
scripts.translation:
[有名的小猫]
...现在你知道怎么使用技能了。
记得感谢我哦，喵呵呵！

scripts.text:
[Well-known Kittie]
Do you need to be enlightened again?
scripts.translation:
[有名的小猫]
还要我再教你一次吗？

scripts.text:
[Well-known Kittie]
There's nothing special about life in this world.
You'd better make yourself familiar with the skill tree. It is accessed when you click the Skill icon.
scripts.translation:
[有名的小猫]
这个世界的生活没什么特别的。
最好熟悉一下技能树，点击技能图标就能打开。

scripts.text:
[Well-known Kittie]
Battle Dorams are specialized in summoning.
Focus on using the summoning skills so that you can win battles.
scripts.translation:
[有名的小猫]
战斗型多兰擅长召唤。
多使用召唤技能，就能赢得战斗。

scripts.text:
[Kitten]
This is it!!
scripts.translation:
[小猫]
就是这个！！

scripts.text: The kitten hoisted the box given to him up high, screaming out in joy
scripts.translation: 小猫把拿到的箱子高高举起，兴奋地欢呼起来。

scripts.text:
[Tool Merchant]
Wait. This box looks familiar...
Hey! Isn't this the box that I told you to deliver to Haru?
scripts.translation:
[道具商人]
等等，这个箱子看起来很眼熟...
嘿！这不是我让你送给哈鲁的箱子吗？

scripts.text:
[Kitten]
~Gulps~
I'm leaving! Right now!
Thank you for finding the box!
scripts.translation:
[小猫]
（咽了一口）
我走了！现在就走！
谢谢你帮我找回箱子！

scripts.text:
[Tool Merchant]
Anyway, thank you for finding the box.
If you have the time, sit down and talk with me.
scripts.translation:
[道具商人]
总之，谢谢你找回箱子。
有空的话，坐下来和我聊聊吧。

scripts.text:
[Kitten]
Why is he taking so long...?
I'm worried.
scripts.translation:
[小猫]
他怎么还没回来...？
我有点担心。

scripts.text: Is there anything that troubles you?
scripts.translation: 有什么事让你烦恼吗？

scripts.text:
[Kitten]
No, it's nothing.
I'm not one of the Dorams who would randomly give up on their errands!
scripts.translation:
[小猫]
没事。
我可不是那种会随便放弃跑腿差事的多兰！

scripts.text: The little Doram starts whining, secretly being conscious of the adult Doram next to him.
scripts.translation: 小多兰开始抱怨起来，还偷偷看了看身旁成年的多兰。

scripts.text:
[Kitten]
I was told you're headed to the New Continent.
I want to go there myself, too!
scripts.translation:
[小猫]
听说你们要去新大陆。
我也想亲自去看看！

scripts.text:
[Kitten]
This is it!!
scripts.translation:
[小猫]
就是这个！！

scripts.text: The kitten hoisted the box given to him up high, screaming out in joy
scripts.translation: 小猫把拿到的箱子高高举起，兴奋地欢呼起来。

scripts.text:
[Tool Merchant]
Wait. This box looks familiar...
Hey! Isn't this the box that I told you to deliver to Haru?
scripts.translation:
[道具商人]
等等，这个箱子看起来很眼熟...
嘿！这不是我让你送给哈鲁的箱子吗？

scripts.text:
[Kitten]
~Gulps~
I'm leaving! Right now!
Thank you for finding the box!
scripts.translation:
[小猫]
（咽了一口）
我走了！现在就走！
谢谢你帮我找回箱子！

scripts.text:
[Tool Merchant]
Anyway, thank you for finding the box.
If you have the time, sit down and talk with me.
scripts.translation:
[道具商人]
总之，谢谢你找回箱子。
有空的话，坐下来和我聊聊吧。

scripts.text:
- Hold on a second here!! -
- You have too many items. -
- That means you can no longer receive any items. -
- Free up some space -
- and try again. -
scripts.translation:
- 请稍等！ -
- 您的物品太多了。 -
- 已无法再领取物品。 -
- 请腾出一些空间 -
- 然后重试。 -

scripts.text:
[Tool Merchant]
You must be here to apply for the expedition to the New Continent.
It looks like my son caused some trouble for you.
Thank you for your help.
scripts.translation:
[道具商人]
您是来申请参加新大陆探险队的吧？
看来我儿子给您添麻烦了。
谢谢您帮忙。

scripts.text:
[Tool Merchant]
This is not much, but please take it. It's a token of my appreciation.
I also gave you ^4d4dffa new set of clothes^000000 so that you can change out of your dirty ones.
scripts.translation:
[道具商人]
礼物不贵重，请收下，聊表谢意。
我还给您们^4d4dff一套新衣服^000000，换下身上脏了的衣服吧。

scripts.text:
[Tool Merchant]
You can find other tool merchants like me in each village.
You can buy and sell the items through those merchants.
scripts.translation:
[道具商人]
每个村庄都有像我这样的道具商人。
您可以找我们买卖物品。

scripts.text:
[Tool Merchant]
Ask ^4d4dffHealer Haru about the Combination Kit^000000 and she'll help you use it effectively.
Just take this with you.
scripts.translation:
[道具商人]
向^4d4dff治疗师哈鲁请教组合专用工具的用法^000000，她会教您如何有效使用。
把这个带上吧。

scripts.text:
[Tool Merchant]
If you want to dispose of any items, you should see me.
Do you understand?
scripts.translation:
[道具商人]
想处理掉物品的话，就来找我。
明白了吗？

scripts.text:
[Tool Merchant]
^4d4dffHealer Haru's house^000000 is straight ^4d4dffto the east^000000 from here.
scripts.translation:
[道具商人]
^4d4dff治疗师哈鲁的家^000000就在这里^4d4dff正东方^000000。

scripts.text:
[Tool Merchant]
Plants and grasses are packed in front of her house because she's busy testing medicinal herbs.
^4d4dffIt's the house where lots of flowerpots are aligned.^000000 You can't miss it.
scripts.translation:
[道具商人]
她正忙着试验药草，所以家门口堆满了植物和草药。
^4d4dff那里摆着一排排花盆，很好认。^000000

scripts.text:
[Tool Merchant]
Haru is a very smart girl, so every sick person goes to her place.
scripts.translation:
[道具商人]
哈鲁很聪明，生病的人都会去找她。

scripts.text:
[Tool Merchant]
You're about to go on a journey and she's going to be a lot of help.
Be sure to meet her.
scripts.translation:
[道具商人]
您即将踏上旅程，她一定能帮上不少忙。
记得去见见她。

scripts.text:
[Tool Merchant]
^4d4dffHealer Haru's house^000000 is straight ^4d4dffto the east^000000 from here.
scripts.translation:
[道具商人]
^4d4dff治疗师哈鲁的家^000000就在这里^4d4dff正东方^000000。

scripts.text:
[Tool Merchant]
Plants and grasses are packed in front of her house because she's busy testing medicinal herbs.
^4d4dffIt's the house where lots of flowerpots are aligned.^000000 You can't miss it.
scripts.translation:
[道具商人]
她正忙着试验药草，所以家门前堆满了植物和草药。
^4d4dff她家门口摆着一排排花盆，很好辨认。^000000

scripts.text:
[Tool Merchant]
Is there anything you need?
scripts.translation:
[道具商人]
需要买点什么吗？

scripts.text:
[Tool Merchant]
Welcome.
scripts.translation:
[道具商人]
欢迎光临。

scripts.text: Buy an item.
scripts.translation: 购买物品

scripts.text: Sell your belongings.
scripts.translation: 出售物品

scripts.text:
[Tool Merchant]
Do you need anything? I have basic potions, traps, magnifiers...You name it!
scripts.translation:
[道具商人]
需要什么？基础药水、陷阱、放大镜...您要的我都有！

scripts.text:
[Tool Merchant]
Good thinking! I knew you would. you'd better sell away items that you no longer need!
scripts.translation:
[道具商人]
想得周到！我就知道您会这么做。最好把不需要的物品都卖掉！

scripts.text:
[Healer Haru]
I see a lot of out-of-towners these days.
What do you need?
scripts.translation:
[治疗师 哈鲁]
最近来了不少外地人。
您需要什么？

scripts.text:
[Healer Haru]
What's up?
scripts.translation:
[治疗师 哈鲁]
怎么了？

scripts.text:
[Healer Haru]
Oh, no...
It's going to be fine.
scripts.translation:
[治疗师 哈鲁]
哎呀...
没事的，会好起来的。

scripts.text:
[Healer Haru]
Oh, dear...
Does it hurt a lot?
You need 5,000 Zeny to heal it all. Do you want me to do it?
scripts.translation:
[治疗师 哈鲁]
哎呀...
很疼吗？
要彻底治好需要 5,000 Zeny。要我帮您治疗吗？

scripts.text: Say yes.
scripts.translation: 好

scripts.text: It's too expensive.
scripts.translation: 太贵了

scripts.text:
[Healer Haru]
Take your time and get some rest.
scripts.translation:
[治疗师 哈鲁]
不着急，先休息一会儿吧。

scripts.text:
[Healer Haru]
Thank you for using our service.
scripts.translation:
[治疗师 哈鲁]
感谢您使用我们的服务。

scripts.text:
[Healer Haru]
You already know what First Aid is...
Please. I don't have all day.
scripts.translation:
[治疗师 哈鲁]
你明明知道什么是紧急治疗...
拜托，我可没那么多时间。

scripts.text:
[Healer Haru]
Oh, you'd like to learn about First Aid! How admirable of you!
First Aid is a skill converting your SP into HP in an emergency.
scripts.translation:
[治疗师 哈鲁]
哦，您想了解紧急治疗啊！真有上进心！
这项技能能在紧急情况下消耗 SP 来恢复 HP。

scripts.text:
[Healer Haru]
The healing amount can be minimal...
But you can at least avoid getting stunned by a critical hit.
scripts.translation:
[治疗师 哈鲁]
恢复量可能不多...
但至少能避免被暴击击晕。

scripts.text:
[Healer Haru]
Click the ^4d4dffSkill^000000 button to open the Skill Window.
FYI, the shortcut key is ^4d4dffAlt+S^000000.
scripts.translation:
[治疗师 哈鲁]
点击^4d4dff“技能”^000000按钮，打开技能窗口。
快捷键是^4d4dffAlt+S^000000。

scripts.text:
[Healer Haru]
Well, then. I'll let you in on something juicy while I'm at it.
Press the ^4d4dffF12 key^000000, will you?
Surprise! It brings up the shortcut key window where nine small slots are arranged in a row.
scripts.translation:
[治疗师 哈鲁]
对了，顺便告诉您一个实用的小技巧。
按下^4d4dffF12 键^000000试试看。
看，快捷键窗口就会打开，里面一排有 9 个小格子。

scripts.text:
[Healer Haru]
Drag the corner area in the right-hand side of the shortcut key window to view other pages.
scripts.translation:
[治疗师 哈鲁]
拖动快捷键窗口右侧的边角，就能切换到其他页面。

scripts.text:
[Healer Haru]
It's easy to use. ^4d4dffEach slot corresponds to the keys from F1 through F9.^000000
Drag your skill or item to use in the slot and press the corresponding key to activate it instantly.
scripts.translation:
[治疗师 哈鲁]
使用方法很简单。^4d4dff每个格子对应 F1 到 F9^000000。
把技能或物品拖到格子里，再按对应按键即可立即使用。

scripts.text:
!- Notice -!
^4d4dffTo place an item or skill icon to use, drag it to the shortcut key slot.^000000
scripts.translation:
!- 告示 -!
^4d4dff要将物品或技能图标放入快捷栏，请把图标拖到对应的快捷键格子里。^000000

scripts.text:
!- Notice -!
^4d4dffTo use or equip an item or equipment registered in the slot, press the key that corresponds to each slot from F1 to F9.^000000
scripts.translation:
!- 告示 -!
^4d4dff要使用或装备快捷栏中登记的物品或装备，请按下对应格子的 F1 至 F9 按键。^000000

scripts.text:
!- Notice -!
^4d4dffIn the shortcut key settings, you can select the corresponding shortcut keys as you desire.^000000
scripts.translation:
!- 告示 -!
^4d4dff您可以在快捷键设置中自行选择合适的按键。^000000

scripts.text:
!- Notice -!
^4d4dffPlace an item and/or skill that you often use for quick usage.^000000
scripts.translation:
!- 告示 -!
^4d4dff把常用的物品或技能放进快捷栏，就能快速使用。^000000

scripts.text:
[Healer Haru]
Well, now. Open the Skill Window and place the First Aid skill in a shortcut key slot to use.
It's going to be a lot easier to use it.
scripts.translation:
[治疗师 哈鲁]
现在打开技能窗口，把紧急治疗拖到快捷键格子里试试。
这样用起来方便多了。

scripts.text:
[Healer Haru]
Oh, so you're here to learn the potion combination?
Then, you need a combination scroll first.
Above all, the most important out of all the combination items should be a potion.
scripts.translation:
[治疗师 哈鲁]
哦，您是来学药水合成的？
那得先准备一张合成卷轴。
合成材料里最重要的当然是药水。

scripts.text:
[Healer Haru]
Have you ever seen the grass growing in the field while you're traveling?
^4d4dffRed Grass, Blue Grass, Green Grass, White Grass...^000000etc...
scripts.translation:
[治疗师 哈鲁]
旅行途中有没有见过田野里长的草？
^4d4dff红草、蓝草、绿草、白草...^000000等等...

scripts.text:
[Healer Haru]
You can obtain herbs from these grasses.
Each herb is a good source to be processed into various kinds of medicine.
scripts.translation:
[治疗师 哈鲁]
这些草都能采到药草。
药草是制作各种药剂的好材料。

scripts.text:
[Healer Haru]
Red Herbs are running out.
I think you should go pick some now.
scripts.translation:
[治疗师 哈鲁]
红色药草快用完了。
您现在去采一些吧。

scripts.text:
[Healer Haru]
The herbs are growing in the entrance of the village. Did you see them?
^4d4dffGo and collect 1 Red Herb in the entrance of the village.^000000 This should be a good practice.
scripts.translation:
[治疗师 哈鲁]
村口长着药草，您看到了吗？
^4d4dff去村口采集 1 份红色药草。^000000正好可以练练手。

scripts.text:
[Healer Haru]
Come on. Hurry!
scripts.translation:
[治疗师 哈鲁]
快去吧，动作快点！

scripts.text:
- Hold on a second here!! -
- You have too many items. -
- That means you can no longer receive any items. -
- Free up some space -
- and try again. -
scripts.translation:
- 请稍等！ -
- 您的物品太多了。 -
- 已无法再领取物品。 -
- 请腾出一些空间 -
- 然后重试。 -

scripts.text:
[Healer Haru]
You've got them, perfect.
This ^4d4dffherb is effective even when eaten as it is, but, it is far more effective when it is made into a potion.^000000
scripts.translation:
[治疗师 哈鲁]
拿到了，很好。
这种^4d4dff药草直接吃也有效，不过制成药水效果会更好。^000000

scripts.text:
[Healer Haru]
Effects vary for the herbs, depending on their colors.
^4d4dffGreen Herbs are known for detoxification.^000000
^4d4dff Blue Herbs restore SP^000000.
scripts.translation:
[治疗师 哈鲁]
药草颜色不同，功效也不同。
^4d4dff绿色药草可以解毒。^000000
^4d4dff蓝色药草可以恢复 SP。^000000

scripts.text:
[Healer Haru]
Anything else?
Well, now. Your HP is being restored as the Red Herb does it's work.
Press juice out of it and put them in a bottle...
scripts.translation:
[治疗师 哈鲁]
还有什么问题吗？
红色药草正在发挥作用，您的 HP 已经开始恢复。
把药草榨出汁液，再装进瓶子里...

scripts.text:
[Healer Haru]
This is what we call a potion that you can take anytime, anywhere!
This is for you on this special encounter.
scripts.translation:
[治疗师 哈鲁]
这就是可以随时随地服用的药水！
就当作这次相逢的纪念，送给您吧。

scripts.text:
[Healer Haru]
Prepare the materials written in the combination scroll.
Then, ^4d4dffuse the Combination Kit or cooking utensils^000000 to make an item you want.
scripts.translation:
[治疗师 哈鲁]
准备好合成卷轴上列出的材料。
然后^4d4dff使用组合专用工具或烹饪工具^000000，制作您想要的物品。

scripts.text:
[Healer Haru]
You can also make various other types of tools, other than potions, with the materials you pick up, so use them well.
scripts.translation:
[治疗师 哈鲁]
除了药水，您也可以用采来的材料制作各种物品，好好利用它们吧。

scripts.text:
[Healer Haru]
I gave you Red Herbs and apples.
So give it a try and craft something with the Combination Kit.
scripts.translation:
[治疗师 哈鲁]
我给了您红色药草和苹果。
试着用组合专用工具做点东西吧。

scripts.text:
[Healer Haru]
Here's the directions. To read the combination scroll,
^4d4dffRight-click the scroll,^000000 and then, click the ^4d4dffbook-shaped icon^000000 found in the description window.
scripts.translation:
[治疗师 哈鲁]
阅读合成卷轴的方法如下：
^4d4dff右键点击卷轴，^000000再点击说明窗口中的^4d4dff书本形状图标^000000。

scripts.text:
[Healer Haru]
There is a place near the entrance of the village where herbs grow.
^4d4dffBeat the Red Grass and get 1 Red Herb^000000.
scripts.translation:
[治疗师 哈鲁]
村口附近有一片药草地。
^4d4dff击败红草，取得 1 份红色药草。^000000

scripts.text:
[Healer Haru]
You should know what the herbs look like.
scripts.translation:
[治疗师 哈鲁]
你应该认得这些药草了吧。

scripts.text:
[Healer Haru]
I've given you all the details about the basics of medicinal botany.
By the way, there is ^4d4dffShining Grass^000000 in this world.
scripts.translation:
[治疗师 哈鲁]
药用植物学的基础知识，我都告诉您了。
对了，这个世界上还有^4d4dff闪光草^000000。

scripts.text:
[Healer Haru]
You have no idea what kind of herb the Shining Grass will produce.
I was lucky enough to obtain Igdrasil's Fruit once.
scripts.translation:
[治疗师 哈鲁]
您不知道闪光草会长出什么药草。
我曾经有幸得到过一次伊格德拉西尔果实。

scripts.text:
[Healer Haru]
Rumor has it that, among humans, ^4d4dffAlchemist^000000, ^4d4dffCreator^000000, or the upper-level ^4d4dffGeneric^000000
are highly specialized in crafting potions.
scripts.translation:
[治疗师 哈鲁]
据说在人类中，^4d4dff炼金术士^000000、^4d4dff创造者^000000和高阶的^4d4dff基因学者^000000
都很擅长制作药水。

scripts.text:
[Healer Haru]
If you happen to meet a human in the Midgard Continent, why don't you ask them?
scripts.translation:
[治疗师 哈鲁]
如果您在米德加尔特大陆遇到人类，不妨问问他们。

scripts.text:
[Hypnotist]
Oh! So you're that famous human everyone is talking about!
But why is your hair uneven?
scripts.translation:
[催眠师]
哦！你就是大家都在谈论的那位有名的人类啊！
不过，你的头发怎么参差不齐？

scripts.text:
[Hypnotist]
Have you come down with a skin disease or something?
This healer next to me is really good. You should ask her to take a look at it!
scripts.translation:
[催眠师]
你是得了什么皮肤病吗？
我旁边这位治疗师很厉害，让她帮你看看吧！

scripts.text:
[Hypnotist]
You're really big and that type of poor hair just doesn't go well with you...
It must've been a lot of work.
scripts.translation:
[催眠师]
你个子真高，这种乱糟糟的发型可不适合你...
你一定费了不少工夫吧。

scripts.text:
[Hypnotist]
I'm casting hypnosis on the young lads for their future.
scripts.translation:
[催眠师]
我正在为年轻人施展催眠术，帮他们规划未来。

scripts.text:
[Hypnotist]
You must have been over with wandering by now.
scripts.translation:
[催眠师]
你应该已经逛得差不多了吧。

scripts.text:
[Hypnotist]
If you don't like a skill you just learned, I can reset it for you.
scripts.translation:
[催眠师]
如果不喜欢刚学会的技能，我可以帮你重置。

scripts.text:
[Hypnotist]
^4d4dffUp to level 49, your skills and status can be reset anytime you want.^000000
scripts.translation:
[催眠师]
^4d4dff49 级以前，您随时可以重置技能和属性。^000000

scripts.text: Reset the status.
scripts.translation: 重置属性

scripts.text: Reset the skill.
scripts.translation: 重置技能

scripts.text:
[Hypnotist]
Your items can be lost, so be sure to make yourself weigh ^FF00000^000000.
scripts.translation:
[催眠师]
物品可能会掉落，务必先将负重降到^FF00000^000000。

scripts.text:
[Hypnotist]
The Cat Paw Commerce Group is responsible for the warehouse, so leave your items to them.
scripts.translation:
[催眠师]
仓库由猫爪商会管理，请把物品存进仓库。

scripts.text:
[Hypnotist]
Your status has been reset successfully!
scripts.translation:
[催眠师]
属性已成功重置！

scripts.text:
[Hypnotist]
I don't do it for the experienced. So you should figure out your own status well beforehand.
scripts.translation:
[催眠师]
我不接待有经验的人，所以请事先了解自己的属性。

scripts.text:
[Hypnotist]
Your skill has been reset successfully!
scripts.translation:
[催眠师]
技能已成功重置！

scripts.text:
[Hypnotist]
I reset skills and statuses without charge only when your level stays at 49 or below.
Before that, I advise you to practice with many skills in diverse ways, to help you decide what you like.
scripts.translation:
[催眠师]
只有等级不超过 49 级时，我才会免费为您重置技能和属性。
在此之前，建议您多尝试不同的技能，找到自己喜欢的玩法。

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Aglio]
I was looking for you at the tool shop and they said you headed here.
scripts.translation:
[义警 阿利奥]
我去道具商店找您，他们说您往这边来了。

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Aglio]
First off, we should meet up with our leader to make decisions about the schedule.
We'd better head to the square.
scripts.translation:
[义警 阿利奥]
首先得和首领碰面，商量一下行程安排。
我们最好去广场。

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Aglio]
I think you can find another Vigilante like myself in the square...
scripts.translation:
[义警 阿利奥]
我想广场上应该能找到其他像我这样的义警...

scripts.text: Buy
scripts.translation: 购买

scripts.text: Sell
scripts.translation: 出售

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Con-Chliina Crewman]
From the continent of Midgard to Far-Star!
scripts.translation:
[康奇利娜号船员]
从米德加尔特大陆前往法尔斯塔尔！

scripts.text:
[Con-Chliina Crewman]
Only ^0000cd{0} Zenies^000000 to the port city Lasagna.
scripts.translation:
[康奇利娜号船员]
前往罗札纳港只需 ^0000cd{0} Zeny^000000。

scripts.text: To Lasagna - {0}z
scripts.translation: 前往罗札纳 - {0} Zeny

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Con-Chliina Crewman]
I see.
scripts.translation:
[康奇利娜号船员]
知道了。

scripts.text:
[Con-Chliina Crewman]
Not enough? How about checking how much he has?
scripts.translation:
[康奇利娜号船员]
钱不够吗？要不要先看看他有多少钱？

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Penne]
Hiya! Isn't it delightful to see the Farfalle Vigilante even here?
scripts.translation:
[义警 佩内]
嗨！没想到在这里也能见到法尔法莱义警，真让人高兴！

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Penne]
By the way, how's your settlement in this land coming along?
Have you been to ^4d4dffProntera^000000 or ^4d4dffPayon^000000 near here?
scripts.translation:
[义警 佩内]
对了，您在这片土地上安顿得如何？
去过附近的^4d4dff普隆德拉^000000或^4d4dff斐扬^000000吗？

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Penne]
There is a Paradise Group you might want to visit.
It doesn't hurt to go visit there.
scripts.translation:
[义警 佩内]
附近有乐园团，您或许会想去看看。
去一趟也没坏处。

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Penne]
Humans always intrigue me with their peculiar look.
Like a big, hairless cat!
scripts.translation:
[义警 佩内]
人类的长相总让我觉得新奇。
就像一只体型很大的无毛猫！

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Penne]
Me? Let me explain. I'm the proud member of the Farfalle Vigilante from the great Far-Star Continent.
scripts.translation:
[义警 佩内]
我？让我来介绍一下。我是来自伟大的法尔斯塔尔大陆、法尔法莱义警团的一员，深感自豪。

scripts.text: Far-Star Continent?
scripts.translation: 法尔斯塔尔大陆？

scripts.text: Farfalle Vigilante?
scripts.translation: 法尔法莱义警团？

scripts.text: Are you from the Cat Paw Commerce Group?
scripts.translation: 你是猫爪商会的人吗？

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Penne]
There are more continents other than Midgard.
The land we crossed from is called Far-Star.
scripts.translation:
[义警 佩内]
米德加尔特之外还有其他大陆。
我们跨越而来的那片土地叫法尔斯塔尔。

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Penne]
Well, we're no different because we thought there was only the Far-Star Continent under the sun.
The world sure is wide...
scripts.translation:
[义警 佩内]
其实我们也一样，曾以为天下只有法尔斯塔尔大陆。
世界真是辽阔啊...

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Penne]
So, do you see this ribbon that goes perfectly well with this cool uniform?
(Show the below-neck area.)
scripts.translation:
[义警 佩内]
您看这条丝带，和这身帅气的制服很相配吧？
（指向脖子下方。）

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Penne]
This is the symbol of our Farfalle Vigilante.
We are the legendary Vigilante Corp that protects Lasagna!
scripts.translation:
[义警 佩内]
这是法尔法莱义警团的标志。
我们是守护罗札纳的传奇义警团！

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Penne]
You have no idea how cool our leader Peperoncino can be...
We do all kinds of chores from handling the urchins at the port to maintaining the security of the village.
scripts.translation:
[义警 佩内]
您可不知道我们的首领佩佩龙奇诺有多帅...
从整治港口的捣蛋鬼到维护村庄治安，各种杂事都由我们负责。

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Penne]
Moreover, you can come to this...Mid...Midgur...Midgar...
Anyway! You're allowed to come here only when the Farfalle Vigilante accepts.
scripts.translation:
[义警 佩内]
而且，您还能来到这...米德...米德加...米德加尔特...
总之，只有获得法尔法莱义警团的许可，您才能来这里。

scripts.text: This proud cat is getting really talkative...
scripts.translation: 这只骄傲的猫真是越来越健谈了...

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Penne]
No, That's not it!!
The Cat Paw Commerce Group is led by Captain Tomei-Tomas!
scripts.translation:
[义警 佩内]
不，不是那样的！！
猫爪商会的首领是船长托梅·托马斯！

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Penne]
I'm with the Farfalle Vigilante commanded by Leader Peperoncino!
scripts.translation:
[义警 佩内]
我属于佩佩龙奇诺首领带领的法尔法莱义警团！

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Penne]
Oh, my days! So you haven't even been to Lasagna, have you?
Our great Captain Gamberri ventured here in person!
scripts.translation:
[义警 佩内]
天哪！看来您连罗札纳都没去过吧？
我们伟大的甘贝里船长可是亲自来过这里！

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Penne]
We are gracious enough to give humans like you a chance to go to the land of Lasagna.
Before long, this Midgur...Midgarr...?? This land will soon be controlled by us, the Dorams!
scripts.translation:
[义警 佩内]
我们大发慈悲，才让你们人类有机会前往罗札纳。
用不了多久，这片米德...米德加...？这片土地就会由我们多兰人统治！

scripts.text:
[Vigilante Penne]
You'd better earn our favor. If you do, we might give you a job to clean anchovies in Lasagna!
scripts.translation:
[义警 佩内]
最好讨我们欢心。表现好的话，说不定能得到一份在罗札纳清洗鳀鱼的工作！

scripts.text:
[Mustachi]
We trim your beards. We comb your tails. Be sure to groom yourselves before setting out to the new world.
There's a hair designer in downtown, so make sure you drop by.
scripts.translation:
[穆斯塔奇]
我们可以帮您修剪胡须、梳理尾巴。前往新世界之前，记得打理好仪容。
市中心有位发型设计师，记得去找她。

scripts.text:
[Linguina]
This is a pub but also an adventurers' club where adventurers stop by. They come from all over the place and share their stories as well as find companions for adventures.
scripts.translation:
[林圭娜]
这里既是酒馆，也是冒险者俱乐部。来自各地的冒险者会在这里歇脚、分享见闻，寻找同行伙伴。

scripts.text:
[Linguina]
These days, many people come to seek information before heading off to the new world.
scripts.translation:
[林圭娜]
最近有很多人在前往新世界之前，来这里打听消息。

scripts.text:
[Linguina]
About ten years ago, it was a conciliating place to rehab hoodlum dorams and recruit them as vigilantes. Before that, rough sailors came to relax after a hard day's work.
scripts.translation:
[林圭娜]
大约十年前，这里曾用来感化惹事生非的多兰，并招募他们加入义警团。
在那之前，辛苦工作一天的水手们常来这里放松。

scripts.text:
[Linguina]
Chief Peperoncino and Captain Gamberry first met here as well. The three became sworn brothers and became legends after their endeavors proved to be successful.
scripts.translation:
[林圭娜]
佩佩龙奇诺首领和甘贝里船长也是在这里初次相遇的。三人结为异姓兄弟，后来事业有成，成了传奇人物。

scripts.text:
[Linguina]
So people who wish to succeed or adventurers who wish to become just like them come here a lot.
scripts.translation:
[林圭娜]
因此，渴望成功的人，以及想成为他们那样的冒险者，都常来这里。

scripts.text:
[Vongolo]
Did you decide what you'll have?
scripts.translation:
[冯戈洛]
您决定好要点什么了吗？

scripts.text:
[Vongolo]
Everyone orders kaluna milk here because of the oven resolution by Peperoncino, Gamberry, and Thomas. But Pub-Oven's real specialty menu is the fish cake.
scripts.translation:
[冯戈洛]
自从佩佩龙奇诺、甘贝里和托马斯定下规矩后，大家来这里都会点卡鲁纳牛奶。不过酒馆烤箱真正的招牌菜是鱼糕。

scripts.text:
[Vongolo]
Fish cake is a white fish fillet mashed with boiled beans that is shaped and fried. It's really delicious but no one asks for it.
scripts.translation:
[冯戈洛]
鱼糕是把白身鱼肉和煮熟的豆子捣碎混合，塑形后再油炸而成。味道很好，却没人点。

scripts.text:
[Vongolo]
So we don't even have the ingredients prepared these days. When there's an order once in a while, we run to the fish store to buy a cod and start cooking then.
scripts.translation:
[冯戈洛]
所以最近连食材都没准备。偶尔有人点单，我们才跑去鱼店买鳕鱼，现做一份。

scripts.text:
[Vongolo]
Oh, It's really good...
scripts.translation:
[冯戈洛]
哦...味道真不错...

scripts.text:
[Property Cat]
Every life in this world comes with a property.
There are numerous kinds of elements from neutral to four major natural elements, alongside the holy and dark elements.
scripts.translation:
[属性猫]
这个世界上的每个生命都有自己的属性。
属性种类繁多，除了无属性和四大自然属性，还有圣属性与暗属性。

scripts.text:
[Property Cat]
Most representative elements are the natural ones.
Put simply, these are the elements of Water, Wind, Earth, and Fire.
Besides, there are elements of Undead, Holiness and Darkness.
scripts.translation:
[属性猫]
最常见的是自然属性。
简单来说，就是水、风、地、火四种属性。
此外还有不死、圣和暗属性。

scripts.text:
[Property Cat]
Each element is intertwined with each other. So be smart and use the opposing elements.
scripts.translation:
[属性猫]
各种属性彼此相克，善用克制对手的属性吧。

scripts.text:
[Property Cat]
That way, you can get the upper hand of a battle.
Let me give you a brief example on their correlation.
scripts.translation:
[属性猫]
这样就能在战斗中占得上风。
我简单说明一下属性之间的关系。

scripts.text:
[Property Cat]
Fire element is highly resistant to Earth element.
Meanwhile, Earth element definitely outperforms Wind element.
scripts.translation:
[属性猫]
火属性对地属性有很强的抗性。
而地属性又明显克制风属性。

scripts.text:
[Property Cat]
Wind element beats Water element.
Yet, Water element defeats Fire element.
scripts.translation:
[属性猫]
风属性克制水属性，
水属性则克制火属性。

scripts.text:
[Property Cat]
Holy element and Dark element directly oppose each other, and you should keep that in mind.
scripts.translation:
[属性猫]
圣属性和暗属性彼此相克，请记住这一点。

scripts.text:
[Property Cat]
Other than that, there are also Neutral and Undead elements. You'll soon know what they are about.
You will have to see it for yourself.
scripts.translation:
[属性猫]
除此之外，还有无属性和不死属性。
之后您就会慢慢了解，亲自体验一下吧。

scripts.text:
- Hold on a second here!! -
- You have too many items. -
- That means you can no longer receive any items. -
- Free up some space -
- and try again. -
scripts.translation:
- 请稍等！ -
- 您的物品太多了。 -
- 已无法再领取物品。 -
- 请腾出一些空间 -
- 然后重试。 -

scripts.text:
[Cat Paw Commerce Group]
Hey, little fellow!
Are you headed to the Midgard Continent?
Then, you'd better listen to me!
scripts.translation:
[猫爪商会]
嘿，小家伙！
您要去米德加尔特大陆吗？
那可得听我说几句！

scripts.text:
[Cat Paw Commerce Group]
Like our Cat Paw Commerce Group, there are other groups who provide the ^4d4dffLocation sharing service^000000 and the ^4d4dffWarehouse service^000000.
scripts.translation:
[猫爪商会]
除了我们猫爪商会，还有其他组织提供^4d4dff存档服务^000000和^4d4dff仓库服务^000000。

scripts.text:
[Cat Paw Commerce Group]
They are: ^4d4dffKafra^000000 and ^4d4dffZonda^000000.
Of course, don't forget about the Cat Paw Commerce Group!
scripts.translation:
[猫爪商会]
它们就是^4d4dff卡普拉^000000和^4d4dff宗达^000000。
当然，也别忘了猫爪商会！

scripts.text:
[Cat Paw Commerce Group]
^4d4dffLocation sharing^000000 is to save the location for you to return to.
If you fall down due to fatigue during an adventure, you should return to the village. That's what you can do with this service.
scripts.translation:
[猫爪商会]
^4d4dff存档服务^000000可以为您保存位置，方便您之后返回。
如果您在冒险中累倒了，可以通过这项服务返回村庄。

scripts.text:
[Cat Paw Commerce Group]
Use the ^4d4dffButterfly Wings^000000 item to fly straight to that location.
scripts.translation:
[猫爪商会]
使用^4d4dff蝴蝶翅膀^000000道具，就能直接传送到已保存的位置。

scripts.text:
[Cat Paw Commerce Group]
Most of the locations shared are the safe village or city.
scripts.translation:
[猫爪商会]
大多数存档地点都是安全的村庄或城镇。

scripts.text:
[Cat Paw Commerce Group]
The ^4d4dffWarehouse service^000000 is also similar.
You pay a little service fee to deposit your items safely.
scripts.translation:
[猫爪商会]
^4d4dff仓库服务^000000也差不多。
只需支付少量费用，就能安全存放物品。

scripts.text:
[Cat Paw Commerce Group]
You can't just carry around every item with you, can you?
This is where the warehouse comes in handy.
scripts.translation:
[猫爪商会]
您总不能把所有物品都带在身上吧？
这时候仓库就派上用场了。

scripts.text:
[Cat Paw Commerce Group]
You can deposit and take out your item in the warehouse anytime, anywhere if you pay the service fee!
Now do you get it?
scripts.translation:
[猫爪商会]
支付服务费后，您就能随时随地存取仓库里的物品！
明白了吗？

scripts.text:
[Cat Paw Commerce Group]
Oh, do you want me to explain it again?
scripts.translation:
[猫爪商会]
哦，要我再解释一遍吗？

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不用

scripts.text: Please.
scripts.translation: 请再说一遍

scripts.text:
[Cat Paw Commerce Group]
Like our Cat Paw Commerce Group, there are other groups who provide the ^4d4dffLocation sharing service^000000 and the ^4d4dffWarehouse service^000000.
scripts.translation:
[猫爪商会]
除了我们猫爪商会，还有其他组织提供^4d4dff存档服务^000000和^4d4dff仓库服务^000000。

scripts.text:
[Cat Paw Commerce Group]
They are: ^4d4dffKafra^000000 and ^4d4dffZonda^000000.
Of course, don't forget about the Cat Paw Commerce Group!
scripts.translation:
[猫爪商会]
它们就是^4d4dff卡普拉^000000和^4d4dff宗达^000000。
当然，也别忘了猫爪商会！

scripts.text:
[Cat Paw Commerce Group]
^4d4dffLocation sharing^000000 is to save the location for you to return to.
If you fall down due to fatigue during an adventure, you should return to the village. That's what you can do with this service.
scripts.translation:
[猫爪商会]
^4d4dff存档服务^000000可以帮您保存地点，以便之后返回。
如果您在冒险途中累倒了，就能用这项服务回到村庄。

scripts.text:
[Cat Paw Commerce Group]
Use the ^4d4dffButterfly Wings^000000 item to fly straight to that location.
scripts.translation:
[猫爪商会]
使用^4d4dff蝴蝶翅膀^000000，便可直接传送到存档地点。

scripts.text:
[Cat Paw Commerce Group]
Most of the locations shared are the safe village or city.
scripts.translation:
[猫爪商会]
大多数存档地点都是安全的村庄或城镇。

scripts.text:
[Cat Paw Commerce Group]
The ^4d4dffWarehouse service^000000 is also similar.
You pay a little service fee to deposit your items safely.
scripts.translation:
[猫爪商会]
^4d4dff仓库服务^000000也差不多。
只需支付少量费用，就能安全存放物品。

scripts.text:
[Cat Paw Commerce Group]
You can't just carry around every item with you, can you?
This is where the warehouse comes in handy.
scripts.translation:
[猫爪商会]
您总不能把所有物品都带在身上吧？
这时候仓库就派上用场了。

scripts.text:
[Cat Paw Commerce Group]
You can deposit and take out your item in the warehouse anytime, anywhere if you pay the service fee!
Now do you get it?
scripts.translation:
[猫爪商会]
支付服务费后，您就能随时随地存取仓库里的物品！
明白了吗？

scripts.text:
[Cat Paw Commerce Group]
Then, what do you want me to help you with?
scripts.translation:
[猫爪商会]
那么，您想让我帮什么忙？

scripts.text:
[Cat Paw Commerce Group]
Come on! Welcome!
What do you want me to help you?
scripts.translation:
[猫爪商会]
欢迎光临！
需要我帮您做什么？

scripts.text: Location sharing service
scripts.translation: 存档服务

scripts.text: Warehouse service
scripts.translation: 仓库服务

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出

scripts.text:
[Cat Paw Commerce Group]
Saved, meow!
scripts.translation:
[猫爪商会]
存好了，喵！

scripts.text:
[Cat Paw Commerce Group]
I'm sorry, but...
You should learn the new basic skill first.
Go and learn the skill if you want to use the warehouse.
scripts.translation:
[猫爪商会]
抱歉...
请先学会新手基本技能。
想使用仓库的话，请先去学习这项技能。

scripts.text:
[Cat Paw Commerce Group]
I'm sorry, but...
You should learn some basic skills first if you want to use the warehouse.
Go and learn the skills until you reach the level to use the warehouse.
I believe it should be ^4d4dffbasic level 6^000000 for humans.
scripts.translation:
[猫爪商会]
抱歉...
使用仓库前，您得先学会一些基本技能。
请把技能练到可以使用仓库的等级。
人类大概要达到^4d4dff基本技能 6 级^000000。

scripts.text:
[Cat Paw Commerce Group]
If you don't have cheese, I'll gladly take Zeny.
The Warehouse Service costs 50 Zeny.
scripts.translation:
[猫爪商会]
没有奶酪的话，我也很乐意收 Zeny。
仓库服务费是 50 Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Cat Paw Commerce Group]
I'll get the warehouse open.
Come back again!
scripts.translation:
[猫爪商会]
我这就为您打开仓库。
欢迎再来！

scripts.text:
[Cat Paw Commerce Group]
Come again then.
scripts.translation:
[猫爪商会]
下次再来吧。

scripts.text:
[Recruiter]
Go for a chance to win a cruise trip and annual salary of one hundred million with a price of three anchovies! Chances are in favor of those who don't doubt!
scripts.translation:
[招募员]
只要付三条鳀鱼，就有机会赢得邮轮之旅和年薪一亿的工作！别怀疑，机会可就在眼前！

scripts.text:
[Gomae]
Vigilantes! Over here! there's someone here tricking people to get on board!
scripts.translation:
[戈梅]
义警！快来这边！有人在这里骗人上船！

scripts.text:
[Recruiter]
Blah! No luck here!
scripts.translation:
[招募员]
啧！看来这儿没戏！

scripts.text:
[Boarding Attendant]
We wish you a pleasant day on Con-Chliina!
scripts.translation:
[登船员]
祝您在康奇利娜号上度过愉快的一天！

scripts.text:
[Boarding Attendant]
Hello, adventurer!
scripts.translation:
[登船员]
您好，冒险者！

scripts.text:
[Boarding Attendant]
I assist those who finished their training from Farfalle Vigilantes with boarding on Con-Chliina.
scripts.translation:
[登船员]
我负责协助完成法尔法莱义警团训练的人登上康奇利娜号。

scripts.text:
[Boarding Attendant]
Those heading to the new world should follow the red yarn and go to the ^0000cddock^000000.
scripts.translation:
[登船员]
要前往新世界，请沿着红线前往^0000cd码头^000000。

scripts.text:
[Boarding Attendant]
Please check to see if you have the boarding pass with you before boarding!
scripts.translation:
[登船员]
登船前请确认您带好了船票！

scripts.text:
[Kittie]
^4d4dffPress the F12 key and it will bring up the shortcut key slots.^000000
scripts.translation:
[小猫]
^4d4dff按 F12 键即可打开快捷键栏。^000000

scripts.text:
!- Notice -!
^4d4dffTo prepare an item or skill icon to use, drag it to the shortcut key slot.
scripts.translation:
!- 告示 -!
^4d4dff将物品或技能图标拖到快捷键格子里，即可放入快捷栏。

scripts.text:
!- Notice -!
^4d4dffTo use or equip an item or equipment registered in the slot, press the key that corresponds to each slot from F1 to F9.
scripts.translation:
!- 告示 -!
^4d4dff要使用或装备快捷栏中登记的物品，请按下对应格子的 F1 至 F9 按键。

scripts.text:
!- Notice -!
^4d4dffIn the shortcut key settings, you can select the corresponding shortcut key as you desire.
scripts.translation:
!- 告示 -!
^4d4dff您可以在快捷键设置中自行选择合适的快捷键。

scripts.text:
!- Notice -!
^4d4dffPrepare an item and/or skill that you often use for faster use.
scripts.translation:
!- 告示 -!
^4d4dff把常用的物品或技能放进快捷栏，就能更快使用。

scripts.text:
[Meow goon]
If you run into a problem, ask them for help. You know, the twins in the vigilante corps. Aglio... Ali... Ol...
scripts.translation:
[喵喽啰]
遇到麻烦的话，就找他们帮忙。就是义警团里的那对双胞胎，阿利奥...阿利...奥利...

scripts.text:
[Meow goon]
Right! They're Aglio and Oligo!
scripts.translation:
[喵喽啰]
对！他们叫阿利奥和奥利戈！

scripts.text:
[Goon meow]
Hey, That's not it... No...
scripts.translation:
[喽啰喵]
喂，不是这样...不对...

scripts.text:
[Meow goon]
No?
scripts.translation:
[喵喽啰]
不对？

scripts.text:
[Goon meow]
They're Aglio and Olio. Not Aglio and Oligo. You made them sound like a sugar.
scripts.translation:
[喽啰喵]
他们叫阿利奥和奥利奥，不是阿利奥和奥利戈。你把他们说得像糖果一样。

scripts.text:
[Meow goon]
Whichever.
scripts.translation:
[喵喽啰]
随便啦。

scripts.text:
[Goon meow]
It's dangerous to put yourself out into the world. Take these tri-colored anchovies.
scripts.translation:
[喽啰喵]
独自闯荡世界很危险。拿着这些三色鳀鱼吧。

scripts.text:
[Meow goon]
Everyone keep away! I'm dangerous. Krahh! How long can the tri-colored anchovies hold off?!
scripts.translation:
[喵喽啰]
大家都离我远点！我很危险。喵啊！三色鳀鱼能挡住它们多久？！

scripts.text:
[Goon meow]
I'm... finished... You go ahead...
scripts.translation:
[喽啰喵]
我...不行了...你先走...

scripts.text:
[Meow goon]
Kah... The poltergeist that had been sleeping inside my bag is raging!
scripts.translation:
[喵喽啰]
嘎...一直睡在我包里的恶灵发狂了！

scripts.text:
[Goon meow]
Good! This should be enough to keep me from getting snubbed in the new world.
scripts.translation:
[喵喽啰]
太好了！这样到了新世界，我就不会被人冷落了。

scripts.text:
[Fettuccina]
I've worked here for a while, but I'm still the youngest so I do all the dishes.
scripts.translation:
[费图奇娜]
我在这里工作有一阵子了，但还是年纪最小，所以所有碗都归我洗。

scripts.text:
[Fettuccina]
A glass before sailing out, a glass on land after a long voyage, a glass for everyone who came from out of town to make an oven resolution, a glass for every regular customers, a glass for everyone who drinks because others drink it..
scripts.translation:
[费图奇娜]
出海前喝一杯，长途航行回来上岸后喝一杯；外地人来参加烤箱决议，人人都要喝一杯；每位熟客喝一杯，就连看别人喝也跟着喝的人也要来一杯...

scripts.text:
[Fettuccina]
So basically, It's beyond your imagination how many glasses I have to wash each day. Not only that, I have to listen to vigilance corps and merchants' low-ranking dorams whine, and counsel rookie adventurers.
scripts.translation:
[费图奇娜]
所以，我每天要洗多少杯子，简直多得数不清。不仅如此，我还得听义警团和商人手下的低阶多兰抱怨，还要劝导新手冒险者。

scripts.text:
[Fettuccina]
Really, 24 hours are too short. We should hire one more person!
scripts.translation:
[费图奇娜]
一天只有 24 小时，实在不够用。我们应该再雇一个人！

scripts.text:
- Hold on a second here!! -
- You have too many items. -
- That means you can no longer receive any items. -
- Free up some space -
- and try again. -
scripts.translation:
- 请稍等！ -
- 您的物品太多了。 -
- 已无法再领取物品。 -
- 请腾出一些空间 -
- 然后重试。 -

scripts.text:
[Yota Chara]
Father, mother. Please come back home safely.
(He's making something, mumbling.)
scripts.translation:
[约塔·查拉]
爸爸，妈妈，请平安回家。
（他一边嘟囔，一边忙着做东西。）

scripts.text: Craft Amulet
scripts.translation: 制作护身符

scripts.text: About the Family
scripts.translation: 关于家人

scripts.text:
[Yota Chara]
...My parents keep going out into the dangerous areas. I'm still a child to help them, so what I do is to make these amulets for them.
scripts.translation:
[约塔·查拉]
...爸妈总是去危险的地方。我还小，帮不上他们什么忙，只能做些护身符，希望他们平安。

scripts.text:
[Yota Chara]
What if some bad news reach us even if I try hard making these amulets for their safety?
scripts.translation:
[约塔·查拉]
就算我努力做护身符保佑他们平安，要是还是传来坏消息，该怎么办？

scripts.text:
[Yota Chara]
I get startled each time some mail arrives...
scripts.translation:
[约塔·查拉]
每次有人寄信来，我都会吓一跳...

scripts.text:
[Dandi Chara]
Whatever happened to our parents? ~Bursting into crying~
scripts.translation:
[丹迪·查拉]
爸爸妈妈到底怎么了？（放声大哭）

scripts.text:
[Jogi Chara]
Well, then. I'll be your dad!!
scripts.translation:
[乔吉·查拉]
好了，我来当你们的爸爸！

scripts.text:
[Dandi Chara]
~Keeps crying uncontrollably~ No way!! Mom!! Dad!!
scripts.translation:
[丹迪·查拉]
（哭个不停）才不要！！妈妈！！爸爸！！

scripts.text:
[Goma Chara]
Both will be totally fine and return to us soon. So quit it! Did you really have to make him cry, huh?!
scripts.translation:
[戈马·查拉]
他们肯定没事，很快就会回来的。别哭了！你干吗非把他惹哭啊？！

scripts.text: - Yota became disheartened and started making another amulet, quietly. -
scripts.translation: - 约塔有些沮丧，默默地开始制作另一个护身符。 -

scripts.text:
[Yota Chara]
...Do you have someone you're close to and whom you wish for their wellness?
If you want an amulet, you can exchange it with the Doram tokens. I have a bunch of amulets with me.
scripts.translation:
[约塔·查拉]
...您有亲近的人，也希望他们平安吗？
想要护身符的话，可以用喵族信物来换。我这里有很多。

scripts.text: Low-grade Horse Mackerel Amulet
scripts.translation: 低级竹荚鱼护身符

scripts.text: Low-grade Leaf Amulet
scripts.translation: 低级树叶护身符

scripts.text: Low-grade Rabbit Amulet
scripts.translation: 低级兔子护身符

scripts.text: Shining Twig Charm
scripts.translation: 闪亮树枝护符

scripts.text: Fresh Tuna Amulet
scripts.translation: 新鲜金枪鱼护身符

scripts.text: Plump Earthworm Amulet
scripts.translation: 肥美蚯蚓护身符

scripts.text:
[Yota Chara]
Will you exchange it for {0} {1}?
scripts.translation:
[约塔·查拉]
您要用 {0} 个 {1} 来交换吗？

scripts.text:
[Yota Chara]
{0} is for my father who is far out to the sea.
Will you exchange it for {1} {2}?
scripts.translation:
[约塔·查拉]
{0} 是送给远在海上的爸爸的。
您要用 {1} 个 {2} 来交换吗？

scripts.text:
[Yota Chara]
{0} is for my mother who should be wandering about the deep side of the forest.
Will you exchange it for {1} {2}?
scripts.translation:
[约塔·查拉]
{0} 是送给在森林深处四处游历的妈妈的。
您要用 {1} 个 {2} 来交换吗？

scripts.text:
[Yota Chara]
{0} is for my brothers' health and wellness.
Will you exchange it for {1} {2}?
scripts.translation:
[约塔·查拉]
{0} 是为哥哥们祈求健康平安的。
您要用 {1} 个 {2} 来交换吗？

scripts.text:
[Yota Chara]
{0} is to wish for my mother to return home safely from anywhere in the world.
Will you exchange it for {1} {2}?
scripts.translation:
[约塔·查拉]
{0} 是祈愿妈妈无论身在何处，都能平安回家。
您要用 {1} 个 {2} 来交换吗？

scripts.text:
[Yota Chara]
{0} is to wish for my father to return home quick with his ship full of tunas.
Will you exchange it for {1} {2}?
scripts.translation:
[约塔·查拉]
{0} 是祈愿爸爸满载金枪鱼，早日回家。
您要用 {1} 个 {2} 来交换吗？

scripts.text:
[Yota Chara]
{0} is to wish for easy fishing so that my family won't be starved.
Will you exchange it for {1} {2}?
scripts.translation:
[约塔·查拉]
{0} 是祈愿捕鱼顺利，让家人不再挨饿。
您要用 {1} 个 {2} 来交换吗？

scripts.text: Exchange
scripts.translation: 交换

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Yota Chara]
Did...did I misspeak, or what?
I'm not an expert but I did my best.
scripts.translation:
[约塔·查拉]
我...我是不是说错什么了？
虽然我不是行家，但已经尽力了。

scripts.text:
[Yota Chara]
I'm sorry. My sister will get pretty mad if I don't sell it for the proper money. Will you come back with 10 Doram Tokens?
scripts.translation:
[约塔·查拉]
抱歉。如果卖得太便宜，姐姐会生气的。您能带 10 个喵族信物再来吗？

scripts.text:
[Yota Chara]
Thanks you. I hope my amulet will be of good use to you...
scripts.translation:
[约塔·查拉]
谢谢您，希望这个护身符能帮上忙...

scripts.text:
- Hold on a second here!! -
- You have too many items. -
- That means you can no longer receive any items. -
- Free up some space -
- and try again. -
scripts.translation:
- 请稍等！ -
- 您的物品太多了。 -
- 已无法再领取物品。 -
- 请腾出一些空间 -
- 然后重试。 -

scripts.text:
[Jogi Chara]
~Whirring~
Here is Jogi, the bomber from Lasagna!
Drop your weapons and surrender!
scripts.translation:
[乔吉·查拉]
（嗡鸣声）
罗札纳的轰炸手乔吉登场！
放下武器，投降吧！

scripts.text: Act as if you surrender.
scripts.translation: 假装投降

scripts.text: Ignore him.
scripts.translation: 不理他

scripts.text:
[Jogi Chara]
~Makes a whiffing sound~
~Thumping sound~
Huh? Where do you think you're going?
scripts.translation:
[乔吉·查拉]
（呼啸声）
（砰的一声）
咦？你要去哪儿？

scripts.text:
[Jogi Chara]
Wahaha! Another victory for me! What a rewarding day!
What should we do next?
scripts.translation:
[乔吉·查拉]
哇哈哈！我又赢了！今天真是大丰收！
接下来做什么好呢？

scripts.text: Exchange tokens for a weapon.
scripts.translation: 用信物兑换武器

scripts.text: About the Family
scripts.translation: 关于家人

scripts.text:
[Jogi Chara]
My sister told me my parents are warriors! They left for a huge adventure!!
scripts.translation:
[乔吉·查拉]
姐姐说，爸妈都是战士！他们去参加一场大冒险了！！

scripts.text:
[Jogi Chara]
I'll join the Militia and become great like my parents!
I'm still too young to join the Militia, but, I'm positive that I can be the ace of the band once I join it because I'm committed to training myself.
scripts.translation:
[乔吉·查拉]
我要加入民兵，像爸妈一样成为强者！
我现在还太小，不能加入民兵。不过只要坚持训练，等加入后我一定能成为队里的王牌。

scripts.text:
[Jogi Chara]
My family members are very lazy. Unless I train them based on my strong belief, they can never become warriors.
Most notoriously, my elder and younger brother can be a real pain in my neck!
scripts.translation:
[乔吉·查拉]
我的家人都很懒。要是不按我的坚定信念好好训练，他们永远成不了战士。
尤其是我的哥哥和弟弟，最让我头疼了！

scripts.text:
[Jogi Chara]
Dandi! Today's training is to <put 10 earthworms on the head!> Get over here!
scripts.translation:
[乔吉·查拉]
丹迪！今天的训练是<把 10 条蚯蚓放在头上！>快过来！

scripts.text:
[Dandi Chara]
~Bursting into crying~ Goma Chara!!
scripts.translation:
[丹迪·查拉]
（放声大哭）戈马·查拉！！

scripts.text:
[Jogi Chara]
Whoa, a new weapon! New power!
What are you going to give me? Do you have a lot of weapons? Can I search into them? Will you exchange it for {0}?
scripts.translation:
[乔吉·查拉]
哇，新武器！新的力量！
你要给我什么？你有很多武器吗？我能翻翻看吗？你愿意用 {0} 跟我交换吗？

scripts.text: Search
scripts.translation: 查看

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Jogi Chara]
That's it?
scripts.translation:
[乔吉·查拉]
就这些？

scripts.text: Search again.
scripts.translation: 再找找

scripts.text: Stop.
scripts.translation: 不找了

scripts.text:
[Jogi Chara]
Whoa! This is ^3131FF{0}^000000!
Exchange it for {1} {2}! Please? Will you do it, please?
scripts.translation:
[乔吉·查拉]
哇！这是^3131FF{0}^000000！
用 {1} 个 {2} 跟我交换吧！求你了！可以吗？拜托了！

scripts.text: Exchange
scripts.translation: 交换

scripts.text: Quit exchanging
scripts.translation: 停止交换

scripts.text:
[Jogi Chara]
~Giggles~ We should see each other more often!
scripts.translation:
[乔吉·查拉]
（咯咯笑）以后要常来找我玩哦！

scripts.text:
[Jogi Chara]
Yay!! Thanks a mil!
Can I look for something else?
scripts.translation:
[乔吉·查拉]
太好了！！太感谢你了！
我还能再找找别的吗？

scripts.text:
[Jogi Chara]
~Scoffs~ Alright, then.
scripts.translation:
[乔吉·查拉]
（哼了一声）好吧。

scripts.text:
- Hold on a second here!! -
- You have too many items. -
- That means you can no longer receive any items. -
- Free up some space -
- and try again. -
scripts.translation:
- 请稍等！ -
- 您的物品太多了。 -
- 已无法再领取物品。 -
- 请腾出一些空间 -
- 然后重试。 -

scripts.text:
[Dandi Chara]
~Shrieks~ Hi...Hiya...
You really startled me...I thought it was Jogi.
scripts.translation:
[丹迪·查拉]
（尖叫）嗨...嗨...
你吓我一跳...我还以为是乔吉。

scripts.text: Exchange tokens for armor.
scripts.translation: 用信物兑换防具

scripts.text: About the Family
scripts.translation: 关于家人

scripts.text:
[Dandi Chara]
She gets angry easily but makes new clothes for me, saying I deserve pretty ones.
I like her...
scripts.translation:
[丹迪·查拉]
妈妈虽然很容易生气，却会说我值得穿漂亮衣服，还亲手给我做新衣服。
我喜欢她...

scripts.text:
[Dandi Chara]
My brothers can be pretty mean. So I try my best to obey what Dandi tells me to.
Still, Yota would never show his smiles, while Jogi would bring me hideous stuff like an earthworm, saying I should be tougher. ~Makes a sobbing sound~
scripts.translation:
[丹迪·查拉]
哥哥们有时很坏，所以我尽量听丹迪的话。
不过，尤塔总是愁眉不展，乔吉还会拿蚯蚓这种恶心的东西给我看，说我得坚强些。（抽泣）

scripts.text:
[Dandi Chara]
What's more, Jogi keeps wandering near the forest, saying He's going for the Militia. Mom said it's dangerous...
scripts.translation:
[丹迪·查拉]
乔吉总在森林附近闲逛，说自己要加入民兵。妈妈说那里很危险...

scripts.text:
[Dandi Chara]
What if a monster takes my brother away? That monster's gotta hurt a lot...
scripts.translation:
[丹迪·查拉]
要是魔物把哥哥抓走了怎么办？那只魔物一定会把哥哥伤得很重...

scripts.text:
[Dandi Chara]
Do you happen to have any piece of armor to spare for my brother? Would you give it to me? I'll pay for it...
scripts.translation:
[丹迪·查拉]
您有没有多余的防具可以给我哥哥？能给我吗？我会付钱的...

scripts.text:
[Dandi Chara]
Do you mind if I search you to see the items you have with you?
If I find an item suitable for Jogi, I'll pay {0}....
scripts.translation:
[丹迪·查拉]
我可以看看您带了哪些物品吗？
如果找到适合乔吉的东西，我会付您 {0}...

scripts.text: Search
scripts.translation: 再找找

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Dandi Chara]
...I think That's just it. Should I look over it again, or stop right here?
scripts.translation:
[丹迪·查拉]
...我想就是这个吧。要再检查一下，还是到此为止？

scripts.text: Search again.
scripts.translation: 再找找

scripts.text: Stop.
scripts.translation: 就这样

scripts.text:
[Dandi Chara]
Whoa, this must be ^3131FF{0}^000000!!
Don't you want to exchange this with {1} {2}?
scripts.translation:
[丹迪·查拉]
哇，这一定是^3131FF{0}^000000！
要用 {1} 个 {2} 跟我交换吗？

scripts.text: Exchange
scripts.translation: 交换

scripts.text: Quit exchanging
scripts.translation: 停止交换

scripts.text:
[Dandi Chara]
I know. I searched into your inventory too much. Sorry...
scripts.translation:
[丹迪·查拉]
我知道。我把你的物品栏翻了个遍，抱歉...

scripts.text:
[Dandi Chara]
Thank you.
Can I look for something else?
scripts.translation:
[丹迪·查拉]
谢谢你。
我还能再找找别的吗？

scripts.text:
[Dandi Chara]
Alright...Thank you for your...help, I guess...
scripts.translation:
[丹迪·查拉]
好吧...还是谢谢你帮忙了...

scripts.text:
- Hold on a second here!! -
- You have too many items. -
- That means you can no longer receive any items. -
- Free up some space -
- and try again. -
scripts.translation:
- 请稍等！ -
- 您的物品太多了。 -
- 已无法再领取物品。 -
- 请腾出一些空间 -
- 然后重试。 -

scripts.text:
[Goma Chara]
I'm Goma Chara, the eldest daughter of the Charas. These brats are who quicken my ageing process...
If you happen to have the amulet that my brother Yota made, I can polish it for you.
scripts.translation:
[戈马·查拉]
我是戈马·查拉，查拉家的长女。这些小鬼头真让我操心，感觉都要被他们气老了...
如果您有我弟弟约塔做的护身符，我可以帮您打磨。

scripts.text: Upgrade Amulet
scripts.translation: 打磨护身符

scripts.text: About the Family
scripts.translation: 关于家人

scripts.text:
[Goma Chara]
My father was a born seaman so went out into the sea a long time ago, saying he'll catch the world's largest tuna.
scripts.translation:
[戈马·查拉]
爸爸天生是个水手，很久以前就出海了，说要捕获世界上最大的金枪鱼。

scripts.text:
[Goma Chara]
My mother can be a collector so she would go into the deepmost side of the forest, looking for the odd fruits. She would come and go even before I know it.
scripts.translation:
[戈马·查拉]
妈妈喜欢收藏奇珍异果，所以常去森林最深处寻找。她总是来去匆匆，我还没反应过来，她就已经走了。

scripts.text:
[Goma Chara]
So taking care of these bratty brothers has become my responsibility! I wonder why I was born the eldest! I've almost had it!
scripts.translation:
[戈马·查拉]
照顾这些调皮的弟弟就成了我的责任！真不懂为什么偏偏我是老大！我快受不了了！

scripts.text:
[Goma Chara]
Yota! Tidy up your place after making amulets! Pick up the scales of horse mackerels there. Oh, my days...
scripts.translation:
[戈马·查拉]
约塔！做完护身符要把地方收拾干净！把地上的竹荚鱼鳞片捡起来。真是的...

scripts.text:
[Goma Chara]
Jogi, Dandi is about to burst into crying. Please behave yourself, will you?
scripts.translation:
[戈马·查拉]
乔吉，丹迪快要哭出来了。你就不能乖一点吗？

scripts.text:
[Goma Chara]
~Signs deeply~ My head is spinning!
I'm sorry but our chit-chat ends here. Time flies when you're busy taking care of little brothers.
scripts.translation:
[戈马·查拉]
（深深叹气）我头都晕了！
抱歉，闲聊就到这里吧。照顾弟弟们的时候，时间总是过得飞快。

scripts.text:
[Goma Chara]
Yota often makes quality amulets, but he still needs more polishing.
If he pays attention to details, his amulets will be even greater. But he just doesn't care.
scripts.translation:
[戈马·查拉]
约塔做的护身符通常很不错，不过还得多打磨。
要是他能多注意细节，护身符就会更好，可他就是不上心。

scripts.text: Polish the Horse Mackerel Amulet.
scripts.translation: 打磨竹荚鱼护身符

scripts.text: Polish the Leaf Amulet.
scripts.translation: 打磨树叶护身符

scripts.text: Polish the Rabbit Amulet.
scripts.translation: 打磨兔子护身符

scripts.text:
[Goma Chara]
This amulet is already perfect!
scripts.translation:
[戈马·查拉]
这枚护身符已经完美无缺了！

scripts.text:
[Goma Chara]
Show me your amulet, will you? I can't seem to find it in your inventory.
scripts.translation:
[戈马·查拉]
把护身符给我看看，好吗？我在你的物品栏里没找到。

scripts.text:
[Goma Chara]
Let me. Hmm... {0}, it is.
...I knew this was going to happen again. Worse, this one must require a lot more time to polish!
scripts.translation:
[戈马·查拉]
我看看。嗯...是 {0}。
...我就知道又会这样。更糟的是，这枚护身符得花更多时间打磨！

scripts.text:
[Goma Chara]
Hey, if you give me {0} {1}, I'll fix this for you.
This should produce {2}, I guess. How do you like it?
scripts.translation:
[戈马·查拉]
给我 {0} 个 {1}，我就帮您修好。
应该能做成 {2}，您觉得怎么样？

scripts.text: Upgrade
scripts.translation: 升级

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Goma Chara]
As you please.
scripts.translation:
[戈马·查拉]
随您决定。

scripts.text:
[Goma Chara]
Insufficient materials, can not be repaired free.
scripts.translation:
[戈马·查拉]
材料不够，无法免费修复。

scripts.text:
[Goma Chara]
The inside of this amulet seems pretty tough.
But my dexterity is tougher. Tada! Put my brother's amulet to good use.
scripts.translation:
[戈马·查拉]
这枚护身符的内层似乎很坚固。
不过我的手艺更胜一筹。锵锵！把弟弟做的护身符好好利用起来吧。

scripts.text:
[Shepherd]
I'm sorry to say this when you're working so hard to help us, but how about searching for some other work? I think It's a shame to let your skills go to waste.
scripts.translation:
[牧羊人]
您这么努力地帮我们，我实在不该这么说...不过要不要考虑找点别的工作？您的本事不用在这里太可惜了。

scripts.text:
[Shepherd]
I heard that honey collect is in need of help, so you should go see ^4D4DFF[Florin]^000000. Thank you for helping us.
scripts.translation:
[牧羊人]
听说采蜜的人手不够，您可以去找^4D4DFF[弗洛林]^000000。谢谢您帮忙。

scripts.text:
[Shepherd]
