scripts.translation:
[蛋仔]
哎呀，看来你很懂这里的规矩嘛。把东西带给副厨师长就行。不过他有点古怪，交东西时记得说句话。

scripts.text:
[Eggling]
You should toss this to him, saying ��^0000cd[Here comes the newbie!]^000000 He believes that a Doram should say this on his or her first voyage for good luck. Anyways, he seems to think that it is the right way to do.
scripts.translation:
[蛋仔]
把这个递给他时，要说“^0000cd新手来了！^000000”。他觉得多兰第一次航行时说这句话能带来好运。总之，他认定这样做才对。

scripts.text:
[Eggling]
You know what I mean, right?
scripts.translation:
[蛋仔]
明白我的意思了吧？

scripts.text:
[Eggling]
You seem to understand it so well. I like it. What is your name, by the way? Haha...
scripts.translation:
[蛋仔]
你还挺上道的，我喜欢。对了，你叫什么名字？哈哈...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
My name is {1}.

[Eggling]
I see. Let's say hi when we run into each other. Well, make sure to follow my instructions when you hand it over to the Sous Chef, OK?
scripts.translation:
[蛋仔]
知道了。下次碰面记得打招呼。把东西交给副厨师长时，记得照我说的做啊。

scripts.text:
[Eggling]
If, there's anything you want to know, don't hesitate to come and see me. And when you get on, make sure to say hi to the ^0000cdpurser^000000.
scripts.translation:
[蛋仔]
有不明白的事就来找我。上船后也记得跟^0000cd事务长^000000打声招呼。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes. Thank you.

[Eggling]
OK. Get on there now.
scripts.translation:
[蛋仔]
好，现在上船吧。

scripts.text:
[Eggling]
Are you back already? What about your mission?
scripts.translation:
[蛋仔]
这么快就回来了？任务办得怎么样？

scripts.text:
[Eggling]
Come back after finishing the mission!
scripts.translation:
[蛋仔]
完成任务后再回来！

scripts.text:
[Eggling]
Just in time. Since the fog is gone, we can set off soon.
scripts.translation:
[蛋仔]
来得正好。雾已经散了，我们很快就能出发。

scripts.text:
[Eggling]
Whoa, the punk never dies and returns.
scripts.translation:
[蛋仔]
哟，那个家伙居然没死，又回来了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You wanted me dead?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你盼着我死吗？

scripts.text:
[Eggling]
No. don't you know? It is a lyric from this latest hit. Oh, please, don't act like you are from some rural town. What would they think of us all? Anyways, what about the thing you are supposed to bring? Do you have it?
scripts.translation:
[蛋仔]
不是。你不知道吗？这是最近的热门歌曲里的歌词。拜托，别装得像个乡下人似的，别人会怎么看我们？对了，你要带的东西呢？带来了吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Not yet. How many did you ask?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
还没。你要我带几个？

scripts.text:
[Eggling]
How stupid... I told you to bring ^0000cd3^000000. I said 3! You can get them from the ^0000cdBasilisks^000000. How many times I have to tell you that? I think I said it about 100 times!
scripts.translation:
[蛋仔]
真笨...我让你带^0000cd3^000000个。就是3个！去找^0000cd蛇怪^000000拿。到底要我说多少遍？我都说了差不多100遍了！

scripts.text:
[Eggling]
You wouldn't get on the ship until you bring it to me!
scripts.translation:
[蛋仔]
不把东西带给我，你就别想上船！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Here they are. The Basilrocks.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
东西在这里。蛇怪的东西。

scripts.text:
[Eggling]
Ha. You are pretty good. How about retiring from the adventures and becoming an apprentice of mine? I'll be nice.
scripts.translation:
[蛋仔]
哈，你挺能干嘛。不如别当冒险者了，来做我的学徒？我会好好待你的。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I have to say no. I don't want to spend the eternity as a sailor boy.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我只能拒绝了。我可不想一辈子都当水手。

scripts.text:
[Eggling]
What? What did you say? A sailor boy? Hey! I am not just a sailor boy, but an invaluable asset who takes care of miscellaneous businesses of Con-Chliina! This ship cannot sail without me!
scripts.translation:
[蛋仔]
什么？你说什么？水手？喂！我可不只是个水手，我还负责康奇利纳号上各种杂事，是不可或缺的人物！没有我，这艘船根本开不了！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh, I see. Please excuse me.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哦，明白了。失礼了。

scripts.text:
[Eggling]
You almost got me mad.
scripts.translation:
[蛋仔]
你差点把我惹火了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh, I see. I am sorry.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哦，明白了。抱歉。

scripts.text:
[Eggling]
Well, thanks anyway. I didn't really expect you to bring it for me. I have nothing else to offer you. Since there is a dangerous world out there, take this.
scripts.translation:
[蛋仔]
总之还是谢了。我本来也没指望你真会帮我带。没什么好送你的，不过外面的世界很危险，拿着这个吧。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Anchovy?

[Eggling]
You know, the anchovy from Lasagna is the best. You cannot buy this with money out there. Take it when I offer it to you. And give me all the Basilrocks you have.
scripts.translation:
[蛋仔]
你知道吧，罗札纳的鳀鱼最好吃了。在外面可买不到。既然我都给你了，就收下吧。把你身上所有的巴西洛克都给我。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh, I see. Thank you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哦，知道了。谢谢。

scripts.text:
[Eggling]
Get in there.
scripts.translation:
[蛋仔]
进去吧。

scripts.text:
[Eggling]
Whoa, the punk never dies and returns.
scripts.translation:
[蛋仔]
哟，那个家伙居然没死，又回来了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You wanted me dead?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你盼着我死吗？

scripts.text:
[Eggling]
No. don't you know? It is a lyric from this latest hit. Oh, please, don't act like you are from some rural town. What would they think of us all?
scripts.translation:
[蛋仔]
不是。你不知道吗？这是最近的热门歌曲里的歌词。拜托，别装得像个乡下人似的，别人会怎么看我们？

scripts.text:
[Eggling]
Get in there.
scripts.translation:
[蛋仔]
进去吧。

scripts.text:
[Eggling]
Are you going to get on the ^0000cdship^000000?

[Eggling]
Are you going to get on the ^0000cdship^000000?

[Eggling]
You are the punk. Are you getting on the ship?
scripts.translation:
[蛋仔]
你这家伙，要上船吗？

scripts.text:
[Eggling]
Or are you heading to ^0000cdIzlude^000000 or ^0000cdMalangdo^000000 in the new continent?
Wherever you go, it costs ^0000cd{0} Zeny^000000.
scripts.translation:
[蛋仔]
还是要去新大陆的^0000cd依斯鲁得岛^000000或^0000cd绵绵岛^000000？
无论去哪儿，费用都是^0000cd{0} Zeny^000000。

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Eggling]
Get in there.
scripts.translation:
[蛋仔]
进去吧。

scripts.text:
[Eggling]
You don't have enough money. Check again.
scripts.translation:
[蛋仔]
你的钱不够，再确认一下。

scripts.text:
[Eggling]
You don't have enough money. Check again.
scripts.translation:
[蛋仔]
你的钱不够，再确认一下。

scripts.text:
[Eggling]
Well then.
scripts.translation:
[蛋仔]
那好吧。

scripts.text:
[Eggling]
Hey, you. Come this way. Have you really thrown it to the Sous Chef because I told you so?
scripts.translation:
[蛋仔]
嘿，你，过来。你真的照我说的，把东西扔给副厨师长了吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I have only done what you told me to do.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我只是照你说的做了。

scripts.text:
[Eggling]
Ha! How could you? You do everything what I say, really? What a dimwit! Do you wear the beard for fashion, you moron? Do you know what kind of trouble I got into because of you? I was scolded because of you!
scripts.translation:
[蛋仔]
哈！你怎么能这么做？我说什么你都照办啊？真是个笨蛋！你留胡子是为了好看吗，蠢货？你知道我因为你惹上多少麻烦吗？我都被骂了！

scripts.text:
[Eggling]
Cut it out. Well, since you seem sorry, I'll forgive you if you bring a ^0000cdBasilrock^000000. I am quite a generous man.
scripts.translation:
[蛋仔]
够了。看你似乎挺后悔的，带一个^0000cd巴西洛克^000000来，我就原谅你。我可是很宽宏大量的。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Why should I...?

[Eggling]
Do you really want to sign yourself up for the worst voyage of your life?
scripts.translation:
[蛋仔]
你真想踏上人生中最糟糕的航程吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What is a Basilrock?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
巴西洛克是什么？

scripts.text:
[Eggling]
No one knows what it is. However, all sailors have it. You should really stop asking. Go get it now. I give 10 seconds.
scripts.translation:
[蛋仔]
没人知道那是什么。不过每个水手都有。别问了，赶紧去拿，我给你10秒。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Everyone should know where to get it in order to carry it. Where can I get it?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
既然大家都带着它，肯定知道去哪儿找吧？我该去哪儿拿？

scripts.text:
[Eggling]
When you get out of the village, there is a cave at the right end of the field in which unpleasant snakes called the ^0000cdBasilisks^000000 live. You can get it from them.
scripts.translation:
[蛋仔]
出村后，田野最右边有个洞穴，里面住着叫^0000cd巴西利斯克^000000的讨厌蛇类。去找它们拿。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Since I am on my way there, I'll get some for you if I can. However, my mission comes first. You don't expect for me to process it before the mission the captain has given me, do you?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我正好要去那边，有机会的话会帮你带一些。不过我得先完成自己的任务。你不会以为我会先办你的事，再去做船长交代的任务吧？

scripts.text:
[Eggling]
Well... I don't mean... Hum... Well 10 seconds has passed. Bring me ^0000cd3 Basilrocks^000000, no less. Bring them without anyone knowing. I will make you regret if you tell anyone.
scripts.translation:
[蛋仔]
嗯...我不是那个意思...咳...好了，10秒到了。给我带^0000cd3个巴西洛克^000000，一个都不能少。偷偷带来，敢告诉别人我就让你后悔。

scripts.text:
[Purser]
Welcome on board. Welcome to ^0000cdCon-Chliina^000000. We will send you safely to your destination. However, we cannot sail off right at this moment.
scripts.translation:
[事务长]
欢迎登船，欢迎来到^0000cd康奇利纳号^000000。我们会安全送您抵达目的地。不过现在还不能起航。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What is going on?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
怎么回事？

scripts.text:
[Purser]
Look at Lasagna out there.
scripts.translation:
[事务长]
看看外面的罗札纳。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I don't see anything.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我什么也看不见。

scripts.text:
[Purser]
Right. You cannot see anything. There is this ^0000cdthick fog^000000. I wonder if we would be able to set off now.
scripts.translation:
[事务长]
没错，什么也看不见。外面有^0000cd浓雾^000000，真不知道现在能不能起航。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I am in a hurry.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我赶时间。

scripts.text:
[Purser]
If you are in a hurry, you should meet ^0000cdthe Captain and the Chief Officer^000000. They decide whether to sail off or not. They are in the Captain's Cabin up there/
scripts.translation:
[事务长]
您要是赶时间，就去见^0000cd船长和大副^000000。他们负责决定是否起航。两位都在上面的船长室里。

scripts.text:
[Purser]
I smell something. The smell of a rookie...
You are?
scripts.translation:
[事务长]
我闻到一股气味...是新手的气味。你是？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Eh, my name is {1}.

[Purser]
Oh, yeah. I see your name on the list. {0}.
scripts.translation:
[事务长]
哦，对了。我在名单上看到你的名字了。{0}。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes... Nice to meet you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是的...很高兴认识您。

scripts.text:
[Purser]
don't need to sweat. I believe you have got enough training out there so there is not much for you to do now. Why don't you go and familiarize yourself with the crews and their name?
scripts.translation:
[事务长]
不用紧张。我相信你已经在外面接受过充分训练，现在没什么特别要做的。不如去熟悉一下船员和他们的名字？

scripts.text:
[Purser]
When you go somewhere where you know nobody, a Doram from the same town can be your best friend. So I recommend you to meet as many of them as possible now.
scripts.translation:
[事务长]
到了人生地不熟的地方，同乡多兰会是最好的伙伴。所以我建议你趁现在尽量多认识一些人。

scripts.text:
[Purser]
There are 12 Part Leaders on this ship other than the Captain, and there are many other crews. You don't need to meet them all. You can meet the important ones.
scripts.translation:
[事务长]
这艘船上除了船长，还有12位部门负责人和许多船员。你不用每个人都认识，先认识几位重要人物就好。

scripts.text:
[Purser]
There will be some guys who manage to show up right before the ship sails off so you should meet the ones you can meet for now. First of all, you should go meet the Captain.
scripts.translation:
[事务长]
有些人会赶在起航前才出现，所以先去认识现在能见到的人吧。首先去见船长。

scripts.text:
[Purser]
The ^0000cdCaptain's Cabin^000000 is right over there. Since the Captain values courtesy and manners. make sure not to make any mistakes.
scripts.translation:
[事务长]
^0000cd船长室^000000就在那边。船长很重视礼节和举止，千万别失礼。

scripts.text:
[Purser]
The Captain and the Chief Officer are in there. You may go meet them. You can also talk to them about the sailing schedule.
scripts.translation:
[事务长]
船长和大副都在里面，你可以去见他们，也可以顺便问问航行日程。

scripts.text:
[Purser]
The Captain's Cabin is right over there. Since the Captain values courtesy and manners. make sure not to make any mistakes.
scripts.translation:
[事务长]
船长室就在那边。船长很重视礼节和举止，千万别失礼。

scripts.text:
[Purser]
Go to meet the Recorder who is the closest to this place. He is such a funny guy. You would have fun talking to him.
scripts.translation:
[事务长]
去见离这里最近的记录员吧。他很有趣，和他聊聊会很开心。

scripts.text:
[Purser]
Have you met the Recorder? How about meeting the Head Chef?
scripts.translation:
[事务长]
见过记录员了吗？要不要再去见见主厨？

scripts.text:
[Purser]
Well. Have you met all of them?
scripts.translation:
[事务长]
嗯，都见过了吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Not all of them. I couldn't find them all.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
还没有，我没能找到所有人。

scripts.text:
[Purser]
I suppose so. They must be drinking Kahlugna Milk and snoring somewhere. They will come back when it is the time to set off. You can meet them then...
scripts.translation:
[事务长]
我想也是。他们大概在哪儿喝着卡鲁纳牛奶、呼呼大睡呢。等到起航时自然会回来，到时再去见他们吧...

scripts.text:
[Purser]
Isn't that ^0000cdKahlugnag^000000 you are holding in your hand? Not anyone can have it, you know.
scripts.translation:
[事务长]
你手里拿的是^0000cd卡鲁纳牛奶^000000吧？这可不是谁都能拿到的。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
The one checking the ticket at the entrance asked me to deliver it to the Head Chef.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
入口处负责验票的人让我把它交给主厨。

scripts.text:
[Purser]
Why didn't you give it to the Head Chef then? Go ahead and deliver it to him!
scripts.translation:
[事务长]
那你怎么没交给主厨？快把东西送过去！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes, yes!

[Purser]
Have you delivered the thing to the Head Chef? The ingredient should be delivered when it is still fresh! The kitchen is at the end of the hallway.
scripts.translation:
[事务长]
东西交给主厨了吗？食材要趁新鲜送到！厨房就在走廊尽头。

scripts.text:
[Purser]
Hum, we have a problem.
scripts.translation:
[事务长]
嗯，遇到麻烦了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I have handed it over. And the Boatswain wanted to know when the ^0000cdSailing Signal^000000 would be issued.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我已经交给主厨了。水手长想知道^0000cd起航信号^000000什么时候发出。

scripts.text:
[Purser]
I was thinking about it just now. Well, have you been trained properly for the adventure? don't you want ^0000cdtest your strength^000000 before that?
scripts.translation:
[事务长]
我刚才也在想这件事。你为冒险做好准备了吗？要不要先^0000cd测试一下实力^000000？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
May I help you?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
需要我帮忙吗？

scripts.text:
[Purser]
Look at Lasagna. What do you think?
scripts.translation:
[事务长]
看看罗札纳，你觉得怎么样？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I think it is one lively and happy village!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我觉得这是个热闹又快乐的村庄！

scripts.text:
[Purser]
That's not what I want to hear. Take a look at the sea we are about to explore.
scripts.translation:
[事务长]
我想听的不是这个。看看我们即将驶入的海域。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
The fog...?

[Purser]
Yes. The ^0000cdfog^000000 over the sea. The sea fog.
scripts.translation:
[事务长]
没错，海面上的^0000cd雾^000000，海雾。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I won't be surprised if a monster storms out of the fog. I smell something smoky too. Has a volcano erupted recently around here?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
就算魔物突然从雾里冲出来，我也不会奇怪。我还闻到一股烟味。这附近最近有火山爆发吗？

scripts.text:
[Purser]
We are unable to issue the sailing signal because of the fog. Ask the ^0000cdChief Officer^000000 if there would be any change in the sailing schedule. If there is any, go fix it.
scripts.translation:
[事务长]
因为海雾，我们无法发出起航信号。去问问^0000cd大副^000000航行日程是否有变。如果有变化，就去处理一下。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What? I finished the training yesterday.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
什么？我昨天已经完成训练了。

scripts.text:
[Purser]
We are not doing a charity work here. We train promising Dorams and send them to the new continent to bring honor to the name of Doram. That's why train you guys.
scripts.translation:
[事务长]
我们可不是在做慈善。我们训练有前途的多兰，再把他们送往新大陆，为多兰族争光。这就是训练你们的原因。

scripts.text:
[Purser]
Consider it as a warming up for all the difficulties you would encounter in the new continent.
scripts.translation:
[事务长]
就把这当成热身，为你在新大陆将遭遇的种种困难做好准备。

scripts.text:
[Purser]
The Chief Officer is in the Captain's Cabin. Go ask him if there would be a change in the sailing schedule because of the fog!
scripts.translation:
[事务长]
大副在船长室里。快去问问他，海雾会不会影响航行日程！

scripts.text:
[Purser]
I guess we wouldn't be able to set off because of the mist.
scripts.translation:
[事务长]
看来雾还没散，我们暂时无法起航。

scripts.text:
[Purser]
How did it go? Please report to Chief Officer Stello.
scripts.translation:
[事务长]
情况如何？向大副斯特洛汇报吧。

scripts.text:
[Purser]
Go ahead and report to the Chief Officer.
scripts.translation:
[事务长]
去向大副汇报吧。

scripts.text:
[Purser]
Enjoy a smooth voyage.
scripts.translation:
[事务长]
祝您一路顺风。

scripts.text:
[Purser]
I am glad that you are working like a full-fledged Doram.
scripts.translation:
[事务长]
很高兴看到你能像个合格的多兰一样办事。

scripts.text:
[Purser]
I should check the cargo before sailing off.
scripts.translation:
[事务长]
起航前我得检查一下货物。

scripts.text:
[Stello]
It looks a lot and large. How about cutting down some?
scripts.translation:
[斯特洛]
看起来又多又大。要不要削减一些？

scripts.text:
[Stello]
Who are you? You are not allowed to enter hear with no permission. Please leave.
scripts.translation:
[斯特洛]
你是谁？未经许可不得进入这里，请离开。

scripts.text:
[Stello]
What brought you here? Are you hear to meet the captain? If not, please leave. You are not supposed to be here.
scripts.translation:
[斯特洛]
有什么事？你是来见船长的吗？不是的话就请离开。这里不是你该来的地方。

scripts.text:
[Stello]
Keep that in mind. You need to watch your manners when you deal with the crews of this ship.
scripts.translation:
[斯特洛]
记住，和船员打交道时要注意礼貌。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Dear Chief Officer!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
大副阁下！

scripts.text:
[Stello]
What is going on?
scripts.translation:
[斯特洛]
怎么回事？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
The Purser asked me to check if there wouldn't be any problem sailing off with the thick ^0000cdfog^000000.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
事务长让我来确认一下，在这么浓的^0000cd雾^000000中起航会不会有问题。

scripts.text:
[Stello]
Hum... This fog must be...
scripts.translation:
[斯特洛]
嗯...这雾一定是...

scripts.text:
[Captain Gamberi]
It is ^0000cdthat one^000000 again.
scripts.translation:
[船长 甘贝里]
又是^0000cd那个家伙^000000。

scripts.text:
[Stello]
Yes. Again. Umm, what should we do? We have no one to send there. Everyone's so busy preparing for the sailing.
scripts.translation:
[斯特洛]
是啊，又来了。嗯，该怎么办？没人能派过去，大家都忙着准备起航。

scripts.text:
[Captain Gamberi]
Stello, I guess you should go down there yourself.
scripts.translation:
[船长 甘贝里]
斯特洛，我看你得亲自下去一趟。

scripts.text:
[Stello]
Let's send Eggling.
scripts.translation:
[斯特洛]
派蛋仔去吧。

scripts.text:
[Captain Gamberi]
Eggling is not ready to handle it yet. Think about why Eggling is still called Eggling.
scripts.translation:
[船长 甘贝里]
蛋仔还没准备好处理这种事。想想看，为什么他至今还叫蛋仔。

scripts.text:
[Stello]
... I guess I should go. Damn it.
scripts.translation:
[斯特洛]
...看来只能我去了。该死。

scripts.text:
[Captain Gamberi]
Stello. a gentleman should use a good language at all time.
scripts.translation:
[船长 甘贝里]
斯特洛，绅士无论何时都要注意言辞。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well... The Purser has sent me to take care of the problem.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯...事务长派我来处理这个问题。

scripts.text:
[Stello]
There is.
scripts.translation:
[斯特洛]
这里有一位...

scripts.text:
[Captain Gamberi]
A well-trained.
scripts.translation:
[船长 甘贝里]
训练有素的...

scripts.text:
[Stello]
Doram.
scripts.translation:
[斯特洛]
多兰。

scripts.text:
[Captain Gamberi]
In front of us.
scripts.translation:
[船长 甘贝里]
就在我们面前。

scripts.text:
[Stello]
Good. Consider it as the last training before sailing off.
scripts.translation:
[斯特洛]
很好。就把这当作起航前的最后训练吧。

scripts.text:
[Captain Gamberi]
Stello. It doesn't make sense to call it as the last training when we are dealing with a Doram who has finished the training for the adventure. This should be called the first practice.
scripts.translation:
[船长 甘贝里]
斯特洛。对方可是已经完成冒险训练的多兰，把这称作最后训练不太合适吧。应该叫第一次实战。

scripts.text:
[Stello]
Whatever it is. Well, good. I'll assign your first mission as your first practice.
scripts.translation:
[斯特洛]
叫什么都无所谓。好，那就把这次任务当作你的第一次实战。

scripts.text:
[Stello]
The seaway we are about to take is ^0000cdno typical seaway^000000. You need to read the movements of the stars and wind. You need to take the way which is not marked on the map which makes you wonder if you will ever find the land.
scripts.translation:
[斯特洛]
我们要走的航线^0000cd并非寻常航道^000000。你得观察星象和风向，选择地图上没有标出的路线，甚至会怀疑自己还能不能找到陆地。

scripts.text:
[Stello]
That is why we need to get rid of all the fog which blocks us from reading the sun and wind.
scripts.translation:
[斯特洛]
所以我们必须驱散所有妨碍观察日照和风向的雾。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Can we get rid of the fog?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
雾能驱散吗？

scripts.text:
[Stello]
If it is a normal fog. You need to wait until it is lifted. However, there is ^0000cdsomething causing this fog^000000. It can be removed.
scripts.translation:
[斯特洛]
如果是普通的雾，只能等它散去。不过，这场雾是由^0000cd某种东西引起的^000000，想办法就能消除。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
There is something causing the fog? A villain involved, maybe? This is exciting!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
有东西在制造雾？难道是坏人在捣鬼？听起来好刺激！

scripts.text:
[Stello]
Not quite. There is a dragon living in a nearby cave. The dragon breathes fire which burns up everything around it. The fog is made of the smoke.
scripts.translation:
[斯特洛]
不完全是。附近的洞穴里住着一条龙，它喷出的火焰会烧毁周围的一切，而这些雾就是烟形成的。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No wonder the fog smells like smoke.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
难怪雾里有股烟味。

scripts.text:
[Stello]
The condition of the dragon is always monitored by the vigilante corps. Please go to see ^0000cdthe vigilante guarding the south bridge of the village^000000, and check the state of the dragon.
scripts.translation:
[斯特洛]
义警一直在监视那条龙的情况。请去找^0000cd守在村庄南桥的义警^000000，确认龙的状况。

scripts.text:
[Stello]
And if you need help, please help them stop the dragon from breathing fire.
scripts.translation:
[斯特洛]
如果需要帮忙，就协助他们阻止那条龙喷火。

scripts.text:
[Captain Gamberi]
The sailing depends on your hand, dear adventurer. Well, go on and take care of your first mision!
scripts.translation:
[船长 甘贝里]
这趟航行就靠你了，亲爱的冒险者。快去完成你的第一个任务吧！

scripts.text:
[Stello]
Wait, take this with you. It will come in handy in case of an emergency. Please be careful!
scripts.translation:
[斯特洛]
等等，把这个带上。遇到紧急情况时会派上用场。小心行事！

scripts.text:
[Stello]
Ask the vigilante how the dragon is doing and resolve the situation with the vigilante corps if any problem has occurred.
scripts.translation:
[斯特洛]
去问问义警那条龙的情况。如果出了问题，就和义警一起处理。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Dear Chief Officer!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
大副阁下！

scripts.text:
[Stello]
You are here. We were just talking about you.
scripts.translation:
[斯特洛]
你来了。我们刚才还在说你呢。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What were you talking about?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你们在说什么？

scripts.text:
[Captain Gamberi]
We were wondering if we had to go down there to recover your dead body...
scripts.translation:
[船长 甘贝里]
我们在商量要不要下去把你的尸体捞回来...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What? Was it such a dangerous mission?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
什么？这任务有那么危险吗？

scripts.text:
[Stello]
No, not at all. Captain, what are you talking about?
scripts.translation:
[斯特洛]
一点也不危险。船长，您在说什么？

scripts.text:
[Captain Gamberi]
Stello, it is called a joke.
scripts.translation:
[船长 甘贝里]
斯特洛，这叫开玩笑。

scripts.text:
[Stello]
A joke should be pleasant for the both parties. This is just a curse.
scripts.translation:
[斯特洛]
玩笑应该让双方都觉得有趣。这听起来更像诅咒。

scripts.text:
[Captain Gamberi]
Stello, you must learn about this thing called social codes.
scripts.translation:
[船长 甘贝里]
斯特洛，你得学学什么叫社交礼节。

scripts.text:
[Stello]
Well, we can talk about that later. I was wondering when you would be back. When the fog was lifted, we figured out that you had succeeded, dear adventurer. Thank you for your effort.
scripts.translation:
[斯特洛]
这个以后再说吧。我一直在等你回来。雾一散，我们就知道你成功了。亲爱的冒险者，辛苦你了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It was a great experience for me.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这次经历让我受益匪浅。

scripts.text:
[Captain Gamberi]
Stello, you should be liberal with your praise. Just as I did it to you.
scripts.translation:
[船长 甘贝里]
斯特洛，赞美别人要大方些，就像我夸你那样。

scripts.text:
[Stello]
Oh, yes. Let's give a big hand to the adventurer who has returned from the mission!
scripts.translation:
[斯特洛]
哦，对了！让我们为完成任务归来的冒险者热烈鼓掌！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh, yes. Well, thanks.

[Captain Gamberi]
Well then. It is the time to issue the sailing signal.
scripts.translation:
[船长 甘贝里]
那么，是时候发出起航信号了。

scripts.text:
[Captain Gamberi]
Everyone, in your position! We are sailing off now!
scripts.translation:
[船长 甘贝里]
所有人各就各位！准备起航！

scripts.text: [Boo-]

[Captain Gamberi]
Stello. give ^0000cdthat^000000 to the adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[船长 甘贝里]
斯特洛，把^0000cd那个^000000交给冒险者。

scripts.text:
[Stello]
That? What do you mean by that?
scripts.translation:
[斯特洛]
那个？您指的是什么？

scripts.text:
[Captain Gamberi]
The thing that you cannot buy with money when you leave Lasagna.
scripts.translation:
[船长 甘贝里]
就是离开罗札纳后，花钱也买不到的东西。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Anchovy?

[Stello]
Oh! How did you know?
scripts.translation:
[斯特洛]
啊！您怎么知道的？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I have received a handful. I don't need more.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我已经拿到一些了，不需要更多。

scripts.text:
[Stello]
Really? Then you may not need this either. Too bad. I have prepared it for you. I guess it belongs to someone else now.
scripts.translation:
[斯特洛]
真的吗？那这个你可能也不需要了。真可惜，我特地为你准备的...看来只好送给别人了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What... What is it?

[Stello]
It is the little present prepared for the novice adventurer by the leader of Farfalle vigilante corps and the captain of Con-Chliina in celebration of the first mission.
scripts.translation:
[斯特洛]
这是法尔法雷义警团首领和康奇利娜号船长准备的小礼物，送给完成首次任务的新手冒险者。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
A hat and a ring?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
一顶帽子和一枚戒指？

scripts.text:
[Stello]
The hat is prepared by Pepperoncino after hearing your story. A Doram adventurer deserves to have a hat. The hat will bring you luck.
scripts.translation:
[斯特洛]
听完你的经历后，佩佩龙奇诺特地准备了这顶帽子。多兰冒险者就该有顶帽子，它会给你带来好运。

scripts.text:
[Stello]
And the ring is prepared by the captain. Dear captain?
scripts.translation:
[斯特洛]
戒指是船长准备的。船长？

scripts.text:
[Captain Gamberi]
That ring will help you gather special experiences as a novice adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[船长 甘贝里]
这枚戒指能帮你在冒险初期获得特别的历练。

scripts.text:
[Captain Gamberi]
It will grow with you until you don't need its help anymore. When you become an experienced adventurer, it will lose all its power and become an ordinary ring made of grass.
scripts.translation:
[船长 甘贝里]
它会陪伴你成长，直到你不再需要它的帮助。等你成为经验丰富的冒险者，它就会失去力量，变成一枚普通的草制戒指。

scripts.text:
[Stello]
Oh, I should get you a Magnifier. When you get an unidentified weapon or equipment, check with it.
scripts.translation:
[斯特洛]
对了，我再给你一个放大镜。拿到未鉴定的武器或装备时，可以用它来鉴定。

scripts.text:
[Stello]
I'll give you some ^0000cdKahlugna Milk^000000 which all Dorams who have ever visited Lasagna crave. Thank you so much for your effort.
scripts.translation:
[斯特洛]
我再送你一些^0000cd卡鲁纳牛奶^000000。每个来过罗札纳的多兰都很喜欢它。非常感谢你的努力。

scripts.text:
[Captain Gamberi]
Well then. It is the time to issue the sailing signal.
scripts.translation:
[船长 甘贝里]
那么，是时候发出起航信号了。

scripts.text:
[Captain Gamberi]
Everyone, in your position! We are sailing off now!
scripts.translation:
[船长 甘贝里]
所有人各就各位！准备起航！

scripts.text: [Boo-]

[Stello]
How is the new continent? Should I ask for a leave and go on an adventure?
scripts.translation:
[斯特洛]
新大陆怎么样？我是不是也该请假去冒险？

scripts.text:
[Stello]
I'd like to explore the new continent when I get to leave the ship someday.
scripts.translation:
[斯特洛]
真希望哪天能离开这艘船，去探索新大陆。

scripts.text:
[Captain Gamberi]
Nonsense! Who else would take care of the seaway to the new continent?
scripts.translation:
[船长 甘贝里]
别胡说！谁来负责通往新大陆的航线？

scripts.text:
[Stello]
Just saying... It doesn't hurt to say that.
scripts.translation:
[斯特洛]
我只是说说...说说又没关系。

scripts.text:
[Captain Gamberi]
Make sure to knock. Keep your manners.
scripts.translation:
[船长 甘贝里]
记得先敲门，注意礼貌。

scripts.text:
[Captain Gamberi]
Stello, I have told you how the way you dress shows what kind of Doram you are. Ad just your attire, please.
scripts.translation:
[船长 甘贝里]
斯特洛，我说过，你的穿着能体现多兰的风度。请整理一下仪容。

scripts.text:
[Stello]
This is too heavy, tight and annoying. This is just too uncomfortable.
scripts.translation:
[斯特洛]
这身衣服又重又紧，还很碍事，穿着太不舒服了。

scripts.text:
[Captain Gamberi]
You need to overcome the inconvenience to have a correct posture. The correct posture is your first step to become a gentleman. Do you get it, Stello?
scripts.translation:
[船长 甘贝里]
要保持端正的仪态，就得克服这些不便。仪态端正是成为绅士的第一步。明白了吗，斯特洛？

scripts.text:
[Captain Gamberi]
Stello, say it again.
scripts.translation:
[船长 甘贝里]
斯特洛，再说一遍。

scripts.text:
[Stello]
Yes, sir.
scripts.translation:
[斯特洛]
是，长官。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Excuse me.

[Stello]
Who are you? You are not allowed to enter hear with no permission. Please leave.
scripts.translation:
[斯特洛]
你是谁？未经许可不得进入这里，请离开。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hello. I am a passenger on this ship. I'd like to know when this ship sets off.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
您好，我是这艘船上的乘客。想问问这艘船什么时候起航。

scripts.text:
[Stello]
The ship will set off when the time comes.
scripts.translation:
[斯特洛]
到了起航的时候，自然就会出发。

scripts.text:
[Captain Gamberi]
Stello, I don't think that is the matter of the question. Look outside.
scripts.translation:
[船长 甘贝里]
斯特洛，我看他问的不是这个。看看外面。

scripts.text:
[Stello]
Oh, the red ^0000cdfog^000000! It seemed all right just a while ago!
scripts.translation:
[斯特洛]
啊，是红色的^0000cd雾^000000！刚才明明还好好的！

scripts.text:
[Captain Gamberi]
I guess something may have cause the disturbance.
scripts.translation:
[船长 甘贝里]
看来是有什么东西引起了这场异变。

scripts.text:
[Stello]
We cannot sail off like this.
scripts.translation:
[斯特洛]
这种情况下不能起航。

scripts.text:
[Captain Gamberi]
I seems so.
scripts.translation:
[船长 甘贝里]
看来确实如此。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
However, I really am in a hurry. Should I wait until the fog is lifted?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
可是我真的赶时间。要等雾散了才能走吗？

scripts.text:
[Stello]
That fog will not be lifted if you just sit and wait.
scripts.translation:
[斯特洛]
光坐着等，雾可不会散。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Isn't it a natural fog?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这不是自然形成的雾吗？

scripts.text:
[Stello]
It Isn't. This fog is made of the smoke which is fumed by ^0000cdthe dragon living in the cave^000000 when it is upset. Please wait until ^0000cdthe vigilantes^000000 take care of it.
scripts.translation:
[斯特洛]
不是。这雾是^0000cd洞穴里的龙^000000发怒时喷出的烟形成的。等^0000cd义警^000000处理好再说吧。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Then when would we be able to set off?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那我们什么时候才能起航？

scripts.text:
[Stello]
Maybe tomorrow.
scripts.translation:
[斯特洛]
也许要等到明天。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Isn't the fog covering the area near the shore? wouldn't it be a problem to just sail off?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
雾不是只在近岸一带吗？直接起航应该也没问题吧？

scripts.text:
[Stello]
The seaway we are about to take is ^0000cdno typical seaway^000000. You need to read the movements of the stars and wind. You need to take the way which is not marked on the map which makes you wonder if you will ever find the land.
scripts.translation:
[斯特洛]
我们要走的航线^0000cd并非寻常航道^000000。你得观察星象和风向，选择地图上没有标出的路线，甚至会怀疑自己还能不能找到陆地。

scripts.text:
[Stello]
That is why we need to get rid of all the ^0000cdfog^000000 which blocks us from reading the sun and wind.
scripts.translation:
[斯特洛]
所以我们必须清除所有妨碍观察日照和风向的^0000cd雾气^000000。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I guess there is no choice left for me. I should go there.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
看来只能这样了，我去看看。

scripts.text:
[Stello]
You don't need to do this.
scripts.translation:
[斯特洛]
你没必要去。

scripts.text:
[Captain Gamberi]
Stello. This adventurer seems very experienced. This could be a new adventure as well. It could help us.
scripts.translation:
[船长 甘贝里]
斯特洛，这位冒险者看起来经验丰富。这也算一次新的冒险，说不定能帮上忙。

scripts.text:
[Stello]
Hum... OK. Please go to see ^0000cdthe vigilante guarding the south bridge of the village^000000, and check the state of the dragon.
scripts.translation:
[斯特洛]
嗯...好吧。请去找^0000cd守在村庄南桥的义警^000000，确认一下龙的情况。

scripts.text:
[Stello]
Since the condition of the dragon is very important in Lasagna, the vigilantes check it at all time.
scripts.translation:
[斯特洛]
龙的情况对罗札纳很重要，所以义警一直在监视它。

scripts.text:
[Stello]
Ask the vigilante how the dragon is doing and resolve the situation with the vigilante corps if any problem has occurred.
scripts.translation:
[斯特洛]
去问问义警那条龙的情况。如果出了问题，就和义警一起处理。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I see. Let me take a quick tour.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
知道了，我先四处看看。

scripts.text:
[Captain Gamberi]
Stello, I have told you how the way you dress shows what kind of Doram you are. Ad just your attire, please.
scripts.translation:
[船长 甘贝里]
斯特洛，我说过，你的穿着能体现多兰的风度。请整理一下仪容。

scripts.text:
[Stello]
This is too heavy, tight and annoying. This is just so uncomfortable.
scripts.translation:
[斯特洛]
这身衣服又重又紧，还很碍事，穿着太不舒服了。

scripts.text:
[Captain Gamberi]
You need to overcome the inconvenience to have a correct posture. The correct posture is your first step to become a gentleman. Do you get it, Stello?
scripts.translation:
[船长 甘贝里]
要保持端正的仪态，就得克服这些不便。仪态端正是成为绅士的第一步。明白了吗，斯特洛？

scripts.text:
[Captain Gamberi]
Stello, say it again.
scripts.translation:
[船长 甘贝里]
斯特洛，再说一遍。

scripts.text:
[Stello]
Yes, sir.
scripts.translation:
[斯特洛]
是，长官。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, is this...

[Stello]
Who are you? You are not allowed to enter hear with no permission. Please leave.
scripts.translation:
[斯特洛]
你是谁？未经许可不得进入这里，请离开。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hello, I am {1} who is on a new adventure.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你好，我是{1}，正在踏上新的冒险旅程。

scripts.text:
[Captain Gamberi]
A new adventurer. A polite Doram always knocks before entering. Since you must be nervous before the adventure, I'll let it slide this time.
scripts.translation:
[船长 甘贝里]
新来的冒险者啊。有教养的多兰进门前都会先敲门。看你出发前有些紧张，这次就算了。

scripts.text:
[Captain Gamberi]
I am Captain ^0000cdGamberi^000000 in charge of this ship. Welcome aboard.
scripts.translation:
[船长 甘贝里]
我是这艘船的船长^0000cd甘贝里^000000。欢迎登船。

scripts.text:
[Stello]
The Purser must have sent up another irrelevant visitor. He must have told you how the people from the same home town should stick together and all.
scripts.translation:
[斯特洛]
事务长肯定又放了个无关紧要的访客上来。他一定又跟你说什么同乡之间要互相照应之类的话了。

scripts.text:
[Stello]
Oh, I am not blaming you. I'll do my best to give you the best sailing adventure. I am ^0000cdStello^000000.
scripts.translation:
[斯特洛]
哦，我不是在怪你。我会尽力让你有一段愉快的航程。我叫^0000cd斯特洛^000000。

scripts.text:
[Captain Gamberi]
It may help you ease your nerve to walk around the ship. As long as you watch your manners, everyone will welcome you.
scripts.translation:
[船长 甘贝里]
在船上四处走走，也许能让你放松些。只要注意礼仪，大家都会欢迎你。

scripts.text:
[Stello]
Especially, you need to adjust your attire. The right outfit leads to a correct posture, and the correct posture is the first step to become a gentleman.
scripts.translation:
[斯特洛]
尤其要注意仪容。得体的穿着能让仪态更端正，而仪态端正是成为绅士的第一步。

scripts.text:
[Stello]
All the crews are such gentlemen, but they have no mercy for bad manners. You should be careful about this.
scripts.translation:
[斯特洛]
船员们都是绅士，但绝不容忍无礼的行为。你可得注意。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes, I will. Thank you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好的，我会注意。谢谢。

scripts.text:
[Captain Gamberi]
I am glad that an experienced adventurer like you is helping us. Ask the vigilante about the state of the dragon.
scripts.translation:
[船长 甘贝里]
有你这样经验丰富的冒险者帮忙，真是太好了。去问问义警那条龙的情况吧。

scripts.text:
[Captain Gamberi]
It would be a great idea to meet other members of the crew.
scripts.translation:
[船长 甘贝里]
去认识一下其他船员也不错。

scripts.text:
[Captain Gamberi]
Please tell it to Stello.
scripts.translation:
[船长 甘贝里]
去告诉斯特洛吧。

scripts.text:
[Captain Gamberi]
You need to calm down the dragon to sail off. Please do your bedt.
scripts.translation:
[船长 甘贝里]
要想起航，你得先让那条龙平静下来。尽力而为吧。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Excuse me, captain.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
船长，打扰一下。

scripts.text:
[Captain Gamberi]
What brought you here?
scripts.translation:
[船长 甘贝里]
有什么事？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I am here to fulfil ^0000cdmy duty as an adventurer^000000.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我来履行^0000cd身为冒险者的职责^000000。

scripts.text:
[Captain Gamberi]
The duty as an adventurer?
scripts.translation:
[船长 甘贝里]
冒险者的职责？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Other than setting off on an adventure, I collect adventure stories from other people. I have heard that Captain Gamberi, you have been in Lasagna for a long time.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
除了亲自冒险，我也会向别人收集冒险故事。听说甘贝里船长您在罗札纳待了很久。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Everyone says that I can hear the adventure stories regarding Lasagna and Con-Chliina from you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
大家都说，想听罗札纳和康奇利娜号的冒险故事，找您准没错。

scripts.text:
[Captain Gamberi]
Hum! Then you have found the right man. It is another adventure for me to tell an adventure story to an adventurer. Which story do you want hear now?
scripts.translation:
[船长 甘贝里]
哼！那你找对人了。给冒险者讲冒险故事，对我来说也是另一场冒险。你现在想听哪个故事？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I am interested in the story about you the most.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我最想听您的故事。

scripts.text:
[Gamberi]
I am from Lasagna. I was born to an honorable family and gentle parents. I grew up to become a curious and adventurous child.
scripts.translation:
[甘贝里]
我来自罗札纳，出生在一个体面的家庭，父母也很温和。我从小就充满好奇，喜欢冒险。

scripts.text:
[Gamberi]
I wanted to break free from the name of the family. I ran off and wandered around Lasagna.
scripts.translation:
[甘贝里]
我想摆脱家族的名声，于是离家出走，在罗札纳四处闯荡。

scripts.text:
[Stello]
Oh, strange. This is not the story I have heard from your mother, Captain. She said you didn't want to help the butcher's shop business, and you went out from the early morning.
scripts.translation:
[斯特洛]
奇怪，这和我从您母亲那里听到的故事不一样，船长。她说您不想帮忙打理肉铺，一大早就跑出去了。

scripts.text:
[Gamberi]
Stello, it is not polite to interrupt. I had a strong sense of justice and couldn't just let those bad Dorams disturbing peace in Lasagna. I had to ^0000cdlead them into the right path^000000.
scripts.translation:
[甘贝里]
斯特洛，插话可不礼貌。我当时正义感十足，没法对那些扰乱罗札纳安宁的坏多兰坐视不理。我必须^0000cd引导他们走上正途^000000。

scripts.text:
[Gamberi]
Then I met Pepperoncino.
scripts.translation:
[甘贝里]
后来我遇到了佩佩龙奇诺。

scripts.text:
[Stello]
I heard that story. That's why you were called the mad...
scripts.translation:
[斯特洛]
我听过这个故事。所以您才被叫作疯...

scripts.text:
[Gamberi]
I was interested in the fishing industry, and I went into the ^0000cdanchovy processing^000000 business with Pepperoncino. We made a fortune. We wondered what to do with all the money we had...
scripts.translation:
[甘贝里]
我对渔业很感兴趣，就和佩佩龙奇诺一起做起了^0000cd鳀鱼加工^000000生意。我们赚了很多钱，后来就开始琢磨该怎么花...

scripts.text:
[Stello]
It really was...
scripts.translation:
[斯特洛]
确实是...

scripts.text:
[Gamberi]
You may not see it now, but Lasagna used to be a dark place. Bad Dorams everywhere on the street, and there were a lot of fights.
scripts.translation:
[甘贝里]
你现在可能看不出来，罗札纳以前可是个黑暗的地方。街上到处都是坏多兰，打架斗殴更是家常便饭。

scripts.text:
[Gamberi]
It was my duty to ^0000cdlead those bad Dorams into the right path^000000.
scripts.translation:
[甘贝里]
引导那些坏多兰^0000cd走上正途^000000是我的职责。

scripts.text:
[Gamberi]
It was 10 years ago when peace was brought to this town as Pepperoncino and Thomas worked together in accord...
scripts.translation:
[甘贝里]
那是十年前，佩佩龙奇诺和托马斯齐心协力，为这座城镇带来了和平...

scripts.text:
[Stello]
You needed some manpower...
scripts.translation:
[斯特洛]
你们当时需要人手...

scripts.text:
[Gamberi]
I met Stello then. I ^0000cdcorrected Stello who was a pickpocket^000000 back then. He has become the Chief Office.
scripts.translation:
[甘贝里]
那时我遇到了斯特洛。我^0000cd改正了当时还是扒手的斯特洛^000000，他后来成了大副。

scripts.text:
[Stello]
Hum, Let's stop talking about it. It was ages ago.
scripts.translation:
[斯特洛]
嗯...别说了，都是很久以前的事了。

scripts.text:
[Gamberi]
I, Pepperoncino and Thomas wanted to pull off a major gig. A really big one. Nothing like what we had done by then. A business. I mean.
scripts.translation:
[甘贝里]
我、佩佩龙奇诺和托马斯想做一番大事业，真正的大事业，和以前做的那些都不一样。我是说，一门生意。

scripts.text:
[Gamberi]
The business we started was to ^0000cdsell the specialty products of Lasagna in other cities^000000. It went well, and we hired more people to expand the size of the business.
scripts.translation:
[甘贝里]
我们开始^0000cd把罗札纳的特产卖到其他城镇^000000。生意很顺利，于是我们雇了更多人，不断扩大规模。

scripts.text:
[Gamberi]
At the same time, we ran a ^0000cdvigilante corps^000000 to clean up the streets of Lasagna. Many people joined us for our cause.
scripts.translation:
[甘贝里]
与此同时，我们还组建了^0000cd义警团^000000来整顿罗札纳的街道。许多人为了这个目标加入了我们。

scripts.text:
[Stello]
Are you going to join me or get punched in the face? Are you going to keep living in the gutter? Who wouldn't join the vigilante corps hearing those threats...
scripts.translation:
[斯特洛]
你是要加入我们，还是等着挨揍？还想继续在街头混日子吗？听了这种威胁，谁还会不加入义警团呢...

scripts.text:
[Gamberi]
Stello?
scripts.translation:
[甘贝里]
斯特洛？

scripts.text:
[Stello]
No! I really wanted to join!
scripts.translation:
[斯特洛]
不是！我是真的想加入！

scripts.text:
[Gamberi]
I corrected those bad Dorams and formed the merchant group and the vigilante corps to engage in^0000cd trades^000000. The business thrived, and all the cities nearby were filled with the goods from Lasagna.
scripts.translation:
[甘贝里]
我让那些坏多兰改邪归正，又组建商队和义警团来经营^0000cd贸易^000000。生意越做越大，附近城镇到处都能看到罗札纳的商品。

scripts.text:
[Gamberi]
Anyway, we decided to extend our stage to the ^0000cdsea^000000. Such decision was made out of the adventurous spirit of mine.
scripts.translation:
[甘贝里]
后来，我们决定把事业扩展到^0000cd海上^000000。这个决定完全是出于我那颗热爱冒险的心。

scripts.text:
[Stello]
That was because Pepperoncino...
scripts.translation:
[斯特洛]
那是因为佩佩龙奇诺...

scripts.text:
[Gamberi]
And we were caught in a storm and parted with ^0000cdThomas' ship, Navi^000000. We kept on looking for Navi.
scripts.translation:
[甘贝里]
我们遭遇风暴，和^0000cd托马斯的船“纳维号”^000000失散了。之后我们一直在寻找纳维号。

scripts.text:
[Gamberi]
Then I pioneered the seaway to Malangdo with ^0000cdStello^000000 whom I had straightened, and reunited with Thomas. Eventually, we decided to advance into the new continent.
scripts.translation:
[甘贝里]
后来，我和^0000cd被我纠正过来的斯特洛^000000开辟了前往绵绵岛的航线，并与托马斯重逢。最终，我们决定进军新大陆。

scripts.text:
[Gamberi]
Ever since, we have been not only leading the trade with the new continent but also connecting the continents. The adventurers from both continents use ^0000cdCon-Chliina^000000, and we are proud of it.
scripts.translation:
[甘贝里]
从那以后，我们不仅主导着与新大陆的贸易，也成了连接两块大陆的桥梁。两边的冒险者都搭乘^0000cd康奇利娜号^000000，想到这一点我们就很自豪。

scripts.text:
[Gamberi]
Is this enough?
scripts.translation:
[甘贝里]
故事够精彩吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh, it was quite a story. I really appreciate your story. I believe that al the numerous adventures have made you the man who you are now, dear captain.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
真是精彩的故事，谢谢您愿意讲给我听。我相信，正是无数次冒险造就了今天的您，船长。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, I guess it is the time for me to go out looking for a new adventure, leaving this valuable experience behind.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我也该去寻找新的冒险了，把这段宝贵的经历留在心里。

scripts.text:
[Captain Gamberi]
Please come back later and tell me your story.
scripts.translation:
[船长 甘贝里]
过些时候再来，跟我讲讲你的故事吧。

scripts.text:
[Captain Gamberi]
Come find me if you have any questions.
scripts.translation:
[船长 甘贝里]
有问题的话，随时来找我。

scripts.text:
[Captain Gamberi]
I'd like to hear about the adventure story someday.
scripts.translation:
[船长 甘贝里]
希望哪天能听听你的冒险故事。

scripts.text:
[Captain Gamberi]
I'd like to hear your adventure stories from the new continent someday. Come visit me from time to time during the adventure.
scripts.translation:
[船长 甘贝里]
希望哪天能听听你在新大陆的冒险故事。冒险途中也常来看看我吧。

scripts.text:
[Recorder]
It looks a lot and large. How about cutting down some?
scripts.translation:
[记录员]
看起来又多又大。要不要删减一些？

scripts.text:
[Recorder]
Since it takes concentration, please don't interrupt me.
scripts.translation:
[记录员]
这需要集中精神，请别打扰我。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Excuse me.

[Recorder]
I told not to disturb... Oh, who are you?
scripts.translation:
[记录员]
我不是说了别打扰...咦，你是谁？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hello, I am {1}, looking for adventure from the new continent. I am here to say hi as the Purser has advised.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你好，我是{1}，正准备前往新大陆冒险。事务长建议我来跟你打声招呼。

scripts.text:
[Recorder]
Nice to meet you. I am the Recorder of this ship who is in charge of all records of this ship. You may come by whenever you have a question. You are free to access any records except the classified ones.
scripts.translation:
[记录员]
幸会。我是这艘船的记录员，负责管理船上的所有档案。有问题随时可以来找我。除了机密档案，你可以查阅其他所有记录。

scripts.text:
[Recorder]
Let me record your profile now. Oh, you don't need to do anything. You may just stand there.
scripts.translation:
[记录员]
我现在来记录一下你的资料。哦，你什么都不用做，站在那里就好。

scripts.text:
[Recorder]
Your name is... {0}... The height must be... and the color is... like this... The accent of yours... You must have lived in Pane and moved to Bongola.
scripts.translation:
[记录员]
你的名字是...{0}...身高应该是...发色是...这样...口音听起来...你一定在帕内住过，后来搬去了邦戈拉。

scripts.text:
[Recorder]
The dirt and grass on your feet... You are not a neat person... Oh, never mind. I am not writing down your faults... This is enough.
scripts.translation:
[记录员]
你脚上沾着泥土和草屑...看来不太爱干净...算了，我不会把缺点记下来的...这样就够了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
How do you know such things in detail?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你怎么能观察得这么仔细？

scripts.text:
[Recorder]
You just need to pay a little attention. It is just a technique I have picked up from observing people for a long time.
scripts.translation:
[记录员]
稍微留心就能发现。这只是我长期观察别人后学会的小技巧。

scripts.text:
[Recorder]
Let's see, you must have met the Captain and the Chief Officer. This place must be your second stop.
scripts.translation:
[记录员]
我想想，你应该已经见过船长和大副了。这里应该是你的第二站。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
That's right!

[Recorder]
Now is the time to see the ^0000cdHead Chef, the Helmsman and the Boatswain^000000. They must be in the ^0000cddining room^000000 at the end of the hallway. Have a safe voyage.
scripts.translation:
[记录员]
接下来该去见^0000cd主厨、舵手和水手长^000000了。他们应该在走廊尽头的^0000cd餐厅^000000里。祝你一路顺风。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ha! Yes. Thank you.

[Recorder]
You should go meet the Head Chef, the Helmsman and the Boatswain. They are in the dining room at the end of the hallway.
scripts.translation:
[记录员]
去见见主厨、舵手和水手长吧。他们都在走廊尽头的餐厅里。

scripts.text:
[Recorder]
Isn't it the time to meet the Purser?
scripts.translation:
[记录员]
你该去见事务长了吧？

scripts.text:
[Recorder]
You are on your way to meet the Sous Chef. He is in the dining room at the end of the hallway.
scripts.translation:
[记录员]
你正要去见副厨师长吧？他在走廊尽头的餐厅里。

scripts.text:
[Recorder]
You must be on your way back to the Purser. I was wondering since there hadn't been a sailing signal even after the scheduled time.
scripts.translation:
[记录员]
你应该是要回去找事务长吧？预定时间都过了还没发出起航信号，我正纳闷呢。

scripts.text:
[Recorder]
The Chief Officer and the Captain are the ones who issue the sailing signal. Asking them would be the fastest way to find out.
scripts.translation:
[记录员]
起航信号由船长和大副发出。直接问他们最快。

scripts.text:
[Recorder]
Are you heading there to meet the vigilante? I was about to go there to check out new members. As soon as the business her is taken care of, I'll go down there. Of course. with a notebook.
scripts.translation:
[记录员]
你要去见义警吗？我也正打算过去看看新成员。这边忙完我就下去，当然会带上笔记本。

scripts.text:
[Recorder]
You should go see the Captain and the Chief Officer. Everyone is waiting to set off.
scripts.translation:
[记录员]
去见船长和大副吧。大家都在等着起航。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Excuse me.

[Recorder]
I told not to disturb... Oh, who are you?
scripts.translation:
[记录员]
我不是说了别打扰...咦，你是谁？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hello, I am {1}, looking for adventure from the new continent. I am here to say hi as the Purser has advised.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你好，我是{1}，正准备前往新大陆冒险。事务长建议我来跟你打声招呼。

scripts.text:
[Recorder]
Oh, I see. Nice to meet you. I am the Recorder of this ship who is in charge of all records of this ship. You may come by whenever you have a question. You are free to access any records except the classified ones.
scripts.translation:
[记录员]
哦，明白了。幸会。我是这艘船的记录员，负责管理船上的所有档案。有问题随时可以来找我。除了机密档案，你可以查阅其他所有记录。

scripts.text:
[Recorder]
Let me record your profile now. Oh, you don't need to do anything. You may just stand there. Your name is... {0}...The height must be... and the color is... like this...
scripts.translation:
[记录员]
我现在来记录一下你的资料。哦，你什么都不用做，站在那里就好。你的名字是...{0}...身高应该是...发色是...这样...

scripts.text:
[Recorder]
Oh, never mind. I am not writing down your faults... This is enough.
scripts.translation:
[记录员]
算了，我不会把你的缺点记下来的...这样就够了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
How do you know such things in detail?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你怎么能观察得这么仔细？

scripts.text:
[Recorder]
You just need to pay a little attention. It is just a technique I have picked up from observing people for a long time.
scripts.translation:
[记录员]
稍微留心就能发现。这是我长期观察别人后掌握的小技巧。

scripts.text:
[Recorder]
Anyways, just in time. A mysterious thing has just happened, and I need ^0000cda fresh eye who is not involved in it^000000.
scripts.translation:
[记录员]
说来正巧，刚发生了一件怪事，我需要^0000cd一个不知情的旁观者来帮忙^000000。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I have a hunch that I have to leave this place now.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我有种预感，现在该离开这里了。

scripts.text:
[Recorder]
You may want to hear me out at least. As an adventurer, it helps to hear a lot of stories.
scripts.translation:
[记录员]
至少听我说完嘛。作为冒险者，多听些故事总有好处。

scripts.text: I will hear the story.
scripts.translation: 我愿意听。

scripts.text: I won't hear the story.
scripts.translation: 我不想听。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I won't listen to it. I don't want to get involved in another annoying business.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我不听。我可不想再卷进什么麻烦事。

scripts.text:
[Recorder]
Is that so? Well, it is not polite to get hold of a busy person.
scripts.translation:
[记录员]
这样啊。那就不打扰您了，毕竟您很忙。

scripts.text:
[Recorder]
However, if you change your mind, come back anytime. I'll be waiting for you.
scripts.translation:
[记录员]
不过，如果改变主意，随时可以回来。我会等着您。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I will hear the story.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我愿意听。

scripts.text:
[Recorder]
Good. Please take a look at this shelf here.
scripts.translation:
[记录员]
很好，请看看这边的书架。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
There are a lot of books.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这里有好多书。

scripts.text:
[Recorder]
They may look like books, but they are not. They are the records of all the things which have happened on the ship.
scripts.translation:
[记录员]
看起来像书，其实不是。这些是船上发生过的各种事情的记录。

scripts.text:
[Recorder]
It is consisted not only of the events which have happened on the ship but also of the history of almost every person who has anything to do with Con-Chliina.
scripts.translation:
[记录员]
里面不只有船上发生的事件，还记载着几乎所有与康奇利娜号有关的人和事。

scripts.text:
[Recorder]
The future can be seen through the past.
scripts.translation:
[记录员]
从过去可以窥见未来。

scripts.text:
[Recorder]
I don't just make new records. I also do my best to store the records at their best condition.
scripts.translation:
[记录员]
我不只负责撰写新记录，也会尽力妥善保存已有的记录。

scripts.text:
[Recorder]
However, someone has ^0000cddamaged one of the records in this place^000000.
scripts.translation:
[记录员]
可是有人^0000cd损坏了这里的一份记录^000000。

scripts.text:
[Recorder]
Whoever did that did not even tried to hide the deed. This person has just torn the entire book mercilessly. It was ruined.
scripts.translation:
[记录员]
那人甚至没想过掩盖行径，竟把整本书都撕得粉碎，彻底毁掉了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Huh! Is it a case in which I need to find the missing paged? The role of this fresh eye you are looking for is to provide a new insight to the investigation to solve the case?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
咦！是要我找回丢失的书页吗？您需要的“新视角”，是指让我为调查提供新的线索，帮忙破案？

scripts.text:
[Recorder]
No. The missing pages have been found. In the oven of the kitchen.
scripts.translation:
[记录员]
不，丢失的书页已经找到了，就在厨房的烤箱里。

scripts.text:
[Recorder]
Unfortunately, most of the pages were gone in the fire. I could barely recognize the remaining of the document.
scripts.translation:
[记录员]
可惜大部分书页都被火烧毁了，剩下的部分也几乎无法辨认。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What were the missing pages about?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那些丢失的书页记载了什么？

scripts.text:
[Recorder]
Unfortunately, those pages contained ^0000cdthe record about Captain Gamberi^000000. Since Gamberi is our captain, I have done my best to make the record.
scripts.translation:
[记录员]
可惜那些书页记载着^0000cd船长甘贝里的故事^000000。甘贝里是我们的船长，所以我一直很用心地整理他的故事。

scripts.text:
[Recorder]
The story about Captain Gamberi is included in all the books as well. And all of it was reduced to ashes.
scripts.translation:
[记录员]
所有记录中都收录了船长甘贝里的故事，可如今全都化为灰烬了。

scripts.text:
[Recorder]
The lost record was about the story of Captain Gamberi before he became the captain of Con-Chliina, which was very rare.
scripts.translation:
[记录员]
这份珍贵的记录讲述的是甘贝里船长成为康奇利娜号船长之前的经历。

scripts.text:
[Recorder]
It is because of the characteristic of Lasagna population. It is mostly consisted of the people from other regions. Captain Gamberi and Captain Thomas of Navi are pretty much the only people from Lasagna.
scripts.translation:
[记录员]
这是罗札纳居民的特点造成的。这里大多数人都来自其他地区，甘贝里船长和纳维号的托马斯船长几乎是唯二的本地人。

scripts.text:
[Recorder]
Most of the people who knew the past of Captain Gamberi have left Lasagna. There is almost no one who knows the past here now.
scripts.translation:
[记录员]
了解甘贝里船长过去的人大多已经离开罗札纳了。如今这里几乎没人知道他的往事。

scripts.text:
[Recorder]
That's why it has taken a long time to research and make the record.
scripts.translation:
[记录员]
所以调查和整理这份记录花了很长时间。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Should I help you find the thief then?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那我去帮您找出小偷？

scripts.text:
[Recorder]
No. I have found the thief already. I plan to punish him in the most painful way possible. However, there are things I have to take care of before that. That's why I am keeping it quiet.
scripts.translation:
[记录员]
不用，我已经找到小偷了。我打算用最痛苦的方式惩罚他。不过在那之前还有些事要处理，所以暂时保密。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Then what do you need a fresh eye for?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那您需要一个局外人做什么？

scripts.text:
[Recorder]
If I cannot recover it, I should rebuild it. I tried to interview Captain Gamberi to fill in the missing pages, but Gaptain Gamberi didn't respond.
scripts.translation:
[记录员]
既然无法复原，就只能重新整理。我试着采访甘贝里船长，补上缺失的内容，可他不肯回应。

scripts.text:
[Recorder]
I have sent many other people. It was no use. He wouldn't open up to anyone on Con-Chliina about his past. That is why I need a ^0000cdfresh eye^000000.
scripts.translation:
[记录员]
我还派了很多人去，全都没用。他不愿向康奇利娜号上的任何人透露过去。所以我才需要^0000cd一个局外人^000000。

scripts.text:
[Recorder]
He sometimes tells a stranger or a newbie ^0000cdhis story and how Lasagna has developed so far^000000 as he is telling some adventure stories. I'd like to send you to hear from him this time.
scripts.translation:
[记录员]
他有时会像讲冒险故事那样，向陌生人或新手^0000cd讲述自己的经历，以及罗札纳一路发展至今的故事^000000。这次我想请你去听听。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You mean that I should ask him about what happened in the past without giving him the impression that I have been asked by you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
您是说，我去问问他过去发生的事，但不能让他知道是您派我去的。

scripts.text:
[Recorder]
Yes, indeed. It should remain a secret. If Captain Gamberi finds out, you and I'd never get away.
scripts.translation:
[记录员]
正是如此。这必须保密。要是被甘贝里船长发现了，你我都别想脱身。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I see.

[Recorder]
Well, then. Have a safe trip.
scripts.translation:
[记录员]
那么，祝你一路顺风。

scripts.text:
[Recorder]
You can interview Captain Gamberi and tell me the story.
scripts.translation:
[记录员]
你可以去采访甘贝里船长，再把听到的故事告诉我。

scripts.text:
[Recorder]
You are here.
scripts.translation:
[记录员]
你回来了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I have heard from the story from Captain Gamberi, but I am very confused.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我听了甘贝里船长讲的故事，不过有些困惑。

scripts.text: [When you told the story you heard from Captain Gamberi and about how Stello interrupted, the Recorder started writing it down.]
scripts.translation: [你讲述从甘贝里船长那里听来的故事，以及斯特洛如何插话时，记录员开始做笔记。]

scripts.text:
[Recorder]
That is strange. I cannot remember all the records, but the story told by Captain Gamberi ^0000cdis different^000000 from the part of the record I do remember.
scripts.translation:
[记录员]
真奇怪。我记不住所有档案，但甘贝里船长^0000cd讲的故事^000000和我记得的档案内容不一样。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Was the story of the Chief Officer true then?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那么，大副说的故事是真的吗？

scripts.text:
[Recorder]
Well, I am not sure. We need to check out the story with other versions. Since there are discrepancies, I cannot make the record counting on the words of Captain Gamberi.
scripts.translation:
[记录员]
嗯，我也不确定。得找其他版本来核对。既然内容有出入，我不能只凭甘贝里船长的话来定稿。

scripts.text:
[Recorder]
It is a relief that we have more people to hear the story from, other than Captain Gamberi.
scripts.translation:
[记录员]
幸好除了甘贝里船长，我们还可以向其他人打听。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Who else?

[Recorder]
Although this person is not from Lasagna, he has spent meaningful amount of time with Captain Gamberi. You may go talk to him. We can compare the story from him with the interview with Captain Gamberi.
scripts.translation:
[记录员]
虽然那人不是罗札纳人，但他和甘贝里船长相处过很长时间。你可以去找他谈谈，再把他的说法和甘贝里船长的采访内容对照一下。

scripts.text:
[Recorder]
I am sorry to ask you again.
scripts.translation:
[记录员]
又要麻烦你，真不好意思。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Who is that?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那个人是谁？

scripts.text:
[Recorder]
I mean ^0000cdPepperoncino the leader of the vigilante corps^000000. He must be having an early meal at the new Adventurer Club now.
scripts.translation:
[记录员]
我是说^0000cd义警团首领佩佩龙奇诺^000000。他现在应该正在新建的冒险者俱乐部吃早饭。

scripts.text:
[Recorder]
You can enter the restaurant when you head to the south gate of the <NAVI>^4D4DFF[Adventurer Club]^000000<INFO>lasagna,56,186,000,1,</INFO></NAVI>.
scripts.translation:
[记录员]
从<NAVI>^4D4DFF[冒险者俱乐部]^000000<INFO>lasagna,56,186,000,1,</INFO></NAVI>南门进去，就能到餐厅。

scripts.text:
[Recorder]
You can interview Pepperoncino and tell me the story.
scripts.translation:
[记录员]
你可以去采访佩佩龙奇诺，再把听到的故事告诉我。

scripts.text:
[Recorder]
He must be having an early meal at the newly built <NAVI>^4D4DFF[Adventurer Club]^000000<INFO>lasagna,56,186,000,1,</INFO></NAVI> now. You can enter the restaurant when you head to the south gate.
scripts.translation:
[记录员]
他现在应该正在新建的<NAVI>^4D4DFF[冒险者俱乐部]^000000<INFO>lasagna,56,186,000,1,</INFO></NAVI>吃早饭。从南门进去就能到餐厅。

scripts.text:
[Recorder]
I guess you must have heard the actual story this time.
scripts.translation:
[记录员]
看来你这次听到了事情的真相。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
The story on Pepperoncino's side makes me more confused. Listen for yourself.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
佩佩龙奇诺的说法让我更困惑了。您自己听听看吧。

scripts.text: [When you told the story you heard from Pepperoncino and about how Olio interrupted, the Recorder started writing it down.]
scripts.translation: [你讲述从佩佩龙奇诺那里听来的故事，以及奥利奥如何插话时，记录员开始做笔记。]

scripts.text:
[Recorder]
The story from Pepperoncino doesn't quite make sense either. I can check out his story with the records.
scripts.translation:
[记录员]
佩佩龙奇诺的说法也有些不对劲。我可以对照档案来核实。

scripts.text:
[Recorder]
Let's see. Well, the story you heard is different from the record of Pepperoncino.
scripts.translation:
[记录员]
我看看...嗯，你听到的故事和档案里佩佩龙奇诺的记载不一样。

scripts.text:
[Recorder]
Not we cannot quite trust the story told by Pepperoncino. I cannot record the story I cannot trust.
scripts.translation:
[记录员]
看来佩佩龙奇诺的话也不完全可信。我不能把自己都不相信的故事写进档案。

scripts.text:
[Recorder]
However, I cannot let the records be lost like this. What should I do...
scripts.translation:
[记录员]
可是我不能就这样放任档案丢失...该怎么办呢？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
How about asking Captain Thomas of Navi?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
问问纳维号的托马斯船长怎么样？

scripts.text:
[Recorder]
As you can see, Captain Gamberi and Pepperoncino only tell the stories they like to tell. We cannot trust the story of Captain Thomas either.
scripts.translation:
[记录员]
你也看到了，甘贝里船长和佩佩龙奇诺只讲他们愿意讲的故事。托马斯船长的说法恐怕也不能全信。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
How about the story told by the oldest person in Lasagna?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
问问罗札纳最年长的那位怎么样？

scripts.text:
[Recorder]
Lasagna is somewhere you just drop by to make some dough when you are young. Most of them just leave this place...
scripts.translation:
[记录员]
罗札纳对很多人来说，只是年轻时来赚点钱的地方。大多数人之后都离开了...

scripts.text:
[Recorder]
Oh, you are right. There is ^0000cdthis one person^000000.
scripts.translation:
[记录员]
啊，你说得对。还有^0000cd那么一个人^000000。

scripts.text:
[Recorder]
Where the Adventurer Club is now, there used to be ^0000cdPub-Oven^000000. The place used to sell Kahlugna Milk. You can go to see ^0000cdthe first owner^000000 of the place. However...
scripts.translation:
[记录员]
冒险者俱乐部所在的地方以前是^0000cdPub-Oven^000000，那里曾经卖卡鲁纳牛奶。你可以去找那里的^0000cd第一任店主^000000。只是...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What's the problem?

[Recorder]
However, she doesn't think clearly now... I guess she may remember the past more vividly because of it. It is like she is living in the past.
scripts.translation:
[记录员]
不过，她现在神志不太清楚...也许正因为如此，她反而更清楚地记得过去，就像一直活在过去一样。

scripts.text:
[Recorder]
Go to meet ^0000cdthe old lady who used to be the owner of Pub-Oven^000000. She is living in a ^0000cd small house near the Adventurer Club^000000.
scripts.translation:
[记录员]
去找^0000cd曾经经营Pub-Oven的老妇人^000000吧。她住在^0000cd冒险者俱乐部附近的一间小屋里^000000。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes. I'll come back soon.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好的，我很快回来。

scripts.text:
[Recorder]
Go to see the old lady who used to be the first owner of Pub-Oven. She must be the house near it.
scripts.translation:
[记录员]
去看看那位曾经经营Pub-Oven的老妇人。她应该住在附近那间房子里。

scripts.text:
[Recorder]
Welcome. Thank you for your effort. Please report it now.
scripts.translation:
[记录员]
欢迎回来，辛苦了。请把情况告诉我。

scripts.text: [When you told the story about Captain Gamberi you heard from the old lady, the Recorder started writing it down.]
scripts.translation: [你讲述从老妇人那里听来的甘贝里船长故事时，记录员开始做笔记。]

scripts.text:
[Recorder]
Nice work. The story matches some of the details I remember. He sure is a living history. I guess I should fill in the records based on the story.
scripts.translation:
[记录员]
做得好。这个故事和我记得的一些细节吻合。他真是活历史啊。我会根据这个故事补全档案。

scripts.text:
[Recorder]
It will be filled with more abundant detailed than the previous record.
scripts.translation:
[记录员]
这次的档案会比之前的更加详尽。

scripts.text:
[Recorder]
Dear captain, what are you doing here?
scripts.translation:
[记录员]
船长，您怎么在这里？

scripts.text:
[Captain Gamberi]
You were in place. I am just checking if everyone is in the right place prior to the voyage.
scripts.translation:
[船长 甘贝里]
你在这里啊。我只是趁起航前确认一下大家是否都各就各位了。

scripts.text:
[Recorder]
Since when it has been your duty to check it? So quietly? Without a knock on the door?
scripts.translation:
[记录员]
什么时候检查文件成了您的职责？而且还偷偷摸摸的，连门都不敲？

scripts.text:
[Captain Gamberi]
As an experienced crew of Con-Chliina, one must be able to cope with any situation whenever they need to.
scripts.translation:
[船长 甘贝里]
身为康奇利娜号的老船员，无论遇到什么情况都得随时应对。

scripts.text:
[Recorder]
I see. ^0000cdIt must be the duty of the captain to tear and burn the document as well^000000, I guess.
scripts.translation:
[记录员]
我明白了。^0000cd撕毁并烧掉档案，大概也是船长的职责之一^000000吧。

scripts.text:
[Captain Gamberi]
Oh, hum. I should go check if the Boatswain in the right place.
scripts.translation:
[船长 甘贝里]
哦，嗯...我得去看看水手长是否在岗位上。

scripts.text:
[Recorder]
don't even think about it from now on!
scripts.translation:
[记录员]
以后可别再碰这些档案了！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Then, the captain must have...?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那么，船长他一定是...？

scripts.text:
[Recorder]
As more people started using the ship and accessing the record, he must have felt embarrassed by the record filled with his not so pretty past.
scripts.translation:
[记录员]
看的人越来越多，他大概是觉得档案里记载的那些不光彩往事让自己丢脸了。

scripts.text:
[Recorder]
I knew he would come again. He must have heard that I am recollecting the record. I though he would come back to get rid of it again. I guess I should be more careful not to lose it.
scripts.translation:
[记录员]
我就知道他还会再来。他肯定听说我在重整档案了。我还以为他会回来再毁一次...看来我得小心保管。

scripts.text:
[Recorder]
Dear adventurer. since you have completed your mission, here is the reward for you. You may access all documents in the recording room freely from now on. Well then.
scripts.translation:
[记录员]
亲爱的冒险者，既然你完成了任务，这就是给你的奖励。从今以后，你可以自由查阅记录室里的所有文件。那就这样吧。

scripts.text:
[Recorder]
You may access all documents in the recording room freely.
scripts.translation:
[记录员]
你可以自由查阅记录室里的所有文件。

scripts.text:
[Recorder]
Please do not touch the books.
scripts.translation:
[记录员]
请不要碰这些书。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Which one should I read first?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我该先读哪一本？

scripts.text: Ship's Log
scripts.translation: 船舶日志

scripts.text: Main Characters
scripts.translation: 主要人物

scripts.text: Glossary
scripts.translation: 词汇表

scripts.text: You close the book.
scripts.translation: 合上书

scripts.translation: 7年前

scripts.text: 6 years ago
scripts.translation: 6年前

scripts.text: 5 years ago
scripts.translation: 5年前

scripts.text: 4 years ago
scripts.translation: 4年前

scripts.text: 3 years ago
scripts.translation: 3年前

scripts.translation: 合上书

scripts.text:
Month X Day X
The long-awaited first voyage. After unloading everything, I hope we return as full ship again...
scripts.translation:
X月X日
期待已久的首次航行。卸下所有货物后，希望我们还能满载而归...

scripts.text:
Month X Day X
Business is good everywhere we go. I'm amazed by the insight of Captain Peperoncino and his crewmen.
scripts.translation:
X月X日
无论到哪里，生意都很好。佩佩龙奇诺船长和他的船员真有眼光。

scripts.text:
Month X Day X
Three days since we left Port Richoli. Met a storm. It's not the first time we experienced the fickleness of mother nature, but we can't help but feel dejected when counting the losses.
Seriously wounded 1, mildly wounded 13, top quality anchovies 23 boxes, kaluna 7 jars, beard comb 1 box, fine fabric 200 rolls.
scripts.translation:
X月X日
离开里乔利港已经三天了。我们遭遇了风暴。虽然不是第一次领教大自然的无常，但清点损失时还是忍不住沮丧。
重伤1人，轻伤13人，特级鳀鱼23箱，卡鲁纳牛奶7罐，胡须梳1箱，优质布料200卷。

scripts.text:
Month X Day X
A couple days ago we met a storm, but another one?! Who set the course this way at this time of the year? I guess I should let it go since It's the first time.
scripts.translation:
X月X日
前几天刚遇到风暴，怎么又来一个？！到底是谁选了这个季节走这条航线？看在是第一次的份上，就算了吧。

scripts.text:
Month X Day X
Nothing is up. Quiet. A shoal of flying fish over the ocean cast with full moon is just spectacular to watch.
scripts.translation:
X月X日
风平浪静。满月映照下，成群飞鱼跃出海面的景象真是壮观。

scripts.text:
Month X Day X
It's great to empty out all the cargo and return with new items loaded. I feel proud, It's like the feeling you get from gleaning and dispersing the crops widely.
scripts.translation:
X月X日
卸下所有货物，再装上新货满载而归，感觉真好。就像收获庄稼，再把它们播撒到各地一样，令人自豪。

scripts.text:
Month X Day X
A glass kaluna milk at a pub after receiving my paycheck is the sweetest thing in the world.
scripts.translation:
X月X日
领到薪水后，在酒馆喝一杯卡鲁纳牛奶，真是世上最甜美的享受。

scripts.text:
Month X Day X
Captain Gamberry and Captain Thomas are weird. They try to keep the lead in a straight line and sail on same speed. It's like having kids walk in steps.
scripts.translation:
X月X日
甘贝里船长和托马斯船长真奇怪。他们总想让船队排成直线，以相同的速度航行。简直像让一群小孩排队走路。

scripts.text:
Month X Day X
We run into storms so often that I'm wondering if we should change our course. Thank god we avoided the storm in Port Richoli.
scripts.translation:
X月X日
我们遇到风暴的次数太多了，真该考虑换条航线。幸好避开了里乔利港附近的风暴。

scripts.text:
Month X Day X
The sous chef we recruited from Port Richoli is just fantastic.
scripts.translation:
X月X日
我们从里乔利港招来的副厨师长真了不起。

scripts.text:
Month X Day X
We lost Butterfly to the storm we met on the second day we left Port Richoli. We were so devastated that no one was able to say anything when we returned to Lasagna.
scripts.translation:
X月X日
离开里乔利港第二天遇到风暴时，“蝴蝶号”失踪了。大家悲痛欲绝，回到罗札纳时谁都说不出话来。

scripts.text:
Month X Day X
No sailing for a while.
scripts.translation:
X月X日
暂时停止航行。

scripts.text:
Month X Day X
It feels like everyone will be back and smiling if I go to the port.
scripts.translation:
X月X日
总觉得只要去港口看看，大家就会回来，重新露出笑容。

scripts.text:
Month X Day X
No news still.
scripts.translation:
X月X日
依然没有消息。

scripts.text:
Month X Day X
A search for Butterfly, second time. Nothing. We couldn't find any remnants of Butterfly. So they must be safe.
scripts.translation:
X月X日
第二次搜寻“蝴蝶号”，还是一无所获。没找到任何残骸，也就是说，他们一定平安无事。

scripts.text:
Month X Day X
Still no news on Butterfly.
scripts.translation:
X月X日
仍然没有“蝴蝶号”的消息。

scripts.text:
Month X Day X
Helmsman caught tuna by fishing. Chef tried to steam the whole fish but the sous chef barely stopped him and cut into pieces for everyone. I wish I can have some more.
scripts.translation:
X月X日
舵手钓到了一条金枪鱼。厨师想整条蒸，被副厨师长好不容易拦住，切成小块分给大家。真想再吃一些。

scripts.text:
Month X Day X
Tuna is served again. First day was tuna, second day was tuna pasta, third day was fried tuna, fourth day was braised tuna... I'm sick of it. Just had it. Did we do something to anger the sous chef?
scripts.translation:
X月X日
又吃金枪鱼。第一天是金枪鱼，第二天是金枪鱼意面，第三天是炸金枪鱼，第四天是炖金枪鱼...我吃腻了，刚才才吃过。我们是不是惹副厨师长生气了？

scripts.text:
Month X Day X
Boatswain tried to throw out the remaining tuna and got caught by the sous chef. We all learned how scary he can be.
scripts.translation:
X月X日
水手长想把剩下的金枪鱼扔掉，结果被副厨师长逮个正着。我们这才知道他有多可怕。

scripts.text:
Month X Day X
We met a storm. Everyone was well-prepared, so the damage was not huge. I guess this is what a know-how is.
scripts.translation:
X月X日
遭遇风暴。幸好大家准备充分，损失不大。这大概就是经验的价值吧。

scripts.text:
Month X Day X
Boatswain is acting strangely. We barely stopped him from trying to jump into water in the middle of a night. He seems to have lost it when I see him shivering all over, but then he's fine the next morning. He's bewitched or something.
scripts.translation:
X月X日
水手长最近举止怪异。半夜里他差点跳进海里，我们好不容易才拦住。那晚他浑身发抖，像是失了神，第二天早上却又恢复正常。莫非是中邪了？

scripts.text:
Month X Day X
Still searching. No news on Butterfly.
scripts.translation:
X月X日
还在搜寻。“蝴蝶号”仍然没有消息。

scripts.text:
Month X Day X
We never had any rats but all of a sudden the ship is infested. Upon investigation, the boatswain... you're such a...
scripts.translation:
X月X日
船上从来没有老鼠，最近却突然闹起鼠患。调查后发现是水手长...你这家伙...

scripts.text:
Month X Day X
A year may pass but we cannot give up the search. We're combing through the area where we lost them.
scripts.translation:
X月X日
一年过去了，我们仍不能放弃搜寻。正在仔细搜索他们失踪的那片海域。

scripts.text:
Month X Day X
I don't know why, but I don't like the feel of this.
scripts.translation:
X月X日
不知为何，总觉得哪里不对劲。

scripts.text:
Month X Day X
Storm. So sick of storms. We're so used to it that we can practically ride over it.
scripts.translation:
X月X日
又是风暴。真受够了。我们都习惯了，甚至几乎能在风暴中航行。

scripts.text:
Month X Day X
You turned our ship because Stello claimed to have seen something strange last night. It's a route that we've never seen before. Everyone had different opinions, but since we had looked everywhere we can, we decided to give it a try.
scripts.translation:
X月X日
斯特洛说昨晚看见了奇怪的东西，于是我们改变航向，驶上一条从未见过的路线。大家意见不一，但能找的地方都找遍了，只好试试看。

scripts.text:
Month X Day X
I had a strange dream.
scripts.translation:
X月X日
我做了个奇怪的梦。

scripts.text:
Month X Day X
When we went through the dense fog that appeared suddenly, there was an island we had never seen before. There were the Butterfly crewmen, their presence natural like the natives.
scripts.translation:
X月X日
穿过突然出现的浓雾后，我们发现了一座从未见过的岛。蝴蝶号的船员们也在那里，仿佛他们本来就是当地居民。

scripts.text:
Month X Day X
Where we had landed softly after being hit by huge waves is called the Soft Island. This is a mysterious place inhabited by people with different appearances. It's a discovery of a new world.
scripts.translation:
X月X日
巨浪把我们推上岸后，我们平安着陆的地方被称作软岛。那里住着外貌各异的人，是个神秘的地方。我们发现了一个新世界。

scripts.text:
Month X Day X
Using Soft Island as the base, Butterfly already had a footing in the new world and was making profits. They are just born to be merchants.
scripts.translation:
X月X日
蝴蝶号以软岛为基地，已经在新世界站稳脚跟，开始赚钱了。他们真是天生的商人。

scripts.text:
Month X Day X
We are on our way to Lasagna. Captain Gamberry and Captain Thomas had a long conversation.
scripts.translation:
X月X日
我们正在返回罗札纳。甘贝里船长和托马斯船长谈了很久。

scripts.text:
Month X Day X
Arrived in Lasagna. Drank five glasses of kaluna milk.
scripts.translation:
X月X日
抵达罗札纳。喝了五杯卡鲁纳牛奶。

scripts.text:
3 years ago: decided to set sail
Month X Day X
We are heading to the new world loaded with supplies. I wanted to take a close look and this is a great opportunity.
scripts.translation:
3年前：决定启航
X月X日
我们满载补给，正驶向新世界。我一直想亲眼看看那里，这次终于有机会了。

scripts.text:
Month X Day X
Storm again.
scripts.translation:
X月X日
又遇到风暴。

scripts.text:
Month X Day X
Arrived in Soft Island. I don't know how we found the way in the vast open sea, but It's still amazing.
scripts.translation:
X月X日
抵达软岛。不知道我们是怎么在茫茫大海中找到这里的，但这仍然令人惊叹。

scripts.text:
Month X Day X
Captain Gamberry and Captain Thomas officially announced their expansion plan to the new world. Con-Chliina will be in charge of recruiting and sending adventurers to the new world
And Farfalle Vigilantes will be in charge of training them. With Soft Island as its base, Butterfly agreed to support adventurers. Preparation time is three years.
scripts.translation:
X月X日
甘贝里船长和托马斯船长正式宣布了进军新世界的计划。康奇利娜号负责招募冒险者并将他们送往新世界，法尔法雷义警团负责训练他们。蝴蝶号将以软岛为基地，为冒险者提供支援。准备时间是三年。

scripts.text:
Month X Day X
I came up with items that can be sold between the new world and Far-Star. I'm surprised at how different their tastes are. Really surprised to hear the price of Igdrasil fruit.
scripts.translation:
X月X日
我想到了可以在新世界和远星之间交易的商品。两边的喜好差异真大。伊格德拉希尔果实的价格更是让我大吃一惊。

scripts.text:
Month X Day X
Sailed out from Soft Island. We'll probably come a few more times.
scripts.translation:
X月X日
我们从软岛启航。以后大概还会再来几次。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
There's nothing to see.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这里没什么好看的。

scripts.text: Gamberry
scripts.translation: 甘贝里

scripts.text: Peperoncino
scripts.translation: 佩佩龙奇诺

scripts.text: Tomei Thomas
scripts.translation: 托梅·托马斯

scripts.text: You close the book.
scripts.translation: 合上书

scripts.text:
- Gamberry -
Captain of Con-Chliina.
Nickname is Berry.
Kaluna milk should be stirred.
scripts.translation:
- 甘贝里 -
康奇利娜号的船长。
绰号是贝里。
卡鲁纳牛奶要搅拌着喝。

scripts.text:
- Gamberry -
His parents ran a butcher's shop in Lasagna.
scripts.translation:
- 甘贝里 -
他的父母在罗札纳经营肉铺。

scripts.text:
- Gamberry -
When he was young, he couldn't resist using violence to rehab hoodlum dorams. Thus, he is called the mad dog of Lasagna.
scripts.translation:
- 甘贝里 -
年轻时，他总忍不住用暴力教训那些流氓多兰，因此得了“罗札纳疯狗”的绰号。

scripts.text:
- Gamberry -
He met Peperoncino (current chief of Farfalle Vigilantes) at Pub-Oven by having disagreements over how to drink kaluna.
scripts.translation:
- 甘贝里 -
他在Pub-Oven与佩佩龙奇诺因卡鲁纳牛奶的喝法起了争执，两人因此相识。佩佩龙奇诺后来成了法尔法雷义警团的首领。

scripts.text:
- Gamberry -
He ended up working at the anchovy workshop with Peperoncino due to the debt he incurred at this time. Gamberry was recognized for his skills and became the workshop manager.
scripts.translation:
- 甘贝里 -
那次欠下债务后，他和佩佩龙奇诺一起到鳀鱼工坊工作。甘贝里的手艺得到赏识，后来当上了工坊经理。

scripts.text:
- Gamberry -
They organized a merchant business with Thomas (current captain of Butterfly) who joined later.
scripts.translation:
- 甘贝里 -
后来托马斯（现任蝴蝶号船长）也加入了他们，三人一起组建商队。

scripts.text:
- Gamberry -
Having decided to expand their domain to the sea, Gamberry and Thomas gathered a fleet and sailed out, but Captain Thomas went missing in a storm.
scripts.translation:
- 甘贝里 -
决定把事业扩展到海上后，甘贝里和托马斯集结舰队出航，但托马斯船长在风暴中失踪了。

scripts.text:
- Gamberry -
Stello, Con-Chliina's first officer, discovered the sea route and finally found Butterfly that had safely reached Soft Island in the new world.
scripts.translation:
- 甘贝里 -
康奇利娜号的大副斯特洛发现了这条航线，最终找到了已平安抵达新世界软岛的蝴蝶号。

scripts.text:
- Gamberry -
Currently sails on the liner that connects Lasagna to the new world.
scripts.translation:
- 甘贝里 -
目前担任往返罗札纳与新世界的定期航线船长。

scripts.text:
- Peperoncino -
Chief of Farfalle Vigilantes.
Nickname is Pepe.
Kaluna milk should be shaken.
scripts.translation:
- 佩佩龙奇诺 -
法尔法雷义警团的首领。
绰号是佩佩。
卡鲁纳牛奶要摇匀了喝。

scripts.text:
- Peperoncino -
Besides the fact that he grew up poor in Fusilli, nothing else is known about his early days.
scripts.translation:
- 佩佩龙奇诺 -
除了知道他早年在富西利过着贫困生活，其他事情都不清楚。

scripts.text:
- Peperoncino -
He came to Lasagna with a grand plan to make a fortune by working on an anchovy fishing line, but gave up because of seasickness.
scripts.translation:
- 佩佩龙奇诺 -
他怀着靠捕捞鳀鱼发大财的宏愿来到罗札纳，却因晕船而放弃了。

scripts.text:
- Peperoncino -
Later, he began working at an anchovy workshop.
scripts.translation:
- 佩佩龙奇诺 -
后来，他开始在鳀鱼工坊工作。

scripts.text:
- Peperoncino -
He met Gamberry (current captain of Con-Chliina) at Pub-Oven by having disagreements over how to drink kaluna.
scripts.translation:
- 佩佩龙奇诺 -
他在Pub-Oven与甘贝里（现任康奇利娜号船长）因卡鲁纳牛奶的喝法起了争执，两人因此相识。

scripts.text:
- Peperoncino -
He ended up working at the anchovy workshop with Gamberry due to the debt he incurred at this time.
scripts.translation:
- 佩佩龙奇诺 -
因为当时欠下了债，他最后和甘贝里一起到鳀鱼工坊工作。

scripts.text:
- Peperoncino -
They organized a merchant business with Thomas (current captain of Butterfly) who joined later.
scripts.translation:
- 佩佩龙奇诺 -
后来托马斯（现任蝴蝶号船长）加入了他们，三人一起经营起商队。

scripts.text:
- Peperoncino -
When Gamberry and Thomas gathered a fleet and set out, Peperoncino organized and manages to this day Farfalle Vigilantes to maintain pubic order of Lasagna.
scripts.translation:
- 佩佩龙奇诺 -
甘贝里和托马斯集结舰队出海后，佩佩龙奇诺组建了法尔法雷义警团，并一直管理至今，负责维护罗札纳的治安。

scripts.text:
- Tomei Thomas -
Captain of Butterfly.
Nickname is Toto.
Kaluna milk should be shaken.
scripts.translation:
- 托梅·托马斯 -
蝴蝶号的船长。
绰号是托托。
卡鲁纳牛奶要摇匀了喝。

scripts.text:
- Tomei Thomas -
Born as Tomei Thomas but shortened to Thomas.
scripts.translation:
- 托梅·托马斯 -
本名托梅·托马斯，后来简称托马斯。

scripts.text:
- Tomei Thomas -
Native of Lasagna, brought up affluently thanks to his wealthy parents.
scripts.translation:
- 托梅·托马斯 -
他是罗札纳人，父母富有，从小过着优渥的生活。

scripts.text:
- Tomei Thomas -
Grew up with Gamberry (current captain of Con-Chliina) as childhood friends.
scripts.translation:
- 托梅·托马斯 -
他和甘贝里（现任康奇利娜号船长）从小就是朋友。

scripts.text:
- Tomei Thomas -
Worked with Gamberry and Peperoncino (current chief of Farfalle Vigilantes) at the anchovy workshop as a hobby.
scripts.translation:
- 托梅·托马斯 -
他曾把在鳀鱼工坊和甘贝里、佩佩龙奇诺（现任法尔法雷义警团首领）一起工作当作兴趣。

scripts.text:
- Tomei Thomas -
While the two spent all the money to pay off their debts, Thomas was able to save his wages. This became the initial fund for the merchant business.
scripts.translation:
- 托梅·托马斯 -
甘贝里和佩佩龙奇诺花光所有钱偿还债务时，托马斯却攒下了工资。这笔钱成了商队的启动资金。

scripts.text:
- Tomei Thomas -
Having decided to expand their domain to the sea, Gamberry and Thomas gathered a fleet and sailed out, but Captain Thomas went missing in a storm.
scripts.translation:
- 托梅·托马斯 -
甘贝里和托马斯决定把事业扩展到海上，于是集结舰队出航，但托马斯船长在风暴中失踪了。

scripts.text:
- Tomei Thomas -
Later, he safely arrived and settled in Soft Island of the new world. He's steadily expanding his domain.
scripts.translation:
- 托梅·托马斯 -
后来，他平安抵达新世界的软岛并在那里定居，如今仍在稳步拓展事业。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
There's nothing to see.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这里没什么好看的。

scripts.text:
^0000cd[Pub-Oven]^000000
The place where Thomas, Peperoncino, and Gamberry met up to make agreements.
scripts.translation:
^0000cd[Pub-Oven]^000000
托马斯、佩佩龙奇诺和甘贝里曾在这里聚会并商定合作。

scripts.text:
^0000cd[Pub-Oven]^000000
Today, it is an adventurers' club and a memorial, a must-see place for dorams going on an adventure.
scripts.translation:
^0000cd[Pub-Oven]^000000
如今这里是冒险者俱乐部兼纪念馆，是准备启程冒险的多兰必访之地。

scripts.text:
^0000cd[Kaluna Milk]^000000
A beverage made by mixing kaluna and milk that three dorams drank when they met up. In their memory, it is now a festival beverage.
scripts.translation:
^0000cd[卡鲁纳牛奶]^000000
这是一种用卡鲁纳和牛奶调制的饮料，三位多兰当年聚会时常喝。为了纪念他们，如今它成了节庆饮品。

scripts.text:
^0000cd[Kaluna Milk]^000000
Mixing is usually done by stirring or shaking, but there is never-ending argument about these two methods.
scripts.translation:
^0000cd[卡鲁纳牛奶]^000000
通常可以搅拌或摇晃来混合，但这两种做法引发的争论从未停歇。

scripts.text:
^0000cd[Kaluna Milk]^000000
Depending on preference, one to three gooseberries can be added.
scripts.translation:
^0000cd[卡鲁纳牛奶]^000000
可按个人喜好加入一到三颗鹅莓。

scripts.text:
^0000cd[Oven Resolution]^000000
Refers to the brotherhood formed in agreement by Thomas, Peperoncino, and Gamberry.
scripts.translation:
^0000cd[炉火之约]^000000
指托马斯、佩佩龙奇诺和甘贝里达成共识后结下的兄弟情谊。

scripts.text:
^0000cd[Butterfly]^000000
Known to have gone missing in a storm but later found to have safely arrived and established in the new world. After the news spread, Butterfly became widely known as the icon of adventure and heroes.
scripts.translation:
^0000cd[蝴蝶号]^000000
据说它曾在风暴中失踪，后来才发现它已平安抵达并在新世界建立据点。消息传开后，蝴蝶号成了冒险与英雄精神的象征。

scripts.text:
^0000cd[L-Day]^000000
Abbreviation of Lasagna Day. It is the day when Butterfly, safely arrived in the new world, was found through the discovery of a new sea route after 32 search attempts.
scripts.translation:
^0000cd[L日]^000000
“罗札纳日”的简称。经过32次搜寻，人们发现蝴蝶号已平安抵达新世界，并在这一天开辟了新的海上航线。

scripts.text:
^0000cd[L-Day]^000000
Lasagna celebrates this day annually with magnificent fireworks and festivals.
scripts.translation:
^0000cd[L日]^000000
罗札纳每年都会在这一天举办盛大的烟火表演和庆典。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
There's nothing to see.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这里没什么好看的。

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
It looks a lot and large. How about cutting down some?
scripts.translation:
[水手长]
东西又多又大。要不要精简一些？

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
Doll, check.
Bell, check.
Dried Star Lilly, check.
Rope tied 33 times, check.
5 creases on the sail, check. Good!
scripts.translation:
[水手长]
玩偶，确认。
铃铛，确认。
干制星百合，确认。
绳子打了33个结，确认。
帆上有5道褶皱，确认。很好！

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
What! Who broke this Pussy Willow branch!
scripts.translation:
[水手长]
什么！是谁折断了这根柳枝！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hello, I am {1} who is on a new adventure this time. Nice to meet you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你好，我是{1}，这次要踏上新的冒险旅程。幸会。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
......

[Boatswain]
Oh, you are the newly trained adventurer setting off on an adventure to the new continent. I am fond of an adventurous spirit. I used to travel from a place to another when I was young.
scripts.translation:
[水手长]
哦，你就是受训完毕、准备前往新大陆冒险的新手啊。我很欣赏冒险精神。年轻时我也到处旅行。

scripts.text:
[Helmsman]
Exactly when was it? How long ago?
scripts.translation:
[舵手]
那是什么时候？多久以前的事了？

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
Not long ago. It feels like it happened just yesterday.
scripts.translation:
[水手长]
没多久以前，感觉就像昨天才发生的一样。

scripts.text:
[Helmsman]
Yesterday, you were running on the deck in the middle of the night.
scripts.translation:
[舵手]
昨天你还半夜在甲板上跑来跑去呢。

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
Phew, such nonsense.
scripts.translation:
[水手长]
哎呀，胡说什么呢。

scripts.text:
[Sous Chef]
Hey, I get it. It is too noisy there. You may go now.
scripts.translation:
[副厨师长]
好了，我知道了。那边太吵了，你可以走了。

scripts.text:
[Boatswain]
The Sous Chef is always on the edge before sailing off. don't take it personally.
scripts.translation:
[水手长]
副厨师长起航前总是很紧张，别往心里去。

scripts.text:
[Helmsman]
