scripts.translation:
[老奶奶]
巴西利斯克现在还待在洞穴里吗？我们年轻时连洞穴附近都不敢靠近。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
So what happened then? They showed up at the pub and what did they do?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
后来发生什么了？他们来到酒馆后做了什么？

scripts.text:
[Grandma]
Oh, right. Pepe looked like a homeless and ordered kaluna milk. That's when Berry picked a fight, saying that only the kids have it shaken.
scripts.translation:
[老奶奶]
哦，对了。佩佩当时看起来像个流浪汉，点了一杯卡鲁纳牛奶。贝里就挑起了争执，说只有小孩子才喝搅拌过的。

scripts.text:
[Grandma]
So they ^0000cdfought^000000. My ^0000cdstore was destroyed^000000. So I made a ^0000cdclaim for damages^000000 for broken furniture and profit loss until the pub was back in business.
scripts.translation:
[老奶奶]
于是他们^0000cd打了起来^000000。^0000cd砸坏了我的酒馆^000000。家具损坏了，酒馆也停业了好一阵，我只好^0000cd向他们索赔^000000。

scripts.text:
[Grandma]
You mentioned Pepe. Seemed like he was poor there as well. He came to Lasagna after hearing from somewhere that he can make a lot of money on anchovy fishing boat, but quit because of seasickness.
scripts.translation:
[老奶奶]
你提到佩佩了。看来他当时也很穷。他听说在鳀鱼船上能赚大钱，就来到了罗札纳，却因为晕船放弃了。

scripts.text:
[Grandma]
After that, he couldn't get on a boat ever again. Haha. He became indebted because of the ^0000cdpenalty for breach of contract^000000 and couldn't leave. So he ended up in the anchovy workshop where he removes anchovy head and guts...
scripts.translation:
[老奶奶]
从那以后，他再也没法上船了，哈哈。他因为^0000cd违约金^000000欠了债，没法离开，最后只好在鳀鱼工坊给鳀鱼去头、清内脏...

scripts.text:
[Grandma]
Anyway, he had a huge debt from the boat and pub. The two mulled over what to do and ended up at the ^0000cdanchovy workshop^000000. Few years later, ^0000cdGamberry became the workshop manager^000000. The job was perfect for him.
scripts.translation:
[老奶奶]
总之，他欠下了船费和酒馆的债。他们商量一番后，去了^0000cd鳀鱼工坊^000000。几年后，^0000cd甘贝里成了工坊经理^000000，那里正适合他。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
How was Lasagna in the old days?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
以前的罗札纳是什么样的？

scripts.text:
[Grandma]
don't even mention it. It was a mess. The roads were awful. People were awful. there's a reason why the past is called the dark ages.
scripts.translation:
[老奶奶]
别提了，一团糟。道路糟糕，人也糟糕。过去会被称为“黑暗时代”，不是没有原因的。

scripts.text:
[Grandma]
Have you ever stepped on fish guts on a road? That's how Lasagna was back then.
scripts.translation:
[老奶奶]
你试过在路上踩到鱼内脏吗？以前的罗札纳到处都是那样。

scripts.text:
[Grandma]
Then one day, two roughnecks came up with the merchants and vigilance corps and started beating up Lasagna kids.
scripts.translation:
[老奶奶]
后来有一天，两个粗汉带着商人和义警团来到这里，开始教训罗札纳的混混。

scripts.text:
[Grandma]
I guess sticks do make dorams. The two sent those hoodlums to the merchants and vigilance corps. Mm... I remember those boys. Their beards were cut and tails were tattered.
scripts.translation:
[老奶奶]
看来棍棒底下真能出多兰。那两人把那些混混分派给商人和义警团。嗯...我记得那两个小伙子，他们剃掉了胡须，尾巴也弄得破破烂烂的。

scripts.text:
[Grandma]
Those doram mouse-looking ones all left Lasagna and only the ones who wanted to live a decent life stayed. They're the ones who made current Lasagna.
scripts.translation:
[老奶奶]
那些长得像老鼠的多兰都离开了罗札纳，只剩下一心想好好生活的人留了下来。正是他们造就了今天的罗札纳。

scripts.text:
[Grandma]
But who are you? Did you come to order kaluna milk? Stirred or shaken? Where did all my workers go?
scripts.translation:
[老奶奶]
不过，你是谁？来点卡鲁纳牛奶的吗？要搅拌还是摇匀？我的员工都去哪儿了？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'll get going now...

[Grandma]
With no customers, my pub will soon be out of business.
scripts.translation:
[老奶奶]
再没有客人上门，我的酒馆就要关门了。

scripts.text:
[Grandma]
If you're not going to order anything, get the heck out!
scripts.translation:
[老奶奶]
不点东西就赶紧滚出去！

scripts.text:
[Grandma]
Zzz...zzzz...
scripts.translation:
[老奶奶]
呼...呼呼...

scripts.text:
[Kalu]
It looks huge and heavy. Go and get rid of some.
scripts.translation:
[卡卢]
这东西看起来又大又重，去处理掉一些吧。

scripts.text:
[Kalu]
If you wish to speak to me, then you'd better go and get some more experience.
scripts.translation:
[卡卢]
想跟我说话的话，先去多积攒些经验再来。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
A glass of kaluna milk please.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
请给我一杯卡鲁纳牛奶。

scripts.text: Stirred.
scripts.translation: 搅拌

scripts.text: Shaken.
scripts.translation: 摇匀

scripts.text:
[Kalu]
If you want to drink kaluna milk, then go see the guy next door. But you'd better hurry. Stirred or shaken, that won't matter pretty soon.
scripts.translation:
[卡卢]
想喝卡鲁纳牛奶就去找隔壁那位。不过最好快点，不管搅拌还是摇匀，很快就都喝不到了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What is going on?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
怎么回事？

scripts.text:
[Kalu]
You know what the main ingredients of kaluna milk are? They're ^0000cdkaluna^000000, the essence made from fermenting a special shellfish called ^0000cdkalunyak^000000, and fresh milk.
scripts.translation:
[卡卢]
你知道卡鲁纳牛奶的主要原料吗？有^0000cd卡鲁纳^000000、用一种叫^0000cd卡鲁尼亚克^000000的特殊贝类发酵制成的精华，还有新鲜牛奶。

scripts.text:
[Kalu]
Mix that in moderate temperate and garnish with a gooseberry. And then you get the kaluna milk that everyone loves.
scripts.translation:
[卡卢]
按适当比例混合，再放上一颗鹅莓点缀，大家最爱的卡鲁纳牛奶就做好了。

scripts.text:
[Kalu]
But we're almost finished with the kaluna in store and the person who supplies us hasn't been here for days. Even the ones we had in stockpile are nearly gone.
scripts.translation:
[卡卢]
可是店里的卡鲁纳快用完了，供应商已经好几天没来。连储备的也所剩无几。

scripts.text:
[Kalu]
Without kaluna, there's no kaluna milk. You get what that means?
scripts.translation:
[卡卢]
没有卡鲁纳，就做不了卡鲁纳牛奶。明白这意味着什么吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What does it mean?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这意味着什么？

scripts.text:
[Kalu]
It means customers who came for kaluna milk would have made their trip in vain.
scripts.translation:
[卡卢]
那些专程来喝卡鲁纳牛奶的客人就要白跑一趟了。

scripts.text:
[Kalu]
Angry people who didn't get to drink kaluna milk will soon cause a ^0000cdriot^000000, and soon it will spread over the entire Lasagna.
scripts.translation:
[卡卢]
喝不到卡鲁纳牛奶的客人会愤怒地^0000cd闹事^000000，恐怕很快就会波及整个罗札纳。

scripts.text:
[Kalu]
Then Lasagna will return to its former state of filth and danger. I can't let that happen. We're finally living like decent human beings but to go back to that dark age...
scripts.translation:
[卡卢]
那样罗札纳就会变回从前那个肮脏又危险的地方。我绝不能让这种事发生。我们好不容易才过上安稳日子，难道又要回到黑暗时代...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm sure that won't happen just over a glass of kaluna milk.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我想不至于因为一杯卡鲁纳牛奶就闹成那样吧。

scripts.text:
[Kalu]
You don't understand what kaluna milk means for people of Lasagna. It's not merely a drink that relaxes the body for these people.
scripts.translation:
[卡卢]
你不懂卡鲁纳牛奶对罗札纳人有多重要。它可不只是能让人放松的饮料。

scripts.text:
[Kalu]
Kaluna milk also symbolizes ^0000cdfaith and friendship, as well as festival^000000. I can't discuss the details here, but if you're curious, go see the bookkeeper of Con-Chliina.
scripts.translation:
[卡卢]
卡鲁纳牛奶还象征着^0000cd信任、友谊和节庆^000000。详情我不方便在这里说。想知道的话，就去问问康奇利娜号的记录员。

scripts.text:
[Kalu]
He's a recording maniac who loves to record everything.
scripts.translation:
[卡卢]
他是个记录狂，什么事情都喜欢记下来。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm not exactly sure, but I can tell It's really important for people here.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我不太清楚，不过能感觉到它对这里的人很重要。

scripts.text:
[Kalu]
Right. That's what I'm talking about. You always start or finish the day with kaluna milk. But that kaluna is nearly all gone!
scripts.translation:
[卡卢]
没错，我说的就是这个。人们总以卡鲁纳牛奶开启或结束一天，可现在卡鲁纳快要耗尽了！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Why don't you send someone over and find out what happened?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
为什么不派个人去看看出了什么事？

scripts.text:
[Kalu]
I'm not dumb you know. But there's no one to send! Look, everyone is busy.
scripts.translation:
[卡卢]
我又不傻，可是没人能派啊！你看，大家都忙着呢。

scripts.text: I'll help you.
scripts.translation: 我来帮你。

scripts.text: Oh no. I'm sorry.
scripts.translation: 啊，不好意思，我帮不了你。

scripts.text:
[Kalu]
Yeah, I'm busy so you should get going. If you wish to drink kaluna milk, try the next door.
scripts.translation:
[卡卢]
是啊，我忙得很，你该走了。想喝卡鲁纳牛奶就去隔壁看看。

scripts.text:
[Kalu]
What? What did you just say? If I heard you correctly, you said you'd help me.
scripts.translation:
[卡卢]
什么？你刚才说什么？我没听错的话，你说要帮我？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You heard me right.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你没听错。

scripts.text:
[Kalu]
Dear lord, thank you. So this is how you repay me for all the nice deeds I've done.
scripts.translation:
[卡卢]
老天爷，谢谢你！这就是对我平日善行的回报啊。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm the one who said I'll help you, but how come the lord gets the appreciation?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
明明是我说要帮你的，怎么反倒是你在感谢老天？

scripts.text:
[Kalu]
Oh, not at all. I'm grateful to you, too. Anyways, if you go to the ^0000cdfishing hole near the south bridge^000000, you'll meet ^0000cdLegalas^000000 who is standing on crutches. He's the one who supplies us with kaluna.
scripts.translation:
[卡卢]
哦，我也很感谢你。总之，去^0000cd南桥附近的渔场^000000找找吧，那里有个拄拐杖的^0000cd莱加拉斯^000000，负责给我们供应卡鲁纳。

scripts.text:
[Kalu]
Most people in Lasagna work for the vigilante corps or merchants, so the town is always short on hands.
scripts.translation:
[卡卢]
罗札纳的大多数人都在义警团或商队工作，所以镇上一直缺人手。

scripts.text:
[Kalu]
So we hire outsiders who want a job as a special treatment policy, and Legalas is in charge of fermenting kaluna.
scripts.translation:
[卡卢]
因此我们会用特殊的雇用政策招揽外来务工者，莱加拉斯就负责发酵卡鲁纳。

scripts.text:
[Kalu]
He's quite skilled at catching, cleaning, and fermenting kalunyak that Lasagna's kaluna milk is regarded as the best around here. Ah, this is not the important part.
scripts.translation:
[卡卢]
他很擅长捕捉、清洗和发酵卡鲁尼亚克，所以罗札纳的卡鲁纳牛奶才是这一带最好的。啊，这不是重点。

scripts.text:
[Kalu]
Go find Legalas and find out what's going on. And tell him to make delivery as soon as possible. At the rate we're going, we'll be out of stock after today.
scripts.translation:
[卡卢]
去找莱加拉斯问问出了什么事，让他尽快送货。照现在的进度，今天过后就要断货了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Okay, I'll go and find out.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好的，我去问问。

scripts.text:
[Kalu]
Thank you so much!
scripts.translation:
[卡卢]
太感谢你了！

scripts.text:
[Kalu]
Didn't you say you were going to find out why Legalas was not able to make the delivery?
scripts.translation:
[卡卢]
你不是说要去调查莱加拉斯为什么没能送货吗？

scripts.text:
[Kalu]
I beg you. I'm really worried. Can't even sleep these days.
scripts.translation:
[卡卢]
拜托你了，我真的很担心，这几天连觉都睡不好。

scripts.text:
[Kalu]
Adventurer, what did Legalas say? Did he say he can deliver kaluna?
scripts.translation:
[卡卢]
冒险者，莱加拉斯怎么说？他说能送来卡鲁纳吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yes. Fortunately, he said he's close to meeting the delivery quota.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
能。好在他说货物很快就能备齐。

scripts.text:
[Kalu]
What a relief! But did tell you about what caused him the delay?
scripts.translation:
[卡卢]
太好了！他有没有告诉你，是什么耽误了送货？

scripts.text: [You tell Kalu about the story of Daldal and Gopara.]
scripts.translation: [你向卡卢讲述了达尔达尔与戈帕拉的故事。]

scripts.text:
[Kalu]
So what you're telling is that I should keep the two far away from the workshop while Legalas is working.
scripts.translation:
[卡卢]
所以你是说，莱加拉斯工作时，我得让那两个人离工坊远点。

scripts.text:
[Kalu]
I think That's something I can take care of. As a matter of fact, I have a ^0000cdlunchbox delivery to make inside the cave^000000. Every day, that is.
scripts.translation:
[卡卢]
这事我应该能处理。正好我每天都要^0000cd往洞穴送午餐盒^000000。

scripts.text:
[Kalu]
Looks like the two can be sent to the delivery team while Legalas is working. For wage, a meal per day would do.
scripts.translation:
[卡卢]
莱加拉斯工作时，正好可以让那两个人加入送货队。报酬嘛，每人每天给顿饭就行。

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
Cave? That's nice. I've always wanted to go there myself.
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
洞穴？听起来不错，我一直很想亲自去看看。

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
Whatever it is, I'm happy that I get to eat yummy food.
scripts.translation:
[达尔达尔]
不管是什么，只要有好吃的，我就开心。

scripts.text:
[Kalu]
Okay, then Let's get started right away! Take this lunchbox to the ^0000cdvigilante inside the cave. His name is Panna.^000000
scripts.translation:
[卡卢]
好，那就马上开始！把这个午餐盒送给^0000cd洞穴里的义警潘娜^000000。

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
Let's go.
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
走吧。

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
Get up.
scripts.translation:
[达尔达尔]
起来。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
M-me, too?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我、我也要去？

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
We're a team.
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
我们是一个团队。

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
A team must move as one.
scripts.translation:
[达尔达尔]
团队就得一起行动。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Since when was I part of the team? All right, fine... Let's go.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我什么时候成团队的一员了？好吧...走吧。

scripts.text:
[Kalu]
Just deliver this big lunchbox to Panna who's out on a cave patrol.
scripts.translation:
[卡卢]
把这个大午餐盒送给正在洞穴巡逻的潘娜就行了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm back.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我回来了。

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
I said I'm back.
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
我说我回来了。

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
I'm back.
scripts.translation:
[达尔达尔]
我回来了。

scripts.text:
[Kalu]
Good job. While the three of you went to the cave, Legalas visited with kaluna. If we can keep this up every day, delivery will be no problem at all.
scripts.translation:
[卡卢]
干得好。你们三个去洞穴的时候，莱加拉斯正好送来了卡鲁纳。每天都能这样的话，送货就没问题了。

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
Adventurer, I'm counting on you tomorrow as well.
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
冒险者，明天也拜托你了。

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
If time permits, I'll be out early and waiting.
scripts.translation:
[达尔达尔]
要是有空，我会早点出门等着。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
M-me, too?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我、我也要去？

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
What were we called before?
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
我们之前的口号是什么来着？

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
One!
scripts.translation:
[达尔达尔]
一！

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
Team!
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
队！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
One team. If I don't show up, they'll probably harass Legalas again. Fine.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
一队。如果我不去，他们可能又会去烦莱加拉斯。好吧。

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
Okay, give me food now.
scripts.translation:
[达尔达尔]
好啦，快给我吃的。

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
I'm fine. Had too much kalunyak that I'm still digesting.
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
我不用了，卡鲁尼亚克吃太多，还没消化完。

scripts.text:
[Kalu]
You should take this. Nice work.
scripts.translation:
[卡卢]
这个给你，干得不错。

scripts.text:
[Kalu]
Good job today as well. Two of you, get some food. Adventurer, that this. I'm counting on you tomorrow as well!
scripts.translation:
[卡卢]
今天也干得很好。你们两个去吃点东西吧。冒险者，这个给你。明天还得拜托你！

scripts.text:
[Kalu]
Just deliver this big lunchbox to Panna who's out on a cave patrol.
scripts.translation:
[卡卢]
把这个大午餐盒送给正在洞穴巡逻的潘娜就行了。

scripts.text:
[Kalu]
Adventurer, you're here already? It's not the time for lunchbox delivery yet.
scripts.translation:
[卡卢]
冒险者，你来得这么早？还没到送午餐盒的时候。

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
Right. Timing is off.
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
是啊，时间不对。

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
Timing is off!
scripts.translation:
[达尔达尔]
时间不对！

scripts.text:
[Kalu]
Come back after the daybreak.
scripts.translation:
[卡卢]
天亮以后再来吧。

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
See you later.
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
回头见。

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
See you again.
scripts.translation:
[达尔达尔]
再见。

scripts.text:
[Kalu]
Right on time. Two people are here already and waiting.
scripts.translation:
[卡卢]
来得正好，他们两个已经在这里等着了。

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
Yes, we've been waiting.
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
是啊，我们一直在等。

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
Waited for a long time. Almost died waiting.
scripts.translation:
[达尔达尔]
等了好久，差点等死了。

scripts.text:
[Kalu]
Then I ask that you ^0000cddeliver the lunchbox to Panna in the cave^000000 for today as well. Hurry up on your way there, but take your time on your way back.
scripts.translation:
[卡卢]
那么，今天也请你们^0000cd把午餐盒送到洞穴里交给潘娜^000000。去的时候走快点，回来时慢慢走。

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
Let's go.
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
走吧。

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
Let's get going!
scripts.translation:
[达尔达尔]
出发吧！

scripts.text:
[Legalas]
Stop eating! Stop! Shame on you!
scripts.translation:
[莱加拉斯]
别吃了！住手！真不像话！

scripts.text:
[Legalas]
Enough already! You guys are getting worse and worse every day! don't you guys think this is too much? Have you no conscience?!
scripts.translation:
[莱加拉斯]
够了！你们一天比一天过分！不觉得这样太过分了吗？还有没有良心？！

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
Conscience? Mm... Sorry, but I don't know because I have no clue where my conscience is.
scripts.translation:
[达尔达尔]
良心？嗯...抱歉，我不知道自己的良心在哪儿。

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
Probably in the chest, right? But what am I supposed to do with it?
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
大概在胸口吧？不过拿它来做什么？

scripts.text:
[Legalas]
The minute I catch kalunyak, you two devour it! You even ate the ones I had cleaned!
scripts.translation:
[莱加拉斯]
我一抓到卡鲁尼亚克，你们俩就把它吃掉！连我清洗好的也不放过！

scripts.text:
[Legalas]
didn't I tell you several times that those must be fermented and delivered? And the deadline has already passed!
scripts.translation:
[莱加拉斯]
我不是跟你们说过好几次，这些得先发酵再送货吗？而且交货期限都过了！

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
Really? I didn't know.
scripts.translation:
[达尔达尔]
是吗？我不知道。

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
I did. But I couldn't help it.
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
我知道，可就是忍不住。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Uh, are you Legalas who supplies kaluna?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
呃，你就是给大家供应卡鲁纳的莱加拉斯吗？

scripts.text:
[Legalas]
Now look! Someone is here because I couldn't make the delivery! I'm ruined now! I'll starve to death!
scripts.translation:
[莱加拉斯]
看吧！因为我没能按时送货，客人都找上门了！我完蛋了，要饿死了！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Calm down. The situation is bad but no need to be so pessimistic. Why is everyone here so extreme?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
冷静点。情况确实不好，但也不至于这么悲观。这里的人怎么都这么容易慌？

scripts.text:
[Legalas]
I don't know what you mean. Please explain.
scripts.translation:
[莱加拉斯]
我不懂你的意思，请解释一下。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Kalu from the adventurers' club wants to know why the delivery is being late. He has enough to sell for today, so everything will be fine as long as you can deliver by today.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
冒险者俱乐部的卡卢想知道送货为什么延误。他今天还有足够的库存，只要你今天能送到就没问题。

scripts.text:
[Legalas]
Ha! Huh! Ha! I wish I can do that. But those two pigs are devouring the kalunyaks! At first, they ate one or two, but now they're at it the minute I catch one. I don't have the opportunity to clean and ferment it!
scripts.translation:
[莱加拉斯]
哈！唉！我也想啊。可那两头猪把卡鲁尼亚克都吃了！起初还只吃一两个，现在我一抓到它们就抢。我根本没机会清洗和发酵！

scripts.text:
[Legalas]
If you want kaluna, then do something about ^0000cdthose two over there^000000! I'm about to go crazy because not only do they leech onto me, now they're ruining my work. Perhaps It's better that I go back to the battlefield!
scripts.translation:
[莱加拉斯]
想要卡鲁纳，就去处理^0000cd那边那两个人^000000！他们不但赖着不走，还毁了我的工作，我快疯了！我还不如回战场去呢！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Please calm down. I'll talk to them.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
冷静点，我去跟他们谈谈。

scripts.text:
[Legalas]
They won't listen no matter what. Look at those bellies. They're from eating so much kalunyak and kaluna.
scripts.translation:
[莱加拉斯]
跟他们说什么都没用。看看他们的肚子，都是吃太多卡鲁尼亚克和卡鲁纳吃出来的。

scripts.text:
[Legalas]
Who knows where the pigs suddenly disappeared to, but I hope they're not back anytime soon. I'm on a roll here! A little more, just a little more...!
scripts.translation:
[莱加拉斯]
不知道那两头猪突然跑哪儿去了，希望它们别这么快回来。我正忙得起劲呢！再一点点，就快好了...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Legalas, I tried everything to make them work, but they have neither the skills nor will.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
莱加拉斯，我试着让他们干活了，可他们既没本事，也没那个意愿。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
But they promised that they won't eat kalunyak, so you won't have any problem with the delivery anymore.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不过他们保证不再吃卡鲁尼亚克，这下应该不会影响你送货了。

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
You seem to have some grudge against us. I'm going to tell Legalas everything as soon as he gets here.
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
你对我们好像有意见。莱加拉斯一来，我就把事情都告诉他。

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
What did we do wrong anyway?
scripts.translation:
[达尔达尔]
我们到底做错什么了？

scripts.text:
[Legalas]
I was wondering why you suddenly took these two out. So That's what happened. It must've been difficult, taking them around with you.
scripts.translation:
[莱加拉斯]
我还纳闷你为什么突然带这两个人过来，原来是这么回事。带着他们到处跑，辛苦你了。

scripts.text:
[Legalas]
Thanks to your sacrifice, I was able to make most of the ^0000cdkaluna^000000 I needed to deliver. Thank you so much.
scripts.translation:
[莱加拉斯]
多亏你帮忙，我总算做出了大部分要交付的^0000cd卡鲁纳^000000。太感谢了。

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
You guys are openly being mean to us.
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
你们也太明目张胆地欺负我们了。

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
Kalunyak is definitely the best.
scripts.translation:
[达尔达尔]
卡鲁尼亚克果然最好吃。

scripts.text:
[Legalas]
Doh! That pig is eating kalunyak again!
scripts.translation:
[莱加拉斯]
哎呀！那头猪又在吃卡鲁尼亚克了！

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
I was hungry. I can't eat anchovies anymore. I can only eat kalunyak now.
scripts.translation:
[达尔达尔]
我饿了嘛，凤尾鱼我已经吃腻了，现在只想吃卡鲁尼亚克。

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
I have no work so I'll eat again.
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
反正没事做，那我再吃点。

scripts.text:
[Legalas]
Adventurer, I have a favor to ask. I haven't met my delivery quota yet, but those two are eating all my kalunyaks! What you see is all I got for today and at this rate, I won't be able to fulfill the order.
scripts.translation:
[莱加拉斯]
冒险者，能帮我个忙吗？我还没完成今天的交货量，那两个人却把卡鲁尼亚克都吃了！今天就剩这些了，照这样下去我根本交不了货。

scripts.text:
[Legalas]
Please take them with you again, even for a short while!
scripts.translation:
[莱加拉斯]
拜托你了，哪怕只带走他们一会儿也好！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I need to deliver some message to Kalu anyway, so I'll take the two with me.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
反正我也要给卡卢送消息，就带他们一起去吧。

scripts.text:
[Legalas]
Please, I beg you!
scripts.translation:
[莱加拉斯]
拜托了，求求你！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Guys, how about we go to the ^0000cdPub-Oven^000000?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
大家，要不我们去^0000cdPub-Oven^000000吧？

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
Fine. Anywhere as long as It's not boring.
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
行啊，只要不无聊，去哪儿都行。

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
Does it have plenty of yummy food? If yes, I'll go.
scripts.translation:
[达尔达尔]
那里有很多好吃的吗？有的话我就去。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Let's go then.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那我们走吧。

scripts.text:
[Legalas]
Thanks for keeping these pigs. Thanks to you, my job got easier!
scripts.translation:
[莱加拉斯]
谢谢你帮我看着这两头猪！多亏了你，我的工作轻松多了！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Guys, there's something I wish to share with you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
大家，我有件事想跟你们说。

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
I'm getting tired of this now. But there's nothing else to eat.
scripts.translation:
[达尔达尔]
我有点吃腻了，可也没别的东西吃。

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
When did we eat because we wanted to? It was more like eating because it was there.
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
我们什么时候是因为想吃才吃的？明明是因为有得吃才吃。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Guys?

[Daldal]
What is it? Did you bring something to eat?
scripts.translation:
[达尔达尔]
怎么了？你带吃的来了吗？

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
Are you going to play with us?
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
要和我们一起玩吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
From what I hear, you eat all the kalunyaks that Legalas cleans. Right now, we're almost out of kaluna made from those kalunyaks. Can you please control yourselves a bit?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
听说你们把莱加拉斯清洗好的卡鲁尼亚克全吃了。现在用卡鲁尼亚克做的卡鲁纳快用完了，能不能稍微克制一下？

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
Why should we?
scripts.translation:
[达尔达尔]
为什么要克制？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Because you can't make kaluna milk without kaluna. Someone who was supposed to receive kaluna from Legalas is in a tight spot right now.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
没有卡鲁纳就做不了卡鲁纳牛奶。莱加拉斯有个客户正等着收货，已经很为难了。

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
What does that have to do with us?
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
那跟我们有什么关系？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You see, Kalu really needs kaluna. Without kaluna, he can't continue his business.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
卡卢很需要卡鲁纳。没有卡鲁纳，他的生意就做不下去。

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
That has nothing to do with me.
scripts.translation:
[达尔达尔]
那不关我的事。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It has a lot to do with Legalas. You are aware that Legalas supplies Kalu with kaluna fermented from kalunyak, right?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这和莱加拉斯关系可大了。你们知道他是把卡鲁尼亚克发酵成卡鲁纳，再供应给卡卢的吧？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
If he can't meet the deadline or delivery quota, he'll lose his job to someone else.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
要是他没按时交货或没完成配额，就会被别人取代。

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
So what does that have to do with us?
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
那又怎样？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
If Legalas loses his job, then he won't be able to earn money. And if he can't earn money, then wouldn't that put you guys in a tight spot?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
莱加拉斯要是丢了工作，就没法赚钱。你们的生活不也会因此陷入困境吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
From what I gather, Legalas feeds you, clothes you, and puts a roof over your heads.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
据我所知，莱加拉斯给你们吃的、穿的，还给你们提供住处。

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
We don't wear clothes.
scripts.translation:
[达尔达尔]
我们又不穿衣服。

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
Then Legalas can find some other job.
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
那莱加拉斯可以去找别的工作啊。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
If you're ruining his work right now, what makes you think that Legalas won't do anything later? He'll probably get rid of you two and go find some other opportunities.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你们现在一直在妨碍他工作，凭什么觉得他以后还会管你们？他大概会把你们赶走，另谋出路。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Then you two who can't support yourselves will wander around and starve to death in some filthy backstreet alley.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
到时候你们两个养不活自己，只能在肮脏的小巷里流浪，最后饿死。

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
N-no way!
scripts.translation:
[达尔达尔]
不...不会吧！

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
T-That's too extreme!
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
这...这也太夸张了！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Then you guys shouldn't get in the way now, should you? Are you going to eat more kalunyaks?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那你们现在就别再妨碍他了，对吧？还要继续吃卡鲁尼亚克吗？

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
No! No more!
scripts.translation:
[达尔达尔]
不吃了！再也不吃了！

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
Not eating kalunyaks is not enough. I've never thought about the possibility that Legalas can leave us. We must do something.
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
光不吃卡鲁尼亚克还不够。我从没想过莱加拉斯会离开我们，我们得做点什么。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Great attitude! Now Legalas will...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
态度不错！这样莱加拉斯就...

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
Now, teach us.
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
那就教我们吧。

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
Yeah! ^0000cdTeach us work^000000 or whatever.
scripts.translation:
[达尔达尔]
对！^0000cd教我们干活^000000什么的。

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
You brought up the subject so you should be responsible for us. That's how Legalas has been taking care of us.
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
既然是你提起这件事的，就该对我们负责。莱加拉斯一直就是这么照顾我们的。

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
Wherever Legalas goes, I go.
scripts.translation:
[达尔达尔]
莱加拉斯去哪儿，我就去哪儿。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
there's something called doram trash among the dorams. Too bad that you can't use it since you're not dorams and That's about it. Fine.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
多兰里有种东西叫“多兰废物”。可惜你们不是多兰，所以也用不上。就这样吧。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm the one responsible for bringing up the subject and for poor Legalas's sake, I'll help you guys find a job.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
既然是我提起这件事，为了可怜的莱加拉斯，我会帮你们找份工作。

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
You should teach us.
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
你得教我们。

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
You should hire us.
scripts.translation:
[达尔达尔]
你得雇我们。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
there's nothing I can teach you. But as I said, I'll look for a place where you can learn.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我没什么能教你们的。不过我说过，会帮你们找个能学习的地方。

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
Then find something easy. I think something like ^0000cdbabysitting^000000 would be nice.
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
那就找点轻松的活吧。比如^0000cd照看小孩^000000就不错。

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
Yeah, I like babies. Small and cute.
scripts.translation:
[达尔达尔]
对，我喜欢小宝宝，小小的，很可爱。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Fine. I'll see if there are any babies around here. There is some type of ^0000cdplayground^000000 above the pub. I'll take a look there.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好吧，我看看附近有没有需要照看的小孩。酒馆上面好像有个^0000cd游乐场^000000，先去那里看看。

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
Yeah, this place is the best. It doesn't taste good, but drinking kaluna seems to be my destiny.
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
对，这里最好。卡鲁纳虽然不好喝，但喝它大概就是我的命。

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
I said I'll go see Kalu. I was bored anyway, so It's all good. Go, you lead the way.
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
我说了要去找卡卢啊。反正我也无聊，这样正好。走吧，你带路。

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
I'm drinking kaluna right now, but It's not because It's tasty. It's because It's there.
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
我现在喝卡鲁纳，可不是因为它好喝，只是因为手边正好有。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Guys, there's something I wish to share with you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
大家，我有件事想告诉你们。

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
I'm getting tired of this now. But there's nothing else to eat.
scripts.translation:
[达尔达尔]
我有点吃腻了，可也没别的东西吃。

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
When did we eat because we wanted to? It was more like eating because it was there.
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
我们什么时候是因为想吃才吃的？明明是因为有得吃才吃。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Guys?

[Daldal]
What is it? Did you bring something to eat?
scripts.translation:
[达尔达尔]
怎么了？你带吃的来了吗？

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
Are you going to play with us?
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
要和我们一起玩吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
From what I hear, you eat all the kalunyaks that Legalas cleans. Right now, we're almost out of kaluna made from those kalunyaks. Can you please control yourselves a bit?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
听说你们把莱加拉斯清洗好的卡鲁尼亚克全吃了。现在用卡鲁尼亚克做的卡鲁纳快用完了，能不能稍微克制一下？

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
Why should we?
scripts.translation:
[达尔达尔]
为什么要克制？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Because you can't make kaluna milk without kaluna. Someone who was supposed to receive kaluna from Legalas is in a tight spot right now.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
没有卡鲁纳就做不了卡鲁纳牛奶。莱加拉斯有个客户正等着收货，已经很为难了。

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
What does that have to do with us?
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
那跟我们有什么关系？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You see, Kalu really needs kaluna. Without kaluna, he can't continue his business.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
卡卢很需要卡鲁纳。没有卡鲁纳，他的生意就做不下去。

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
That has nothing to do with me.
scripts.translation:
[达尔达尔]
那不关我的事。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It has a lot to do with Legalas. You are aware that Legalas supplies Kalu with kaluna fermented from kalunyak, right?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这和莱加拉斯关系可大了。你们知道他是把卡鲁尼亚克发酵成卡鲁纳，再供应给卡卢的吧？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
If he can't meet the deadline or delivery quota, he'll lose his job to someone else.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
要是他没按时交货或没完成配额，就会被别人取代。

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
So what does that have to do with us?
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
那又怎样？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
If Legalas loses his job, then he won't be able to earn money. And if he can't earn money, then wouldn't that put you guys in a tight spot?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
莱加拉斯要是丢了工作，就没法赚钱。你们的生活不也会因此陷入困境吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
From what I gather, Legalas feeds you, clothes you, and puts a roof over your heads.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
据我所知，莱加拉斯给你们吃的、穿的，还给你们提供住处。

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
We don't wear clothes.
scripts.translation:
[达尔达尔]
我们又不穿衣服。

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
Then Legalas can find some other job.
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
那莱加拉斯可以去找别的工作啊。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
If you're ruining his work right now, what makes you think that Legalas won't do anything later? He'll probably get rid of you two and go find some other opportunities.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你们现在一直在妨碍他工作，凭什么觉得莱加拉斯以后还会管你们？他大概会把你们赶走，另谋出路。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Then you two who can't support yourselves will wander around and starve to death in some filthy backstreet alley.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
到时候你们两个养不活自己，只能在肮脏的小巷里流浪，最后饿死。

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
N-no way!
scripts.translation:
[达尔达尔]
不...不会吧！

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
T-That's too extreme!
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
这...这也太夸张了！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Then you guys shouldn't get in the way now, should you? Are you going to eat more kalunyaks?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那你们现在就别再妨碍他了，对吧？还要继续吃卡鲁尼亚克吗？

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
No! No more!
scripts.translation:
[达尔达尔]
不！再也不吃了！

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
Not eating kalunyaks is not enough. I've never thought about the possibility that Legalas can leave us. We must do something.
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
光不吃卡鲁尼亚克还不够。我从没想过莱加拉斯会离开我们，我们得做点什么。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Great attitude! Now Legalas will...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
态度不错！这样莱加拉斯就...

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
Now, teach us.
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
那就教我们吧。

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
Yeah! ^0000cdTeach us work^000000 or whatever.
scripts.translation:
[达尔达尔]
对！^0000cd教我们干活^000000什么的。

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
You brought up the subject so you should be responsible for us. That's how Legalas has been taking care of us.
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
既然是你提起这件事的，就该对我们负责。莱加拉斯一直就是这样照顾我们的。

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
Wherever Legalas goes, I go.
scripts.translation:
[达尔达尔]
莱加拉斯去哪儿，我就去哪儿。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
there's something called doram trash among the dorams. Too bad that you can't use it since you're not dorams and That's about it. Fine.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
多兰里有种东西叫“多兰废物”。可惜你们不是多兰，所以也用不上。就这样吧。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm the one responsible for bringing up the subject and for poor Legalas's sake, I'll help you guys find a job.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
既然是我提起这件事，为了可怜的莱加拉斯，我会帮你们找份工作。

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
You should teach us.
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
你得教我们。

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
You should hire us.
scripts.translation:
[达尔达尔]
你得雇我们。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
there's nothing I can teach you. But as I said, I'll look for a place where you can learn.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我没什么能教你们的。不过我说过，会帮你们找个能学习的地方。

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
Then find something easy. I think something like ^0000cdbabysitting^000000 would be nice.
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
那就找点轻松的活吧。比如^0000cd照看小孩^000000就不错。

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
Yeah, I like babies. Small and cute.
scripts.translation:
[达尔达尔]
对，我喜欢小宝宝，小小的，很可爱。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Fine. I'll see if there are any babies around here. There is some type of ^0000cdplayground^000000 above the pub. I'll take a look there.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好吧，我看看附近有没有需要照看的小孩。酒馆上面好像有个^0000cd游乐场^000000，我先去那里看看。

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
I can't believe I was going to leave this comfy place. I forgot for a second that eating kalunyak is the biggest joy in my life.
scripts.translation:
[达尔达尔]
真不敢相信我刚才竟然想离开这么舒服的地方。我一时忘了，吃卡鲁尼亚克才是人生最大的乐趣。

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
Let's go see Kalu. I want to go and eat something yummy.
scripts.translation:
[达尔达尔]
我们去找卡卢吧，我想去吃点好吃的。

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
Eating kalunyak is simple. Grab kalunyak with hard shell. Then hand it over to Legalas.
scripts.translation:
[达尔达尔]
卡鲁尼亚克很简单：抓起带硬壳的卡鲁尼亚克，然后交给莱加拉斯。

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
Legalas gets rid of kalunyak's shell and puts it in a container. Then you eat from that container. Simple, right?
scripts.translation:
[达尔达尔]
莱加拉斯会把卡鲁尼亚克剥壳后放进容器里，然后你们就可以吃了。很简单吧？

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
I like baby! Cute!
scripts.translation:
[达尔达尔]
我喜欢小宝宝！好可爱！

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
Wouldn't Babysitting be easy? What can a little kid do?
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
照看小孩应该很轻松吧？小孩子能做什么呢？

scripts.text:
[Baby]
Waa.
scripts.translation:
[婴儿]
哇。

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
there's a baby here.
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
这里有个小宝宝。

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
Baby...right?
scripts.translation:
[达尔达尔]
是婴儿...没错吧？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Big but definitely... a baby.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
虽然个头很大，但确实...是个婴儿。

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
Okay, I'm sitting now.
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
好，我坐下了。

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
Sitting.
scripts.translation:
[达尔达尔]
坐好了。

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
Patiently sitting.
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
耐心地坐着。

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
Sitting.
scripts.translation:
[达尔达尔]
坐好了。

scripts.text:
[Baby]
Waa. Waa!
scripts.translation:
[婴儿]
哇。哇！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
G-guys? didn't you want me to find you a babysitting job?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你...你们不是想让我帮忙找照看小孩的工作吗？

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
So That's what we're doing right now. We're sitting as hard as we can.
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
我们现在不就在做吗？正努力坐着呢。

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
Me too.
scripts.translation:
[达尔达尔]
我也是。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Babysitting is not sitting around quietly. It's looking after a baby!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
照看小孩不是坐着不动，而是要看护小孩！

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
Is that so? But That's so bothersome! I can't even look after my own body.
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
是这样吗？可太麻烦了！我连自己都照顾不好。

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
That was what babysitting was about? I didn't know. If I did, I wouldn't have done it.
scripts.translation:
[达尔达尔]
原来照看小孩是这么回事？我不知道啊，早知道就不干了。

scripts.text:
[Baby]
Waa. Waa.
scripts.translation:
[婴儿]
哇。哇。

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
Be quiet. Just speak up.
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
安静点。有话就说。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
This is not going to work. Let's forget about babysitting. Was there anything you've always wanted to do?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这样不行，还是别照看小孩了。你们有没有一直想做的事？

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
No such thing. I'm hungry.
scripts.translation:
[达尔达尔]
没有，我饿了。

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
Now that I think about it, I've always wanted to do something ^0000cdrelated to anchovies^000000. Anchovies are yummy.
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
仔细想想，我一直想做些^0000cd和鳀鱼有关的事^000000。鳀鱼很好吃。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Okay, fine. Let's go to the anchovy workshop ^0000cdnear the dock^000000.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好吧，那就去^0000cd码头附近的鳀鱼工坊^000000看看。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Baby, cute...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
小宝宝真可爱...

scripts.text:
[Baby]
Waa waa!
scripts.translation:
[婴儿]
哇哇！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Opps! I was supposed to go to the anchovy workshop. Gotta hurry.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
糟了！我本来要去鳀鱼工坊的，得赶紧走。

scripts.text:
[Baby]
Twinkle twinkle little star - how I wonder what you are -
Up above the world so high - like a diamond in the sky -
scripts.translation:
[婴儿]
一闪一闪亮晶晶 - 满天都是小星星 -
挂在天上放光明 - 好像许多小眼睛 -

scripts.text:
[Baby]
Twinkle twinkle little star - how I wonder what you are -
scripts.translation:
[婴儿]
一闪一闪亮晶晶 - 满天都是小星星 -

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
To be honest, before I came here, I thought the anchovies were dug from the ground. But I'm not embarrassed though.
scripts.translation:
[达尔达尔]
说实话，我来之前还以为鳀鱼是从地里挖出来的。不过，我可不觉得丢脸。

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
I've had anchovies before because Legalas bought some time to time.
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
我以前吃过鳀鱼，莱加拉斯偶尔会买一些回来。

scripts.text:
[Workshop Manager]
Rookie? Have experience working in this field? Well, it doesn't matter even if you don't. You can learn it easily.
scripts.translation:
[工坊管理员]
新人？做过这行吗？没有也没关系，很快就能学会。

scripts.text:
[Workshop Manager]
Now, follow after me. Grab an anchovy. Remove its head. Pull out the guts. Put it inside the container.
scripts.translation:
[工坊管理员]
跟我来。拿一条鳀鱼，去掉鱼头，掏出内脏，再放进容器里。

scripts.text:
[Workshop Manager]
Rookies go through these four steps, but skilled workers pick up and simultaneously remove head and guts and throw it inside the container. They are capable of one-step method.
scripts.translation:
[工坊管理员]
新手要分四步做，熟练工人却能一边拿鱼，一边去头、掏内脏，再把它扔进容器，一步完成。

scripts.text:
[Workshop Manager]
The captain of Con-Chliina was especially skilled at it. Now, you guys give it a try.
scripts.translation:
[工坊管理员]
康奇利娜号的船长尤其擅长这个。现在你们也试试看。

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
What... is this.
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
这...是什么？

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
What is this gross looking thing?
scripts.translation:
[达尔达尔]
这恶心的东西是什么？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Anchovy. You said you wanted to do something that has to do with anchovies, so I brought you here.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
鳀鱼啊。你们不是说想做和鳀鱼有关的工作吗？所以我就带你们来了。

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
Anchovy is a long and thin snack That's a bit salty, Isn't it? But this thing has a head... and eyes too!
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
鳀鱼不是细长、咸咸的零食吗？可这东西竟然有头...还有眼睛！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Of course it has eyes and head since It's a fish.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
它是鱼，当然有眼睛和头。

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
Anchovy is a fish?
scripts.translation:
[达尔达尔]
鳀鱼是鱼？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Then what did you think it was?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那你们以为它是什么？

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
I thought it was a tasty food made from some mysterious ingredients in the store.
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
我以为那是商店里用神秘材料做出来的美味。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Guys... how can you not know that an anchovy is a fish? What kind of lives did you guys live?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你们...怎么会不知道鳀鱼是鱼？以前到底过的是什么日子啊？

scripts.text:
[Workshop Manager]
Where in the world did you find these idiots? Do you think they can handle this job?
scripts.translation:
[工坊管理员]
你们从哪儿找来这两个笨蛋的？他们真能干这份活吗？

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
I can't do this.
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
我做不来。

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
I don't think I can eat another anchovy ever again. Our eyes met just before. They're going to follow me every time I see an anchovy.
scripts.translation:
[达尔达尔]
我再也不想吃鳀鱼了。刚才我还和它对上了眼。以后每次看到鳀鱼，我都会想起那双眼睛。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ha... Is that so? Seems like this job is not for you either. Then Let's go find something else. Was there any other job you wanted to try?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哈...是吗？看来这份工作也不适合你们。我们再找别的吧。还有什么想做的工作吗？

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
Ship. I want to be on a ^0000cdship^000000!
scripts.translation:
[达尔达尔]
船！我想上^0000cd船^000000！

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
Right. I've been living in Lasagna all this time and never been on a ship. This is a good chance to board on one.
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
对啊，我一直住在罗札纳，还从没上过船。这可是个好机会。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Yeah? Then Let's go to that ^0000cdanchovy fishing boat up there^000000.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
是吗？那我们去上面那艘^0000cd鳀鱼渔船^000000看看。

scripts.text:
[Workshop Manager]
Didn't you say you were going to the anchovy shipping boat? Beats me what you can do there even if you go there.
scripts.translation:
[工坊管理员]
你们不是说想去鳀鱼运输船吗？就算去了，我也不知道你们能做什么。

scripts.text:
[Workshop Manager]
Lasagna's anchovies are special. Top quality anchovies are steamed and dried nine times, followed by removal of head and guts. This is an art work that requires delicate processes.
scripts.translation:
[工坊管理员]
罗札纳的鳀鱼很特别。上等鳀鱼要蒸干九次，再去掉头和内脏。这是一门讲究细致工序的手艺。

scripts.text:
[Workshop Manager]
They're perfect to be served with alcohol and make great snacks for students studying for an exam. Try one.
scripts.translation:
[工坊管理员]
它们很适合下酒，也是备考学生的好零食。尝一个吧。

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
I've always wanted to be on a boat... hah... nostalgia...
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
我一直想上船...哈哈...真让人怀念...

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
Every time I see a boat, it reminds me of a shell. You know, the one that is empty inside and hard outside.
scripts.translation:
[达尔达尔]
每次看到船，我就会想起贝壳。你知道那种东西吧？里面空空的，外面却很硬。

scripts.text:
Captain of Anchovy Fishing Boat
What is it?
scripts.translation:
鳀鱼渔船船长
什么事？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I was wondering if you need any help on the ship.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我想问问船上需不需要帮手。

scripts.text:
Captain of Anchovy Fishing Boat
Anchovy business has definitely seen better days, but I'm always short on hands.
scripts.translation:
鳀鱼渔船船长
鳀鱼生意确实不如从前了，不过我一直缺人手。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Then how about you give these two a try? They want to work on a ship, so even an apprenticeship would be nice.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那您愿不愿意试用这两个人？他们想在船上工作，就算从学徒做起也行。

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
Feels like we're being sold.
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
感觉我们像是要被卖掉了。

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
Probably just an imagination. He wouldn't sell us.
scripts.translation:
[达尔达尔]
大概是你想多了，他不会卖掉我们的。

scripts.text:
Captain of Anchovy Fishing Boat
Hey, you two over there. Have you ever been on a ship?
scripts.translation:
鳀鱼渔船船长
喂，你们两个以前上过船吗？

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
Nope.
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
没有。

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
Nah. My mom held my hand and came here just by riding on the tides. She was swept away and I landed here alone. Legalas found me and since then, we've been living together like a family.
scripts.translation:
[达尔达尔]
没有。我妈妈牵着我的手，跟着潮水漂到了这里。她被潮水冲走了，我一个人留在岸上。莱加拉斯发现了我，从那以后我们就像一家人一样生活。

scripts.text:
Captain of Anchovy Fishing Boat
No need to know about your past. I just need you to do a good job on the ship. Since this is the first time on a boat for both of you, looks like there's a long bumpy road ahead.
scripts.translation:
鳀鱼渔船船长
我不需要知道你们的过去，只要在船上好好干活就行。既然你们都是第一次上船，往后可有不少苦头要吃。

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
So mean. I shared my painful past and you couldn't care any less.
scripts.translation:
[达尔达尔]
真冷漠。我都把伤心往事告诉你了，你却一点也不在意。

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
It's okay. I care.
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
没关系，我在意。

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
Thanks.
scripts.translation:
[达尔达尔]
谢谢。

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
I want to share mine. Can I tell you?
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
我也想讲讲自己的故事，可以吗？

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
Not really interested.
scripts.translation:
[达尔达尔]
没什么兴趣。

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
Let's fight!
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
我们来打一架！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Now now, calm down. How does it feel to be on a ship? It carries anchovies from the anchovy fishing boat to Lasagna, but you won't get to see them since the cargo is stored in the storage area.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好了，冷静点。在船上的感觉怎么样？这艘船负责把鳀鱼从渔船运到罗札纳，不过货物都放在仓库里，你们看不到。

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
That's not the problem I'm upset.
scripts.translation:
[达尔达尔]
我生气的不是这个。

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
Why does the floor look so nauseous?
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
为什么地板看起来这么晃，真恶心？

scripts.text:
Captain of Anchovy Fishing Boat
Looks like you got a seasickness. It'll get better after a while. By then, you'll feel strange when you walk on land.
scripts.translation:
鳀鱼渔船船长
你这是晕船了。过一会儿就会好些，不过到时在陆地上走路反而会觉得怪怪的。

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
Weird. The ship is firm, but why is it so nauseous?
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
真奇怪，船明明这么稳，我为什么还会晕？

scripts.text:
Captain of Anchovy Fishing Boat
That's because the boat moves along with the waves.
scripts.translation:
鳀鱼渔船船长
因为船会随着波浪起伏。

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
What? Isn't the boat stuck firmly on the water?!
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
什么？船不是牢牢停在水面上的吗？！

scripts.text:
Captain of Anchovy Fishing Boat
It's floating on water, not stuck on water. How can a boat move if It's stuck on water?!
scripts.translation:
鳀鱼渔船船长
船是浮在水上，不是钉在水上。要是钉住了，还怎么航行？！

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
I can't believe it! How can you say that such heavy boat is floating on water?!
scripts.translation:
[达尔达尔]
不敢相信！这么重的船怎么可能浮在水面上？！

scripts.text:
Captain of Anchovy Fishing Boat
Hey you, adventurer!
scripts.translation:
鳀鱼渔船船长
喂，冒险者！

scripts.text:
Captain of Anchovy Fishing Boat
Take them back with you. Working on a ship doesn't require high intelligence, but these idiots probably can't even pull off a cleaning job. No, forget cleaning. I'll be lucky if they don't drive me crazy first.
scripts.translation:
鳀鱼渔船船长
把他们带回去吧。船上的活不需要多聪明，可这两个笨蛋恐怕连清理工作都做不好。不，别说清理了，只要他们不把我逼疯，我就谢天谢地了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I understand.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我明白了。

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
What do you mean you understand? You don't say such a thing like that.
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
你说“明白了”是什么意思？怎么能这么说呢？

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
What are you talking about?
scripts.translation:
[达尔达尔]
你在说什么？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
This won't do. I don't think I can help you. We should go back to ^0000cdLegalas^000000 discuss the matter with him. Let's go now.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这不行，我帮不了你们。我们还是回去和^0000cd莱加拉斯^000000商量一下吧，现在就走。

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
I don't know what just happened, but I'm happy to go back.
scripts.translation:
[达尔达尔]
我不知道刚才发生了什么，不过能回去就好。

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
Yeah, Let's go back for now. This is not fun anymore.
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
是啊，先回去吧。这里一点也不好玩。

scripts.text:
Captain of Anchovy Fishing Boat
Didn't you say that you're going back to Legalas? And next time you bring some helpers, make sure they're decent.
scripts.translation:
鳀鱼渔船船长
你不是说要回去找莱加拉斯吗？下次带帮手来，记得找靠谱的人。

scripts.text:
Captain of Anchovy Fishing Boat
If you have anybody decent, bring him. I'm so short on hands that I do all of that work by myself.
scripts.translation:
鳀鱼渔船船长
有靠谱的人就带来吧。我实在缺人手，什么活都得自己干。

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
What is it? didn't you say that you had some business with not me, but Kalu?
scripts.translation:
[达尔达尔]
怎么了？你不是说要找卡卢办事，不是来找我的吗？

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
Kalu! Tell Kalu that you delivered the lunchbox so we can eat!
scripts.translation:
[达尔达尔]
卡卢！快告诉他午餐盒送到了，这样我们就有东西吃了！

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
I like relaxing here as well. No craving for kalunyak either.
scripts.translation:
[达尔达尔]
我也喜欢在这里放松，而且也不怎么想吃卡鲁尼亚克。

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
Didn't you say you had something to say to Kalu? Go ahead.
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
你不是有话要跟卡卢说吗？快去吧。

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
Too late. Go and report to Kalu.
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
太迟了，快去把午餐盒交给卡卢吧。

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
You're here already. We hate waiting, so we're thinking about just settling here.
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
你终于来了。我们讨厌等人，刚才都打算直接在这儿住下了。

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
Hurry, go and deliver his lunchbox. He looks like he's about to starve to death.
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
快把午餐盒送过去，他看起来快饿死了。

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
Give that vigilante a lunchbox. I'm curious as to what's inside.
scripts.translation:
[达尔达尔]
给那个义警送午餐盒吧，我很好奇里面装了什么。

scripts.text:
[Panna]
Oh, I'm so hungry. When is the food coming? Food.
scripts.translation:
[潘娜]
啊，我好饿。饭什么时候送来？我要吃饭。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Panna?

[{0}]
Panna? Here's your lunchbox...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
潘娜？这是你的午餐盒...

scripts.text:
[Panna]
Where's the lunchbox? Where's mine? there's none for me! Where did you drop it? My food! My food!!!
scripts.translation:
[潘娜]
午餐盒呢？我的那份呢？怎么没有我的！你把它弄丢在哪儿了？我的饭！我的饭！！！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Calm down. I'll go find it right now.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
冷静点，我马上去找。

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
He lost his mind.
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
他饿糊涂了。

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
I can understand, though. Let's go find the lunchbox.
scripts.translation:
[达尔达尔]
我能理解。我们去找午餐盒吧。

scripts.text:
[Panna]
Food!!!
scripts.translation:
[潘娜]
吃的！！！

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
What a rude, ungrateful doram.
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
真是个粗鲁又不知感恩的多兰。

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
How am I supposed to talk when I'm eating?
scripts.translation:
[达尔达尔]
我吃东西的时候怎么说话？

scripts.text:
[Panna]
Chomp chomp chomp.
scripts.translation:
[潘娜]
嚼嚼嚼。

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
That looks delicious...
scripts.translation:
[达尔达尔]
看起来真好吃...

scripts.text:
[Panna]
Hah, I feel much better now. I was so hungry that I was about to eat a basilisk, and you couldn't come at a better time. I almost became a doram who failed to remain as one and turn into an animal.
scripts.translation:
[潘娜]
哈，舒服多了。刚才我饿得差点把巴西利斯克都吃了，幸好你及时送来午餐。我差点饿到失去理智，变成只会吃东西的野兽。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'll take the empty dishes.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我把空盘子收走吧。

scripts.text:
[Panna]
It's okay, just leave them. I'll take them with me when I go back to town later.
scripts.translation:
[潘娜]
不用，就放在那里吧。我晚些回城时会带走。

scripts.text:
[Gopara]
I'm going.
scripts.translation:
[戈帕拉]
我走了。

scripts.text:
[Daldal]
I'm leaving.
scripts.translation:
[达尔达尔]
我也走了。

scripts.text:
[Panna]
Thanks to you, I was able to eat a hearty meal. Please tell Kalu that I'm grateful for the delicious lunch. Hopefully, today will be another safe...
scripts.translation:
[潘娜]
多亏了你，我才能饱餐一顿。请替我谢谢卡卢，这顿午餐真好吃。希望今天也能平安无事...

scripts.text:
[Panna]
Oh, I'm so hungry. When is the food coming? Food.
scripts.translation:
[潘娜]
啊，我好饿。饭什么时候送来？我要吃饭。
